source.text: Οὐδὲν ἄρα νῦν κατάκριμα τοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: No therefore now condemnation to the [ones] in Christ Jesus;

en.L: So now [there is] no condemnation for those in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus.
en.B: So then, those who are in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus now face no sentence of condemnation.
en.R: So now God does not condemn those who belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. No sentence of punishment hangs over them.

es.L: Por tanto, ahora no [hay] condenación alguna para los [que están] en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}}.
es.B: Así pues, los que están en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}} ya no enfrentan ninguna sentencia de condenación.
es.R: Así que ahora Dios no condena a los que pertenecen {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}}. Ya no pesa sobre ellos ninguna sentencia de castigo.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo sasa hakuna kuhukumiwa kwa wale walio katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.B: Basi sasa, wale walio katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu hawakabiliwi na hukumu yoyote ya kuadhibiwa.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo sasa Mungu hawahukumu wale walio wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu. Hakuna adhabu inayowangoja.

fr.L: Donc maintenant, [il n’y a] aucune condamnation pour ceux [qui sont] {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.B: Ainsi donc, il n’y a maintenant plus aucune sentence de condamnation contre ceux qui sont {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.R: Alors maintenant, Dieu ne condamne pas ceux qui appartiennent au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus. Aucune sentence de punition ne pèse sur eux.

ko.L: 그러므로 이제 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에 있는 사람들에게는 정죄함이 없습니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 이제 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에 있는 사람들은 결코 정죄의 판결을 받지 않습니다.
ko.R: 그러므로 이제 하나님께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께 속한 사람들을 정죄하지 않으십니다. 그들에게는 어떤 벌의 판결도 내려지지 않습니다.

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ không có sự kết án nào cho những người ở trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu.
vi.B: Vậy, những người ở trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} giờ đây không còn chịu bản án nào nữa.
vi.R: Vậy bây giờ Đức Chúa Trời không kết án những người thuộc về Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. Không có bản án hình phạt nào treo trên đầu họ.

pt.L: Portanto, agora [não há] nenhuma condenação para os que [estão] {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus.
pt.B: Assim, os que estão {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus agora não enfrentam nenhuma sentença de condenação.
pt.R: Por isso, agora Deus não condena os que pertencem {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}} Jesus. Não pesa sobre eles nenhuma sentença de castigo.

am.L: ስለዚህ አሁን {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ላሉት ኩነኔ [የለም]።
am.B: እንግዲህ {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ያሉትን አሁን የሚጠብቃቸው የኩነኔ ፍርድ የለም።
am.R: ስለዚህ አሁን እግዚአብሔር {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ኢየሱስ የሆኑትን አይኮንናቸውም። የቅጣት ፍርድ በእነርሱ ላይ የለም።

ru.L: Итак, теперь нет никакого осуждения тем, кто {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе.
ru.B: Итак, теперь тем, кто {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе, не грозит никакой приговор осуждения.
ru.R: Итак, теперь Бог не осуждает тех, кто принадлежит {{christos:Христу|Мессии}} Иисусу. Над ними не висит никакой приговор к наказанию.

hi.L: इसलिए अब जो मसीह यीशु में हैं, उनके लिए दोषी ठहराया जाना नहीं।
hi.B: इसलिए जो मसीह यीशु में हैं, उन्हें अब दोषी ठहराए जाने का दंड नहीं भोगना है।
hi.R: इसलिए अब परमेश्वर उन्हें दोषी नहीं ठहराते जो मसीह यीशु के हैं। उन पर दंड का कोई फ़ैसला नहीं लटका है।

uk.L: Отже, тепер [немає] жодного осуду тим, [хто] {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі.
uk.B: Тож тепер тим, хто {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі, не загрожує жоден вирок осуду.
uk.R: Отже, тепер Бог не засуджує тих, хто належить {{christos:Христові|Месії}} Ісусу. Над ними більше не висить вирок покарання.

ja.L: ですから今や、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスにある者たちには、罪に定められることは何も[ありません]。
ja.B: こういうわけで、今や、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスに結ばれている人たちが罪に定められることは、決してありません。
ja.R: ですから今、神は、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスと一つにされた人たちを罪に定めたりはなさいません。その人たちに罰の判決が下されることは、もうないのです。

decisions.choice: condemnation: the sentence passed on the guilty, and the penalty it carries
decisions.reason: katakrima is a law-court word: the judge's verdict against someone and the punishment that follows. Paul used it in 5:16 and 5:18, where Adam's trespass led to condemnation for all. Here that verdict is gone for those in Christ.

decisions.choice: "so now": a conclusion, and a new time
alternatives: "now" as only "at this point in the argument"
decisions.reason: ara draws the conclusion of what Paul has said since 5:12, and especially of 7:25. "Now" is the time that began with Christ, as in 3:21 ("but now") and 5:9: what was true of life under sin is no longer true.

decisions.choice: in Christ Jesus: joined to him, sharing his death and life
decisions.reason: Paul has said that believers were baptized into Christ, died with him and live with him (6:3-11). Being "in" him is that union, and the verdict that falls on him now falls on them.

decisions.choice: the verse ends at "in Christ Jesus"
alternatives: adds "who walk not according to the flesh" (and, in later copies, "but according to the Spirit")
decisions.reason: The earliest manuscripts end the verse here. Later copies add words from verse 4, so that the verse no longer says that freedom from condemnation depends on being in Christ alone; the longer form is in the King James Version. The SBLGNT has the short text. (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

decisions.choice: face no sentence of condemnation (B); God does not condemn them, no sentence of punishment (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out that the word is a judge's sentence (m1). Readable names God as the judge, since he alone passes this sentence (verse 33).

decisions.choice: who belong to Christ Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable explains "in Christ Jesus" as belonging to him (m3).

decisions.choice: kuhukumiwa (L); hukumu ... ya kuadhibiwa (B); Mungu hawahukumu, hakuna adhabu (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the sentence passed on the guilty together with the penalty it carries (m1). "Hukumu" alone is any judgment or verdict, so Literal uses the passive verb "kuhukumiwa" (being condemned), Balanced names the penalty ("hukumu ya kuadhibiwa"), and Readable splits the two, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: passé composé for past events at every level, as in chapters 5-7
alternatives: passé simple at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Romans is a letter: Paul tells his readers what God has done for them, which French says with the passé composé.

decisions.choice: "{{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus" (L, B); "au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus" (R) (for the whole chapter)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians: French cannot say "en Messie", so the span for "in Christ" covers the preposition. Readable says "belong to", where the article stays outside the span ("au Christ" / "au Messie"). Where the Greek has no article and French needs one inside the alternative, it goes inside the span ("{{christos:Christ|le Messie}}"), capitalised at the start of a sentence.

decisions.choice: "정죄함" (L); "정죄의 판결" (B); "정죄하지 않으신다 ... 벌의 판결" (R)
decisions.reason: The noun is the sentence passed on the guilty together with its penalty (meaning decision; compare 5:16, 18). "정죄", the letter's word for condemn (2:1), is kept at every level; Balanced adds "판결" and Readable names the punishment.

decisions.choice: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}; "{{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에" (L, B) / "{{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수께 속한" (R); no deity_pronoun spans (as through the letter)
decisions.reason: As through the letter: Korean has no capital letters for the deity_pronoun setting to change, so respect for God, Christ and the Spirit is carried by -시-, 께서 and "그분". Readable says "belong to" for "in Christ", as in 6:11 and 6:23.

decisions.choice: "sự kết án" (L); "bản án" (B); "không kết án", "bản án hình phạt" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the sentence passed on the guilty and the penalty it carries (m1). "Kết án" is the word for condemnation in 5:16 and 5:18 and returns in 8:3 and 8:34; "bản án" names the sentence itself.

decisions.choice: condenação; sentença de condenação (B); sentença de castigo (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: the word is a judge's sentence (m1). Portuguese "sentença" is the court word, so Balanced and Readable say what kind of condemnation it is; Literal keeps "condenação", as in 5:16 and 5:18.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter
alternatives: capitalised pronouns for God, Christ and the Spirit, as the English alternative
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God, Christ and the Spirit in English (from 8:3 on) has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}}
decisions.reason: As in 3:24 and 6:11: the preposition changes with the word, so it goes inside each option.

decisions.choice: "मसीह यीशु" with no christos setting
decisions.reason: "मसीह" is both the familiar name and the word Messiah itself, so the choice the English setting offers is already made (style guide, section 7). The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "दोषी ठहराया जाना"
decisions.reason: The same word as in 5:16 and 5:18, the sentence passed on the guilty (meaning decision m1), so Literal and Balanced keep "दोषी ठहराना" for it, as in 8:3 and 8:34.

decisions.choice: {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}}
decisions.reason: The preposition changes its form with the next word ("у Христі", "в Месії"), so it goes inside each option, as the Ukrainian brief asks for Romans.

decisions.choice: "罪に定められること" (L, B); "罪に定めたりはなさいません" and "罰の判決" (R)
decisions.reason: The word is a judge's verdict and the penalty that follows (m1). "罪に定める" is the plain Japanese for passing that verdict, and the same verb serves for "condemned sin" in verse 3 and "who condemns?" in verse 34, so the thread stays visible. Readable names God as the judge, as the English Readable does, and adds the sentence of punishment.

decisions.choice: "にある" (L); "に結ばれている" (B); "と一つにされた" (R)
decisions.reason: The Romans terms settle "in Christ" as union with him (m3): Literal keeps the bare preposition, Balanced says joined to him, and Readable says made one with him. This holds for the whole chapter.

source.text: ὁ γὰρ νόμος τοῦ πνεύματος τῆς ζωῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἠλευθέρωσέν σε ἀπὸ τοῦ νόμου τῆς ἁμαρτίας καὶ τοῦ θανάτου.

records.literal_gloss: The for law of the Spirit of the life in Christ Jesus set free you from the law of the sin and of the death.

en.L: For the law of the Spirit of life in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus set you free from the law of sin and of death.
en.B: For in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus the law of the Spirit who gives life has freed you from the law of sin and death.
en.R: The Spirit gives life to everyone who is joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. And the Spirit's power has set you free from the power of sin, which leads to death.

es.L: Porque la ley del Espíritu de la vida en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}} te liberó de la ley del pecado y de la muerte.
es.B: Porque en {{christos:Cristo Jesús|el Mesías Jesús}} la ley del Espíritu que da vida te ha hecho libre de la ley del pecado y de la muerte.
es.R: El Espíritu da vida a todos los que están unidos {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}}. Y el poder del Espíritu te ha liberado del poder del pecado, que lleva a la muerte.

sw.L: Kwa maana sheria ya Roho wa uzima katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu ilikuweka huru mbali na sheria ya dhambi na ya kifo.
sw.B: Kwa maana katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, sheria ya Roho anayetoa uzima imekuweka huru kutoka kwa sheria ya dhambi na kifo.
sw.R: Roho humpa uzima kila mtu aliyeunganishwa na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu. Na nguvu ya Roho imekuweka huru kutoka kwa nguvu ya dhambi, inayoleta kifo.

fr.L: Car la loi de l’Esprit de la vie {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus t’a libéré de la loi du péché et de la mort.
fr.B: Car {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus, la loi de l’Esprit qui donne la vie t’a libéré de la loi du péché et de la mort.
fr.R: L’Esprit donne la vie à tous ceux qui sont unis au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus. Et la puissance de l’Esprit t’a libéré de la puissance du péché, qui mène à la mort.

ko.L: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서 생명의 성령의 법이 죄와 죽음의 법에서 당신을 해방하였기 때문입니다.
ko.B: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수 안에서, 생명을 주시는 성령의 법이 죄와 죽음의 법에서 당신을 해방했기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 성령께서는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수와 하나가 된 모든 사람에게 생명을 주십니다. 그리고 성령의 능력은 죽음으로 이끄는 죄의 권세에서 당신을 자유롭게 해 주었습니다.

vi.L: Vì luật của Thánh Linh sự sống trong {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu đã giải phóng bạn khỏi luật của tội lỗi và của sự chết.
vi.B: Vì trong Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, luật của Thánh Linh, Đấng ban sự sống, đã giải phóng bạn khỏi luật của tội lỗi và sự chết.
vi.R: Thánh Linh ban sự sống cho mọi người được hiệp nhất với Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. Và quyền năng của Thánh Linh đã giải phóng bạn khỏi quyền lực của tội lỗi, là điều dẫn đến sự chết.

pt.L: Pois a lei do Espírito da vida {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus libertou você da lei do pecado e da morte.
pt.B: Pois {{christos:em Cristo|no Messias}} Jesus a lei do Espírito que dá vida libertou você da lei do pecado e da morte.
pt.R: O Espírito dá vida a todos os que estão unidos {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}} Jesus. E o poder do Espírito libertou você do poder do pecado, que leva à morte.

am.L: ምክንያቱም {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ያለው የሕይወት መንፈስ ሕግ ከኃጢአትና ከሞት ሕግ ነጻ አወጣህ።
am.B: ምክንያቱም {{christos:በክርስቶስ|በመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ሕይወትን የሚሰጠው የመንፈስ ሕግ ከኃጢአትና ከሞት ሕግ ነጻ አውጥቶሃል።
am.R: መንፈስ ቅዱስ {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሕ}} ኢየሱስ ጋር አንድ ለሆነ ሁሉ ሕይወትን ይሰጣል። የመንፈስ ቅዱስ ኃይልም ወደ ሞት ከሚመራው ከኃጢአት ኃይል ነጻ አውጥቶሃል።

ru.L: Ведь закон Духа жизни {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе освободил тебя от закона греха и смерти.
ru.B: Ведь {{christos:во Христе|в Мессии}} Иисусе закон Духа, дающего жизнь, освободил тебя от закона греха и смерти.
ru.R: Дух даёт жизнь каждому, кто соединён {{christos:со Христом|с Мессией}} Иисусом. И сила Духа освободила тебя от власти греха, которая ведёт к смерти.

hi.L: क्योंकि मसीह यीशु में जीवन के आत्मा की व्यवस्था ने तुम्हें पाप और मृत्यु की व्यवस्था से स्वतंत्र कर दिया।
hi.B: क्योंकि मसीह यीशु में जीवन देनेवाले आत्मा के नियम ने तुम्हें पाप और मृत्यु के नियम से स्वतंत्र कर दिया है।
hi.R: आत्मा हर उस व्यक्ति को जीवन देता है जो मसीह यीशु से जुड़ा है। और आत्मा की शक्ति ने तुम्हें पाप की शक्ति से स्वतंत्र कर दिया है, जो मृत्यु तक ले जाती है।

uk.L: Бо закон Духа життя {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі звільнив тебе від закону гріха і смерті.
uk.B: Бо {{christos:у Христі|в Месії}} Ісусі закон Духа, що дає життя, визволив тебе від закону гріха і смерті.
uk.R: Дух дає життя кожному, хто поєднаний з {{christos:Христом|Месією}} Ісусом. І сила Духа звільнила тебе з-під влади гріха, яка веде до смерті.

ja.L: なぜなら、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスにある命の霊の律法が、罪と死の律法からあなたを解放したからです。
ja.B: {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスに結ばれたあなたを、命を与える霊の法則が、罪と死の法則から解放したからです。
ja.R: 聖霊は、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスと一つにされたすべての人に、命を与えてくださいます。この聖霊の法則が、あなたを罪の法則から自由にしてくださいました。罪の法則は、人を死へと向かわせるものです。

decisions.choice: law: here a ruling power or order, the Spirit's against sin's
alternatives: the law of Moses in both places: the same law, used by the Spirit or by sin
decisions.reason: Paul has just spoken of "another law" at work in his body, "the law of sin" (7:21-23). Here he sets the rule of the Spirit against that rule of sin. Some read both phrases as the law of Moses, which sin used to bring death (7:10-11) and which the Spirit now fulfills (verse 4); the wording allows that too.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of life: the Spirit who gives life
alternatives: "the spirit of life" as a quality, a living spirit
decisions.reason: Paul names the Spirit as the one who gives life in verses 10-11, against sin which leads to death.

decisions.choice: "in Christ Jesus" goes with the whole saying: the Spirit sets free those joined to Christ
alternatives: goes only with "life": the life that is in Christ Jesus
decisions.reason: The phrase stands between "life" and "set free" and may go with either. Both say that the freedom and the life come in union with Christ (verse 1), so the levels keep it close to both.

decisions.choice: "you" (singular)
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts have "you" in the singular, Paul speaking to each reader in turn; some have "me", continuing chapter 7, and a few "us". The SBLGNT has "you". (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

decisions.choice: the Spirit's power; the power of sin
alternatives: the Spirit's law; the law of sin
decisions.reason: Readable says "power" for the sense the meaning decision prefers (m1), so a new reader does not think of a written law code; the decision is marked uncertain for reviewers.

decisions.choice: te (tú), no setting
decisions.reason: The Greek "you" here is singular (m4): Paul speaks to each reader. Spanish keeps the singular "te", which needs no ustedes/vosotros setting.

decisions.choice: -ku- (ilikuweka huru, imekuweka huru)
decisions.reason: The Greek "you" is singular (m4), and Swahili keeps the singular object marker "-ku-" at every level.

decisions.choice: kifo
decisions.reason: For death through this chapter Swahili uses "kifo", the plain everyday word, at every level. "Mauti" is the older word familiar from church reading; it means the same, and a reviewer may prefer it at Literal.

decisions.choice: "la loi de l'Esprit", "la loi du péché" in lower case
decisions.reason: As in 7:21-23, "law" here is a ruling power or order (see the meaning decision), so it is written in lower case; the capital is kept for the law of Moses (verses 3-4, 7).

decisions.choice: "t'" (singular you)
decisions.reason: The Greek "you" is singular here, Paul speaking to each reader in turn; French keeps the singular "te", where English cannot show it.

decisions.choice: "당신" at every level for the singular "you"
decisions.reason: The Greek turns to a single reader (meaning decision, with the variant in its footnote). Korean uses "당신", the 합쇼체 singular already used for the imagined listener in 2:1-27, so the shift from "여러분" stays visible without leaving the letter's speech level.

decisions.choice: "법" (L, B) for the two "laws"; "능력" and "권세" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "law" here as a ruling power or order, as in 7:21-23, so Korean uses "법", not "율법"; Readable says "능력" for the Spirit and "권세" for sin, as the English Readable says "power".

decisions.choice: "bạn" for the singular "you"
decisions.reason: The text has the singular "you" (m4, footnoted). As in 2:1, "bạn" is the Vietnamese for one reader addressed directly; "anh chị em" would make it plural.

decisions.choice: "luật" (L, B); "quyền năng", "quyền lực" (R)
decisions.reason: Here law is a ruling power or order, the Spirit's against sin's (m1), so Vietnamese uses "luật", as in 7:21-25, not "luật pháp", the word kept for the law of Moses in verses 3-4.

decisions.choice: você (singular)
decisions.reason: The Greek "you" is singular here (m4): Paul speaks to each reader in turn. Portuguese can show that, as English cannot, so every level says "você", the singular of the "vocês" Paul uses for the church (docs/portuguese-style.md section 4).

decisions.choice: a lei (lowercase)
decisions.reason: "Law" here is a ruling power (m1), as in 7:21-23, so it takes a small letter; "a Lei" with a capital is the Law of Moses (verses 3-4, 7).

decisions.choice: "ነጻ አወጣህ" (set you free, singular)
decisions.reason: The Greek "you" is singular here, and the Amharic verb ending shows it, as Paul turns to each reader in person.

decisions.choice: тебя
decisions.reason: The Greek has the singular "you" here (m4), so Russian says "тебя", as Paul turns to each reader; the English cannot show the difference.

decisions.choice: закон, lowercase
decisions.reason: "Law" here is a ruling power or order (m1), the Spirit's against sin's, so it is not capitalised; Readable says "сила" and "власть", as the English says "power".

decisions.choice: "नियम" (B); "व्यवस्था" (L); "शक्ति" (R)
decisions.reason: Law here is a ruling power or order (meaning decision m1), as in 7:21-25, so Balanced says "नियम" as it did there; Literal keeps the one word "व्यवस्था".

decisions.choice: тебе
decisions.reason: The Greek has the singular "you" (m4), so Ukrainian says "тебе", as Paul turns to each reader; English cannot show the difference.

decisions.choice: закон, lowercase
decisions.reason: Here "law" is a ruling power or order (m1), the Spirit's against sin's, so it is not capitalised as God's Law is; Readable says "сила" and "влада", as the English says "power".

decisions.choice: "律法" (L); "法則" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Here the word most likely means a ruling power or order, the Spirit's against sin's (m1), as in 7:21-23. The Romans terms keep "律法" at Literal, so the reader sees the same Greek word as the law of Moses, and use "法則" at Balanced and Readable for a rule that is at work. The other reading, the law of Moses, is still open (m1).

decisions.choice: "霊" (L, B); "聖霊" (R), with light respect forms ("与えてくださいます")
decisions.reason: For God's Spirit the style guide uses "霊" ("御霊" is not used). Readable writes "聖霊" so that a new reader does not take "霊" for a ghost or for the human spirit, which verse 16 sets beside the Spirit. The Spirit's actions take the light respect forms used for God in the letters. This holds for the whole chapter.

source.text: τὸ γὰρ ἀδύνατον τοῦ νόμου, ἐν ᾧ ἠσθένει διὰ τῆς σαρκός, ὁ θεὸς τὸν ἑαυτοῦ υἱὸν πέμψας ἐν ὁμοιώματι σαρκὸς ἁμαρτίας καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας κατέκρινε τὴν ἁμαρτίαν ἐν τῇ σαρκί, ἵνα τὸ δικαίωμα τοῦ νόμου πληρωθῇ ἐν ἡμῖν τοῖς μὴ κατὰ σάρκα περιπατοῦσιν ἀλλὰ κατὰ πνεῦμα·

records.literal_gloss: The for impossible [thing] of the law, in which it was weak through the flesh, the God the of himself Son having sent in likeness of flesh of sin and concerning sin condemned the sin in the flesh, \v 4 so that the righteous requirement of the law might be fulfilled in us, the [ones] not according to flesh walking but according to Spirit;

en.L: For what was impossible for the law, in that it was weak through the flesh, God [did]: sending {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own Son in [the] likeness of flesh of sin, and for sin, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} condemned sin in the flesh, \v 4 so that the righteous requirement of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not according to [the] flesh but according to [the] Spirit.
en.B: The law was powerless, since the flesh had left it weak. So God acted. He sent {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, as an offering for sin, and in the flesh {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} passed sentence on sin. \v 4 He did this so that the law's righteous requirement would be fully met in us, who conduct our lives by the Spirit and not by the flesh.
en.R: The law could not do this, because our sinful selves were too weak to keep it. But God did it. He sent {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own Son as a real human being, with a body like the bodies of sinful people. God sent {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to be an offering for sin. In {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} human body God judged sin and condemned it. \v 4 God did this so that what the law rightly requires would come true in us. Now we do not follow our sinful selves. We follow the Spirit.

es.L: Porque lo imposible para la ley, en cuanto que era débil por la carne, Dios [lo hizo]: enviando a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio Hijo en [la] semejanza de [la] carne de pecado, y por el pecado, condenó el pecado en la carne, \v 4 para que la justa exigencia de la ley se cumpliera en nosotros, que no andamos según [la] carne sino según [el] Espíritu.
es.B: La ley no tenía poder, porque la carne la había dejado débil. Por eso actuó Dios. Envió a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio Hijo en semejanza de carne pecadora, como ofrenda por el pecado, y en la carne dictó sentencia contra el pecado. \v 4 Lo hizo para que la justa exigencia de la ley se cumpliera plenamente en nosotros, que llevamos nuestra vida guiados por el Espíritu y no por la carne.
es.R: La ley no podía hacer esto, porque nuestro yo pecador era demasiado débil para cumplirla. Pero Dios lo hizo. Envió a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio Hijo como un verdadero ser humano, con un cuerpo como el de la gente pecadora. Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} envió para ser una ofrenda por el pecado. En {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cuerpo humano, Dios juzgó al pecado y lo condenó. \v 4 Dios hizo esto para que lo que la ley justamente exige se hiciera realidad en nosotros. Ahora no vivimos según lo que quiere nuestro yo pecador. Vivimos guiados por el Espíritu.

sw.L: Kwa maana kile ambacho sheria haikuweza, kwa kuwa ilikuwa dhaifu kwa sababu ya mwili, Mungu [alikifanya]: akimtuma Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe kwa sura ya mwili wa dhambi, na kwa ajili ya dhambi, aliihukumu dhambi ndani ya mwili, \v 4 ili matakwa ya haki ya sheria yatimizwe ndani yetu, sisi tusiotembea kwa kadiri ya mwili bali kwa kadiri ya Roho.
sw.B: Sheria haikuwa na uwezo, kwa kuwa asili ya dhambi iliidhoofisha. Kwa hiyo Mungu alitenda. Alimtuma Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe akiwa na mfano wa mwili wenye dhambi, kama sadaka kwa ajili ya dhambi, na katika mwili huo akaitolea dhambi hukumu. \v 4 Alifanya hivyo ili matakwa ya haki ya sheria yatimizwe kikamilifu ndani yetu, sisi tunaoishi tukiongozwa na Roho, wala si na asili ya dhambi.
sw.R: Sheria haikuweza kufanya hivyo, kwa sababu asili yetu ya dhambi ilikuwa dhaifu mno kuweza kuitii. Lakini Mungu alifanya hivyo. Alimtuma Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe kama mwanadamu halisi, mwenye mwili kama miili ya watu wenye dhambi. Mungu alimtuma ili awe sadaka kwa ajili ya dhambi. Katika mwili {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kibinadamu Mungu aliihukumu dhambi na kuitia hatiani. \v 4 Mungu alifanya hivyo ili yale ambayo sheria inadai kwa haki yatimie ndani yetu. Sasa hatufuati tena asili yetu ya dhambi. Tunamfuata Roho.

fr.L: Car ce qui était impossible à la Loi, en ce qu’elle était faible à cause de la chair, Dieu [l’a fait] : en envoyant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre Fils dans [la] ressemblance d’une chair de péché, et pour le péché, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a condamné le péché dans la chair, \v 4 afin que la juste exigence de la Loi soit accomplie en nous, qui marchons non selon [la] chair mais selon [l’]Esprit.
fr.B: La Loi était impuissante, parce que la chair l’avait rendue faible. Alors Dieu a agi. Il a envoyé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre Fils dans une chair semblable à notre chair pécheresse, comme sacrifice pour le péché, et dans la chair, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prononcé la condamnation du péché. \v 4 Il l’a fait pour que la juste exigence de la Loi soit pleinement accomplie en nous, qui conduisons notre vie selon l’Esprit et non selon la chair.
fr.R: La Loi ne pouvait pas faire cela, parce que notre nature pécheresse était trop faible pour lui obéir. Mais Dieu l’a fait. Il a envoyé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre Fils comme un vrai être humain, avec un corps semblable à celui des gens pécheurs. Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a envoyé pour être un sacrifice pour le péché. Dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} corps humain, Dieu a jugé le péché et l’a condamné. \v 4 Dieu a fait cela pour que ce que la Loi demande à juste titre se réalise en nous. Maintenant, nous ne suivons plus notre nature pécheresse. Nous suivons l’Esprit.

ko.L: 율법이 육신으로 말미암아 약해져서 할 수 없었던 것을 하나님께서 [하셨습니다]. 곧 자기 아들을 죄 있는 육신의 모양으로, 그리고 죄를 위하여 보내셔서, 육신 안에서 죄를 정죄하셨습니다. \v 4 이는 육신을 따라 걷지 않고 성령을 따라 걷는 우리 안에서 율법의 의로운 요구가 이루어지게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 율법은 육신 때문에 약해져서 아무것도 할 수 없었습니다. 그래서 하나님께서 직접 일하셨습니다. 하나님께서는 자기 아들을 죄 있는 육신과 같은 모습으로 보내셔서 죄를 위한 제물이 되게 하셨고, 그 육신 안에서 죄에 판결을 내리셨습니다. \v 4 그것은 육신을 따르지 않고 성령을 따라 사는 우리 안에서 율법이 요구하는 의가 온전히 이루어지게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.R: 우리의 죄에 끌리는 본성이 너무 약해서 우리는 율법을 지킬 수 없었습니다. 그래서 율법은 이 일을 할 수 없었습니다. 그러나 하나님께서 그 일을 하셨습니다. 하나님께서는 자기 아들을 참된 사람으로 보내셨습니다. 그분은 죄 있는 사람들과 똑같은 몸을 입으셨습니다. 하나님께서는 그분을 죄를 없애는 제물로 보내셨습니다. 그리고 그분의 사람의 몸에서 죄를 심판하시고 정죄하셨습니다. \v 4 하나님께서 이렇게 하신 것은 율법이 바르게 요구하는 것이 우리 안에서 이루어지게 하시려는 것입니다. 이제 우리는 죄에 끌리는 본성을 따르지 않고 성령을 따릅니다.

vi.L: Vì điều luật pháp không thể làm được, vì luật pháp yếu đuối bởi xác thịt, thì Đức Chúa Trời [đã làm]: sai chính Con của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến trong hình dạng giống như xác thịt tội lỗi, và vì tội lỗi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã kết án tội lỗi trong xác thịt, \v 4 để điều đòi hỏi công chính của luật pháp được làm trọn trong chúng ta, là những người không bước đi theo xác thịt nhưng theo Thánh Linh.
vi.B: Luật pháp đã bất lực, vì xác thịt đã làm cho nó yếu đuối. Vì vậy Đức Chúa Trời đã hành động. Ngài sai chính Con của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến trong hình dạng giống như xác thịt tội lỗi, để làm của lễ chuộc tội, và trong xác thịt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã kết án tội lỗi. \v 4 Ngài làm vậy để điều đòi hỏi công chính của luật pháp được làm trọn trong chúng ta, là những người sống theo Thánh Linh chứ không theo xác thịt.
vi.R: Luật pháp không thể làm được điều này, vì bản tính tội lỗi của chúng ta quá yếu đuối để vâng giữ luật pháp. Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời đã làm. Ngài sai chính Con của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến làm một con người thật, có thân thể giống như thân thể của những người tội lỗi. Đức Chúa Trời sai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến để làm của lễ chuộc tội. Trong thân thể con người của Con, Đức Chúa Trời đã xét xử và kết án tội lỗi. \v 4 Đức Chúa Trời làm điều này để những gì luật pháp đòi hỏi cách công chính được thực hiện trong chúng ta. Giờ đây chúng ta không đi theo bản tính tội lỗi nữa. Chúng ta đi theo Thánh Linh.

pt.L: Pois o que era impossível para a Lei, visto que estava enfraquecida pela carne, Deus [fez]: enviando o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio Filho em semelhança de carne de pecado, e pelo pecado, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} condenou o pecado na carne, \v 4 para que a justa exigência da Lei fosse cumprida em nós, que não andamos segundo a carne, mas segundo o Espírito.
pt.B: A Lei não tinha poder, porque a carne a deixava fraca. Então Deus agiu. Ele enviou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio Filho em semelhança de carne pecadora, como oferta pelo pecado, e na carne {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deu a sentença contra o pecado. \v 4 Fez isso para que a justa exigência da Lei fosse plenamente cumprida em nós, que conduzimos a vida pelo Espírito, e não pela carne.
pt.R: A Lei não podia fazer isso, porque a nossa natureza pecadora era fraca demais para cumpri-la. Mas Deus fez. Ele enviou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio Filho como um ser humano de verdade, com um corpo igual ao corpo das pessoas pecadoras. Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} enviou para ser uma oferta pelo pecado. No corpo humano {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, Deus julgou o pecado e o condenou. \v 4 Deus fez isso para que aquilo que a Lei exige com justiça se cumprisse em nós. Agora não seguimos a nossa natureza pecadora. Seguimos o Espírito.

am.L: ሕግ በሥጋ በኩል ደካማ ስለ ነበረ ሊያደርገው ያልቻለውን እግዚአብሔር [አደረገው]፤ የገዛ ልጁን በኃጢአት ሥጋ ምሳሌ ስለ ኃጢአትም ልኮ በሥጋ ኃጢአትን ኮነነ፤ \v 4 ይኸውም እንደ ሥጋ ሳይሆን እንደ መንፈስ በምንመላለስ በእኛ የሕጉ የጽድቅ መስፈርት እንዲፈጸም ነው።
am.B: ሕጉ ኃይል አልነበረውም፤ ሥጋ አድክሞት ነበርና። ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ራሱ አደረገ። የገዛ ልጁን በኃጢአተኛ ሥጋ ምሳሌ፣ ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አድርጎ ላከው፤ በሥጋም በኃጢአት ላይ ፍርድ አስተላለፈ። \v 4 ይህን ያደረገው፣ በሥጋ ሳይሆን በመንፈስ በምንኖር በእኛ የሕጉ የጽድቅ መስፈርት ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲፈጸም ነው።
am.R: ሕጉ ይህን ማድረግ አልቻለም፤ ምክንያቱም ኃጢአተኛው ማንነታችን ሕጉን ለመጠበቅ እጅግ ደካማ ነበር። እግዚአብሔር ግን አደረገው። የገዛ ልጁን እውነተኛ ሰው አድርጎ ላከው፤ ሰውነቱም እንደ ኃጢአተኞች ሰዎች ሰውነት ነበር። እግዚአብሔር ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት እንዲሆን ላከው። በሰው አካሉም እግዚአብሔር በኃጢአት ላይ ፈረደ፤ ኮነነውም። \v 4 እግዚአብሔር ይህን ያደረገው ሕጉ በትክክል የሚጠይቀው በእኛ እንዲፈጸም ነው። አሁን ኃጢአተኛውን ማንነታችንን አንከተልም፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስን እንከተላለን።

ru.L: Ведь что было невозможно для Закона, потому что он был немощен из-за плоти, [то сделал] Бог: послав своего Сына в подобии плоти греха и за грех, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} осудил грех во плоти, \v 4 чтобы праведное требование Закона исполнилось в нас, живущих не по плоти, но по Духу.
ru.B: Закон был бессилен, потому что плоть сделала его немощным. И тогда Бог сделал это. Он послал своего Сына в подобии греховной плоти, как жертву за грех, и во плоти {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вынес приговор греху. \v 4 Он сделал это, чтобы праведное требование Закона было полностью исполнено в нас, тех, кто живёт по Духу, а не по плоти.
ru.R: Закон не мог этого сделать, потому что наша греховная природа была слишком слаба, чтобы исполнять его. Но Бог это сделал. Он послал своего Сына как настоящего человека, с телом, как у грешных людей. Бог послал {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} стал жертвой за грех. В {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} человеческом теле Бог осудил грех. \v 4 Бог сделал это, чтобы то, что справедливо требует Закон, исполнилось в нас. Теперь мы не следуем греховной природе. Мы следуем Духу.

hi.L: क्योंकि जो काम व्यवस्था न कर सकी, क्योंकि वह शरीर के कारण निर्बल थी, उसे परमेश्वर ने [किया]: अपने ही पुत्र को पापमय शरीर की समानता में, और पाप के लिए भेजकर, उन्होंने शरीर में पाप को दोषी ठहराया, \v 4 ताकि व्यवस्था की धर्मी माँग हममें पूरी हो, जो शरीर के अनुसार नहीं, पर आत्मा के अनुसार चलते हैं।
hi.B: व्यवस्था असमर्थ थी, क्योंकि शरीर ने उसे निर्बल कर दिया था। इसलिए परमेश्वर ने स्वयं कार्य किया। उन्होंने अपने ही पुत्र को पापमय शरीर की समानता में, पापबलि के रूप में भेजा, और शरीर में पाप को दोषी ठहराया। \v 4 उन्होंने यह इसलिए किया कि व्यवस्था की धर्मी माँग हममें पूरी हो, जो शरीर के अनुसार नहीं, बल्कि आत्मा के अनुसार अपना जीवन बिताते हैं।
hi.R: व्यवस्था यह नहीं कर सकी, क्योंकि हमारा शारीरिक स्वभाव उसे मानने के लिए बहुत कमज़ोर था। पर परमेश्वर ने यह कर दिखाया। उन्होंने अपने ही पुत्र को एक सच्चे मनुष्य के रूप में भेजा, ऐसे शरीर के साथ जो पापी लोगों के शरीर जैसा था। परमेश्वर ने उन्हें पाप के लिए बलि होने को भेजा। उनके मानवीय शरीर में परमेश्वर ने पाप का न्याय किया और उसे दोषी ठहराया। \v 4 परमेश्वर ने यह इसलिए किया कि जो व्यवस्था ठीक ही माँगती है, वह हममें पूरा हो। अब हम अपने शारीरिक स्वभाव के पीछे नहीं चलते। हम आत्मा के पीछे चलते हैं।

uk.L: Бо [те], що [було] неможливе для Закону, оскільки він був немічний через тіло, [зробив] Бог: пославши свого власного Сина в подобі тіла гріха і за гріх, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} засудив гріх у тілі, \v 4 щоб праведна вимога Закону здійснилася в нас, які ходимо не згідно з тілом, а згідно з Духом.
uk.B: Закон був безсилий, бо тіло зробило його немічним. Тож діяв Бог. Він послав свого власного Сина в подобі грішного тіла як жертву за гріх, і в тілі {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} виніс вирок гріхові. \v 4 Він зробив це, щоб праведна вимога Закону повністю виконалася в нас, які живемо за проводом Духа, а не тіла.
uk.R: Закон не міг цього зробити, бо наша грішна природа була надто слабка, щоб його виконувати. Але Бог це зробив. Він послав свого власного Сина справжньою людиною, з тілом, як у грішних людей. Бог послав {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} стати жертвою за гріх. У {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} людському тілі Бог судив гріх і засудив його. \v 4 Бог зробив це, щоб те, чого справедливо вимагає Закон, здійснилося в нас. Тепер ми не йдемо за своєю грішною природою. Ми йдемо за Духом.

ja.L: というのは、律法が肉によって弱くなっていたためにできなかったこと[を]、神は[なさいました]。ご自分の御子を罪の肉の似姿で、また罪のために遣わして、肉において罪を罪に定められたのです。\v 4 それは、肉に従ってではなく霊に従って歩むわたしたちのうちに、律法の正しい要求が満たされるためでした。
ja.B: 律法は、肉のために弱くなっていて、無力でした。そこで神が行動されました。ご自分の御子を、罪ある肉と同じ姿で、罪のためのささげ物として遣わし、その肉において罪に判決を下されたのです。\v 4 それは、肉ではなく霊に従って生きるわたしたちのうちに、律法の正しい要求が完全に満たされるためでした。
ja.R: 律法には、この解放ができませんでした。罪に傾く人間の性質が弱すぎて、律法を守ることができなかったからです。しかし、神がそれをしてくださいました。神はご自分の御子を、本当の人間として遣わされました。御子は、罪のある人々と同じような体をもって来られたのです。神は御子を、罪のためのささげ物として遣わされました。そして、御子の人間としての体において、罪をさばき、罪に定められました。\v 4 神がこうなさったのは、律法が正しく求めていることが、わたしたちのうちに実現するためです。今、わたしたちは罪に傾く性質に従わず、聖霊に従って生きています。

decisions.choice: what the law could not do, God did
alternatives: "the law's weakness" as the object of "condemned"
decisions.reason: The sentence opens with "the impossible thing of the law" and never gives it a verb of its own; Paul breaks off and says what God did instead. The thing the law could not do is what verse 2 has just said: set people free from sin and death.

decisions.choice: flesh: human nature, weak and under sin's sway
decisions.reason: In Romans 7-8 the flesh is human life in its weakness, under sin's sway and set against God's Spirit (7:5, 7:18, 7:25; Galatians 5:16-17). Paul does not mean the body as such, which God will give life to (verse 11). The law was good (7:12), but it could not change people whose flesh was ruled by sin.

decisions.choice: in the likeness of sinful flesh: truly human, yet not himself sinful
decisions.reason: homoiōma ("likeness") lets Paul say two things at once. The Son came in real human flesh, the flesh in which sin rules in everyone else; yet he did not sin (2 Corinthians 5:21). Paul uses the same word in Philippians 2:7.

decisions.choice: for sin: as a sin offering
decisions.reason: In the Greek Old Testament "for sin" is the regular name for the sin offering (Leviticus 4-5, 16; Isaiah 53:10). God sent the Son to be the sacrifice that deals with sin.

decisions.choice: condemned sin in the flesh: in the Son's own human nature, where sin was judged
decisions.reason: God passed sentence on sin in the very flesh where it had ruled. Because "the flesh" follows the Son coming "in the likeness of sinful flesh", it most naturally means his flesh, put to death on the cross; sin's condemnation fell there, and so not on those in Christ (verse 1).

decisions.choice: the righteous requirement is fulfilled in us: God brings it about
alternatives: "fulfilled by us" through our own effort
decisions.reason: dikaiōma is what the law rightly requires. The verb is passive and the phrase is "in us", not "by us": God's work in Christ and the Spirit bring about what the law asked for. Those in whom this happens are those who live by the Spirit.

decisions.choice: walk: live, conduct one's life
decisions.reason: peripateō ("walk") is the usual biblical word for how a person lives, as in 6:4 and 13:13.

decisions.choice: the sentence is broken into four
decisions.reason: The Greek runs on from verse 3 into verse 4 and leaves its first phrase without a verb (m1). Balanced finishes that thought first, "The law was powerless", and then tells what God did in short sentences.

decisions.choice: our sinful selves
decisions.reason: Readable says what "flesh" means here (m2), as in Galatians 5 and Romans 13:14.

decisions.choice: as a real human being, with a body like the bodies of sinful people; in his human body
decisions.reason: Readable explains "likeness of sinful flesh" (m3) and "in the flesh" (m5) in plain words.

decisions.choice: conduct our lives
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the picture of walking means (m7).

decisions.choice: carne (L, B); yo pecador (R)
decisions.reason: Recorded once for the chapter. Where the flesh is human nature under sin's sway, set against the Spirit (m2), Literal and Balanced keep "carne", as the English keeps "flesh" and as Galatians 5 and Romans 13:14 do, and Readable says "yo pecador" (sinful self). Where it is the Son's own human nature ("semejanza de carne pecadora", "condenó el pecado en la carne", m3, m5), Readable says "un verdadero ser humano" and "cuerpo humano", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: mwili (L); asili ya dhambi (B, R); mwili where the Son's human nature is meant
decisions.reason: Recorded once for the chapter. Literal keeps "mwili" for the flesh throughout. Where the flesh is human nature under sin's sway, set against the Spirit (m2; 8:3-9, 8:12-13), Balanced and Readable say "asili ya dhambi" (sinful nature), as Galatians 5 and Romans 13:14 do, because "mwili" would be heard as the body and its appetites only. Where the flesh is the Son's own human nature ("mfano wa mwili wenye dhambi", "katika mwili huo", m3, m5), every level keeps "mwili", since there it is plain human life, not sinful nature.

decisions.choice: tusiotembea kwa kadiri ya (L); tunaoishi tukiongozwa na Roho (B)
decisions.reason: Walking is the biblical picture for how one lives (m7). Literal keeps "kutembea", as Galatians 5:16 does; Balanced says "live, led by the Spirit", as there, where the English Balanced says "conduct our lives".

decisions.choice: "notre nature pécheresse" (R) for "the flesh" (for the whole chapter)
decisions.reason: As in chapter 7: Literal and Balanced keep "la chair"; Readable says what it means here, human nature under sin's sway, as the English Readable says "sinful self".

decisions.choice: "육신" (L, B); "죄에 끌리는 본성" (R), as settled at 7:5; "죄 있는 육신의 모양" (L) / "죄 있는 육신과 같은 모습" (B) / "죄 있는 사람들과 똑같은 몸" (R)
decisions.reason: The flesh here is human nature, weak and under sin's sway (meaning decision); Literal and Balanced keep "육신" so the four uses in these verses stay one word. The meaning decision says the Son was truly human yet not himself sinful; "모양", "같은 모습" keep that "likeness", and Readable keeps it by speaking of sinful people's bodies, not of a sinful Son.

decisions.choice: "죄를 위하여" (L); "죄를 위한 제물" (B); "죄를 없애는 제물" (R); "걷다" (L) / "살다" (B) / "따르다" (R) for walk
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "for sin" as the sin offering; Literal keeps the bare phrase and Balanced and Readable name the offering. Walking is the picture for how one lives, kept at Literal as in 6:4.

decisions.choice: "trong hình dạng giống như xác thịt tội lỗi" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The likeness says he was truly human, yet not himself sinful (m3). "Hình dạng giống như" says that he shared our human form, without saying that he shared our sin.

decisions.choice: "vì tội lỗi" (L); "làm của lễ chuộc tội" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The phrase is the Greek Old Testament's name for the sin offering (m4). Literal keeps the bare phrase; Balanced and Readable say what it means, with "của lễ chuộc tội" as in 3:25.

decisions.choice: a nossa natureza pecadora
decisions.reason: As in 7:5, 7:18 and 7:25: Readable says what "flesh" means (m2), as the English "sinful selves" does; Literal and Balanced keep "a carne" (docs/portuguese-style.md section 6). The same in verses 5-13.

decisions.choice: andamos
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of walking (m7), as the English does; Portuguese "andar segundo" is understood as "live by". Balanced says "conduzimos a vida".

decisions.choice: плоть
decisions.reason: Key term: sarx is "плоть" at Literal and Balanced through 8:3-13. Readable says "греховная природа" where the sense is moral (m2), and "человек", "тело" where it is the Son's human body (m3, m5).

decisions.choice: ходить; живущих
decisions.reason: In 8:4 Literal says "живущих" for "walk", as the meaning decision explains (m7); "ходящих по плоти" would be read literally.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans; honorific forms for God and the Son ("उन्होंने", "उनके मानवीय शरीर"), and "आत्मा स्वयं" for the Spirit (8:16, 8:26)
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi. Respect for God and Christ comes from the honorific third person at every level, and the Spirit takes masculine agreement (style guide, sections 4, 6 and 7). The same through this chapter.

decisions.choice: "शारीरिक स्वभाव" where flesh means human nature under sin's sway (8:3-13); "शरीर" where it is the Son's human body (8:3)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "शरीर" for flesh through Romans. Readable says "शारीरिक स्वभाव" where the sense is moral (meaning decision m2), as in chapter 7, and "शरीर" where Paul means a human body.

decisions.choice: "тіло" for sarx (L, B); "грішна природа" (R) where the sense is moral
decisions.reason: Settled for Romans in the Ukrainian brief and kept through chapters 8-13. "Тіло" also renders soma (8:10, 8:11, 8:13), so the meaning decisions say which is meant; Readable separates them, saying "грішна природа" for the moral sense and "людське тіло" for the Son's human body (m3, m5).

decisions.choice: ходимо
decisions.reason: Literal keeps Paul's picture of walking; Balanced and Readable say how one lives (m7).

decisions.choice: "肉" (L, B); "罪に傾く人間の性質", shortened to "罪に傾く性質" after this (R)
decisions.reason: Flesh here is human nature in its weakness, under sin's sway (m2), not the body. Literal and Balanced keep the church word "肉"; Readable says what it means, as the style guide and the Romans terms do, and uses the shorter form through the rest of the chapter. Where the flesh is the Son's own human nature (m3, m5), Readable says "人間としての体" and "体", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "罪のためのささげ物として" (B, R); "罪のために" (L)
alternatives: "罪のためのいけにえとして"
decisions.reason: "For sin" is the Greek Old Testament's name for the sin offering (m4). Literal keeps the bare phrase; Balanced and Readable say what it names. "御子" is used for God's Son at every level, the usual respectful word.

source.text: οἱ γὰρ κατὰ σάρκα ὄντες τὰ τῆς σαρκὸς φρονοῦσιν, οἱ δὲ κατὰ πνεῦμα τὰ τοῦ πνεύματος.

records.literal_gloss: The [ones] for according to flesh being the [things] of the flesh set mind on, the [ones] but according to Spirit the [things] of the Spirit.

en.L: For those who are according to [the] flesh set [their] minds on the things of the flesh, but those [who are] according to [the] Spirit, on the things of the Spirit.
en.B: Those who are under the rule of the flesh have their minds fixed on the concerns of the flesh, but those under the rule of the Spirit, on the concerns of the Spirit.
en.R: People who live by their sinful selves think only about what their sinful selves want. But people who live by the Spirit think about what the Spirit wants.

es.L: Porque los que son según [la] carne ponen la mente en las cosas de la carne, pero los [que son] según [el] Espíritu, en las cosas del Espíritu.
es.B: Los que están bajo el dominio de la carne tienen la mente puesta en lo que interesa a la carne, pero los que están bajo el dominio del Espíritu, en lo que interesa al Espíritu.
es.R: Las personas que viven según su yo pecador solo piensan en lo que su yo pecador quiere. Pero las que viven según el Espíritu piensan en lo que el Espíritu quiere.

sw.L: Kwa maana wale walio kwa kadiri ya mwili huweka nia zao katika mambo ya mwili, lakini wale [walio] kwa kadiri ya Roho, katika mambo ya Roho.
sw.B: Wale walio chini ya utawala wa asili ya dhambi huelekeza mawazo yao kwenye mambo ya asili ya dhambi, lakini wale walio chini ya utawala wa Roho, kwenye mambo ya Roho.
sw.R: Watu wanaoishi kwa kufuata asili yao ya dhambi hufikiri tu juu ya yale ambayo asili yao ya dhambi inataka. Lakini watu wanaoishi kwa kufuata Roho hufikiri juu ya yale ambayo Roho anataka.

fr.L: Car ceux qui sont selon [la] chair pensent aux choses de la chair, mais ceux [qui sont] selon [l’]Esprit, aux choses de l’Esprit.
fr.B: Ceux qui sont sous l’emprise de la chair ont leurs pensées tournées vers ce qui concerne la chair, mais ceux qui sont sous la conduite de l’Esprit, vers ce qui concerne l’Esprit.
fr.R: Les gens qui vivent selon leur nature pécheresse ne pensent qu’à ce que veut leur nature pécheresse. Mais les gens qui vivent selon l’Esprit pensent à ce que veut l’Esprit.

ko.L: 육신을 따르는 사람들은 육신의 일들을 생각하고, 성령을 따르는 사람들은 성령의 일들을 [생각합니다].
ko.B: 육신의 지배를 받는 사람들은 육신의 일에 마음을 두고, 성령의 다스림을 받는 사람들은 성령의 일에 마음을 둡니다.
ko.R: 죄에 끌리는 본성을 따라 사는 사람들은 그 본성이 원하는 것만 생각합니다. 그러나 성령을 따라 사는 사람들은 성령께서 원하시는 것을 생각합니다.

vi.L: Vì những người theo xác thịt thì để tâm vào những điều thuộc về xác thịt, còn những người theo Thánh Linh thì [để tâm vào] những điều thuộc về Thánh Linh.
vi.B: Những người sống dưới sự cai trị của xác thịt thì chú tâm vào những điều xác thịt quan tâm, còn những người sống dưới sự cai trị của Thánh Linh thì chú tâm vào những điều Thánh Linh quan tâm.
vi.R: Những người sống theo bản tính tội lỗi thì chỉ nghĩ đến những gì bản tính tội lỗi muốn. Nhưng những người sống theo Thánh Linh thì nghĩ đến những gì Thánh Linh muốn.

pt.L: Pois os que são segundo a carne pensam nas coisas da carne, mas os [que são] segundo o Espírito, nas coisas do Espírito.
pt.B: Os que estão sob o domínio da carne têm a mente voltada para o que interessa à carne, mas os que estão sob o domínio do Espírito, para o que interessa ao Espírito.
pt.R: As pessoas que vivem pela sua natureza pecadora só pensam no que essa natureza quer. Mas as pessoas que vivem pelo Espírito pensam no que o Espírito quer.

am.L: እንደ ሥጋ ያሉት የሥጋን ነገር ያስባሉና፤ እንደ መንፈስ ያሉት ግን የመንፈስን ነገር [ያስባሉ]።
am.B: በሥጋ አገዛዝ ሥር ያሉ ሰዎች ሐሳባቸውን በሥጋ ጉዳዮች ላይ ያደርጋሉ፤ በመንፈስ አገዛዝ ሥር ያሉት ግን በመንፈስ ጉዳዮች ላይ ያደርጋሉ።
am.R: በኃጢአተኛው ማንነታቸው የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ኃጢአተኛው ማንነታቸው የሚፈልገውን ብቻ ያስባሉ። በመንፈስ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ግን መንፈስ የሚፈልገውን ያስባሉ።

ru.L: Ведь живущие по плоти думают о плотском, а [живущие] по Духу — о духовном.
ru.B: Те, кем управляет плоть, устремлены мыслями к тому, что нужно плоти, а те, кем управляет Дух, — к тому, что нужно Духу.
ru.R: Люди, которые живут по своей греховной природе, думают только о том, чего хочет эта природа. А люди, которые живут по Духу, думают о том, чего хочет Дух.

hi.L: क्योंकि जो शरीर के अनुसार हैं, वे शरीर की बातों पर मन लगाते हैं, परंतु जो आत्मा के अनुसार हैं, वे आत्मा की बातों पर।
hi.B: जो शरीर के वश में हैं, उनका मन शरीर की बातों पर लगा रहता है, पर जो आत्मा के वश में हैं, उनका मन आत्मा की बातों पर।
hi.R: जो लोग अपने शारीरिक स्वभाव के अनुसार जीते हैं, वे केवल उसी के बारे में सोचते हैं जो उनका शारीरिक स्वभाव चाहता है। पर जो लोग आत्मा के अनुसार जीते हैं, वे उसके बारे में सोचते हैं जो आत्मा चाहता है।

uk.L: Бо ті, хто є згідно з тілом, думають про те, що належить тілу, а ті, [хто] згідно з Духом, — про те, що належить Духові.
uk.B: Ті, ким править тіло, зосереджують свої думки на тому, чого прагне тіло, а ті, ким править Дух, — на тому, чого прагне Дух.
uk.R: Люди, які живуть за своєю грішною природою, думають лише про те, чого хоче їхня грішна природа. А люди, які живуть за Духом, думають про те, чого хоче Дух.

ja.L: というのは、肉に従っている者たちは肉のことを思い、霊に従っている者たちは霊のことを[思う]からです。
ja.B: 肉に支配されている人たちは肉のことに心を向け、霊に支配されている人たちは霊のことに心を向けます。
ja.R: 罪に傾く性質のままに生きる人たちは、その性質が求めることばかり考えます。しかし、聖霊に従って生きる人たちは、聖霊が望まれることを考えます。

decisions.choice: flesh: human nature under sin's sway, set against the Spirit
decisions.reason: In Romans 7-8 the flesh is human life in its weakness, under sin's sway and set against God's Spirit (7:5, 7:18, 7:25; Galatians 5:16-17). Paul does not mean the body as such, which God will give life to (verse 11).

decisions.choice: set the mind on: the whole bent of thought, will and desire
alternatives: think about, as a passing thought
decisions.reason: phroneō is not only thinking but what a person is set on and lives for, as in Philippians 3:19 ("their minds set on earthly things").

decisions.choice: being according to the flesh: having one's existence shaped and ruled by it
decisions.reason: Paul describes two kinds of people, those whose life is ruled by the flesh and those ruled by the Spirit. The second half of the verse leaves out the verbs, which carry over from the first.

decisions.choice: under the rule of
decisions.reason: Balanced says what "being according to" means (m3).

decisions.choice: their sinful selves
decisions.reason: Readable says what "flesh" means here (m1).

decisions.choice: chini ya utawala wa asili ya dhambi / wa Roho
alternatives: kwa kadiri ya asili ya dhambi
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced says "under the rule of", Swahili Balanced says "chini ya utawala wa", and keeps it where the Greek says "in the flesh" (verses 8-9), since both phrases name one way of existing with its ruling power (m3; 8:9 m2). Roho takes personal agreement ("Roho anataka"), never the agreement of a thing.

decisions.choice: "생각하다" (L); "마음을 두다" (B); "생각하다" (R) for the verb; "생각" (L) / "마음" (B) for the noun in verses 6-7
decisions.reason: The verb and its noun mean the whole bent of thought, will and desire (meaning decision). Balanced "마음을 두다" includes desire as well as thought; Literal keeps the plain "생각".

decisions.choice: "để tâm vào" (L); "chú tâm vào" (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the whole bent of thought, will and desire (m2). "Để tâm" and "chú tâm" say where the heart and mind are set, more than "suy nghĩ" (to think).

decisions.choice: греховная природа
decisions.reason: Readable says "греховная природа" where sarx means human nature under sin's sway (m1), as the style guide has it for 8:3-13.

decisions.choice: "思う" (L); "心を向ける" (B); and the noun "思い" in verses 6-7
decisions.reason: The verb is the whole bent of thought, will and desire (m2), not thinking alone. Balanced says where the heart is turned; Literal keeps "思う" so that the noun "思い" of verses 6-7 is seen to come from it.

source.text: τὸ γὰρ φρόνημα τῆς σαρκὸς θάνατος, τὸ δὲ φρόνημα τοῦ πνεύματος ζωὴ καὶ εἰρήνη·

records.literal_gloss: The for mindset of the flesh death, the but mindset of the Spirit life and peace;

en.L: For the mindset of the flesh [is] death, but the mindset of the Spirit [is] life and peace.
en.B: The outlook of the flesh means death, but the outlook of the Spirit means life and peace.
en.R: When the sinful self is in charge of what you think about, the end is death. When the Spirit is in charge, there is life and peace.

es.L: Porque la mentalidad de la carne [es] muerte, pero la mentalidad del Espíritu [es] vida y paz.
es.B: La manera de pensar de la carne significa muerte, pero la manera de pensar del Espíritu significa vida y paz.
es.R: Cuando el yo pecador manda en lo que uno piensa, el final es la muerte. Cuando el Espíritu manda, hay vida y paz.

sw.L: Kwa maana fikira za mwili [ni] kifo, lakini fikira za Roho [ni] uzima na amani.
sw.B: Mtazamo wa asili ya dhambi unaleta kifo, lakini mtazamo wa Roho unaleta uzima na amani.
sw.R: Asili ya dhambi ikitawala mawazo ya mtu, mwisho wake ni kifo. Roho akitawala, kuna uzima na amani.

fr.L: Car la pensée de la chair, [c’est] la mort, mais la pensée de l’Esprit, [c’est] la vie et la paix.
fr.B: La manière de penser de la chair, c’est la mort, mais la manière de penser de l’Esprit, c’est la vie et la paix.
fr.R: Quand c’est notre nature pécheresse qui dirige nos pensées, cela finit par la mort. Quand c’est l’Esprit qui les dirige, il y a la vie et la paix.

ko.L: 육신의 생각은 죽음이요, 성령의 생각은 생명과 평안입니다.
ko.B: 육신에 마음을 두면 죽음에 이르지만, 성령께 마음을 두면 생명과 평안을 누립니다.
ko.R: 죄에 끌리는 본성이 우리의 생각을 다스리면 그 끝은 죽음입니다. 그러나 성령께서 다스리시면 생명과 평안이 있습니다.

vi.L: Vì tâm trí của xác thịt [là] sự chết, còn tâm trí của Thánh Linh [là] sự sống và bình an.
vi.B: Lối suy nghĩ của xác thịt đưa đến sự chết, còn lối suy nghĩ của Thánh Linh đem lại sự sống và bình an.
vi.R: Khi bản tính tội lỗi điều khiển những gì anh chị em suy nghĩ, kết cuộc là sự chết. Khi Thánh Linh điều khiển, thì có sự sống và bình an.

pt.L: Pois a mentalidade da carne [é] morte, mas a mentalidade do Espírito [é] vida e paz.
pt.B: A maneira de pensar da carne significa morte, mas a maneira de pensar do Espírito significa vida e paz.
pt.R: Quando a natureza pecadora controla o que vocês pensam, o fim é a morte. Quando o Espírito está no controle, há vida e paz.

am.L: ምክንያቱም የሥጋ አስተሳሰብ ሞት [ነው]፤ የመንፈስ አስተሳሰብ ግን ሕይወትና ሰላም [ነው]።
am.B: የሥጋ አመለካከት ሞት ማለት ነው፤ የመንፈስ አመለካከት ግን ሕይወትና ሰላም ማለት ነው።
am.R: ኃጢአተኛው ማንነት የምታስቡትን ሲቆጣጠር መጨረሻው ሞት ነው። መንፈስ ሲቆጣጠር ግን ሕይወትና ሰላም አለ።

ru.L: Ведь помышление плоти — смерть, а помышление Духа — жизнь и мир.
ru.B: Образ мыслей плоти означает смерть, а образ мыслей Духа — жизнь и мир.
ru.R: Когда греховная природа управляет твоими мыслями, это кончается смертью. А когда управляет Дух, есть жизнь и мир.

hi.L: क्योंकि शरीर पर मन लगाना मृत्यु है, परंतु आत्मा पर मन लगाना जीवन और शान्ति है।
hi.B: शरीर की सोच का अर्थ मृत्यु है, पर आत्मा की सोच का अर्थ जीवन और शान्ति है।
hi.R: जब तुम्हारी सोच पर शारीरिक स्वभाव का अधिकार होता है, तो अंत मृत्यु है। जब आत्मा का अधिकार होता है, तो जीवन और शान्ति है।

uk.L: Бо мислення тіла — смерть, а мислення Духа — життя і мир.
uk.B: Устремління тіла означає смерть, а устремління Духа — життя і мир.
uk.R: Коли грішна природа керує твоїми думками, кінець — смерть. Коли ж керує Дух, є життя і мир.

ja.L: というのは、肉の思いは死[であって]、霊の思いは命と平和[だ]からです。
ja.B: 肉の思いが行き着くところは死ですが、霊の思いは命と平和をもたらします。
ja.R: 罪に傾く性質が考えることを決めていると、行き着く先は死です。聖霊が考えることを導いてくださるなら、そこには命と平和があります。

decisions.choice: mindset: the way of thinking and wanting that belongs to the flesh or to the Spirit
alternatives: the mind as a part of a person
decisions.reason: phronēma is the noun from the verb of verse 5: a settled way of thinking and desiring.

decisions.choice: death, life and peace: separation from God, and life with him
alternatives: physical death and long life only
decisions.reason: Death here is more than the end of the body: it is the wages of sin (6:23), being cut off from God now and at the end. Life is the life of the age to come, already begun (verse 10), and peace is peace with God (5:1) and the wholeness that follows from it.

decisions.choice: flesh: human nature under sin's sway
decisions.reason: In Romans 7-8 the flesh is human life in its weakness, under sin's sway and set against God's Spirit (7:5, 7:18, 7:25; Galatians 5:16-17). Paul does not mean the body as such, which God will give life to (verse 11).

decisions.choice: outlook
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "outlook" for a settled way of thinking and wanting (m1).

decisions.choice: when the sinful self is in charge of what you think about
decisions.reason: Readable says what "flesh" means (m3) and turns "the mindset of" into a plain clause.

decisions.choice: mentalidad (L); manera de pensar (B); lo que uno piensa (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the whole way of thinking and wanting that belongs to the flesh or to the Spirit (m1). "Mentalidad" and "manera de pensar" say that in current Spanish. Readable uses the impersonal "uno" for the English Readable's general "you", so it needs no ustedes/vosotros setting.

decisions.choice: fikira (L); mtazamo (B)
decisions.reason: The word is the whole bent of thinking and wanting (m1). "Fikira" (ways of thinking) keeps the link with "thinking" in verse 5; Balanced says "mtazamo" (outlook), as the English Balanced does. "Nia" (intention) would narrow it to the will.

decisions.choice: "la manière de penser"
decisions.reason: "État d'esprit" would bring the word "esprit" into a sentence about the Spirit. "Manière de penser" says a settled way of thinking and wanting.

decisions.choice: "평안" at every level
decisions.reason: Here peace is the state of the one whose mind belongs to the Spirit, set beside life, so the key-term word "평안" is used; "평화" was kept in 5:1 for peace between God and people.

decisions.choice: "tâm trí" (L); "lối suy nghĩ" (B) for this noun (also 8:7, 8:27)
decisions.reason: The noun is the way of thinking and wanting that belongs to the flesh or to the Spirit (m1). Literal says "tâm trí" (mind), Balanced "lối suy nghĩ" (way of thinking), as the English says "outlook".

decisions.choice: a mentalidade (L); a maneira de pensar (B)
decisions.reason: Both say a settled way of thinking and wanting (m1); "mentalidade" is the noun Portuguese uses for it, and Balanced spells it out, as the English says "outlook".

decisions.choice: помышление
decisions.reason: Literal keeps a single noun for phronema; the Synodal "мудрование" is obsolete. Balanced says "образ мыслей".

decisions.choice: мислення (L); устремління (B)
decisions.reason: phronēma is a whole bent of thinking and wanting (m1). "Мислення" keeps the link with the verb of 8:5 at Literal; "устремління" at Balanced says that it is a direction of the will as well as of thought. Kept through 8:6-8:7 and 8:27.

decisions.choice: "平和"
decisions.reason: The peace here is first peace with God (5:1) and the wholeness that comes from it (m2), so the Romans terms give "平和" rather than the inner calm of "平安".

source.text: διότι τὸ φρόνημα τῆς σαρκὸς ἔχθρα εἰς θεόν, τῷ γὰρ νόμῳ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐχ ὑποτάσσεται, οὐδὲ γὰρ δύναται·

records.literal_gloss: Because the mindset of the flesh hostility toward God, to the for law of the God not it submits, not even for it is able;

en.L: Because the mindset of the flesh [is] hostility toward God, for it does not submit to the law of God, nor indeed is it able [to].
en.B: That is because the outlook of the flesh is at war with God. It does not bow to God's law, and in fact it is not able to.
en.R: The sinful self is God's enemy. It refuses to obey God's law, and it could never obey it.

es.L: Porque la mentalidad de la carne [es] hostilidad hacia Dios, pues no se sujeta a la ley de Dios, y ni siquiera puede [hacerlo].
es.B: Eso es porque la manera de pensar de la carne está en guerra con Dios. No se somete a la ley de Dios, y de hecho no es capaz de hacerlo.
es.R: El yo pecador es enemigo de Dios. Se niega a obedecer la ley de Dios, y nunca podría obedecerla.

sw.L: Kwa sababu fikira za mwili [ni] uadui dhidi ya Mungu, kwa maana haziitii sheria ya Mungu, wala kwa kweli haziwezi.
sw.B: Hii ni kwa sababu mtazamo wa asili ya dhambi uko vitani na Mungu. Hautii sheria ya Mungu, na kwa kweli hauwezi kuitii.
sw.R: Asili ya dhambi ni adui wa Mungu. Inakataa kutii sheria ya Mungu, na haingeweza kamwe kuitii.

fr.L: Parce que la pensée de la chair [est] hostilité envers Dieu, car elle ne se soumet pas à la Loi de Dieu, et elle ne le peut même pas.
fr.B: C’est que la manière de penser de la chair est en guerre contre Dieu. Elle ne se soumet pas à la Loi de Dieu, et en fait, elle en est incapable.
fr.R: Notre nature pécheresse est l’ennemie de Dieu. Elle refuse d’obéir à la Loi de Dieu, et elle ne pourrait jamais lui obéir.

ko.L: 육신의 생각은 하나님께 원수가 되기 때문입니다. 그것은 하나님의 율법에 굴복하지 않고, 또 굴복할 수도 없습니다.
ko.B: 육신에 둔 마음은 하나님과 맞서 싸우기 때문입니다. 그것은 하나님의 율법에 복종하지 않으며, 사실은 복종할 수도 없습니다.
ko.R: 죄에 끌리는 본성은 하나님의 원수입니다. 그것은 하나님의 율법에 순종하려 하지 않고, 결코 순종할 수도 없습니다.

vi.L: Bởi vì tâm trí của xác thịt [là] thù nghịch với Đức Chúa Trời, vì nó không phục tùng luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời, và cũng không thể [phục tùng].
vi.B: Ấy là vì lối suy nghĩ của xác thịt thù nghịch với Đức Chúa Trời. Nó không chịu phục tùng luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời, và thật ra nó cũng không thể phục tùng được.
vi.R: Bản tính tội lỗi là kẻ thù của Đức Chúa Trời. Nó không chịu vâng theo luật pháp của Đức Chúa Trời, và nó cũng không bao giờ có thể vâng theo.

pt.L: Porque a mentalidade da carne [é] inimizade contra Deus, pois não se submete à Lei de Deus, nem mesmo pode [fazê-lo];
pt.B: Isso porque a maneira de pensar da carne está em guerra com Deus. Ela não se submete à Lei de Deus, e de fato nem consegue.
pt.R: A natureza pecadora é inimiga de Deus. Ela se recusa a obedecer à Lei de Deus, e nunca conseguiria obedecer.

am.L: ምክንያቱም የሥጋ አስተሳሰብ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ጠላትነት [ነው]፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ሕግ አይገዛምና፤ ሊገዛም አይችልም፤
am.B: ይህ የሆነው የሥጋ አመለካከት ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ጦርነት ላይ ስለ ሆነ ነው። ለእግዚአብሔር ሕግ አይንበረከክም፤ በእርግጥም ሊንበረከክ አይችልም።
am.R: ኃጢአተኛው ማንነት የእግዚአብሔር ጠላት ነው። የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ለመታዘዝ እምቢ ይላል፤ ደግሞም ፈጽሞ ሊታዘዘው አይችልም።

ru.L: Потому что помышление плоти — вражда против Бога, ведь Закону Бога оно не покоряется, да и не может.
ru.B: Потому что образ мыслей плоти воюет с Богом. Он не подчиняется Закону Бога, да и не может подчиниться.
ru.R: Греховная природа — враг Бога. Она отказывается слушаться Закона Бога и никогда не сможет его слушаться.

hi.L: क्योंकि शरीर पर मन लगाना परमेश्वर से बैर रखना है, क्योंकि वह परमेश्वर की व्यवस्था के अधीन नहीं होता, और न हो सकता है।
hi.B: इसका कारण यह है कि शरीर की सोच परमेश्वर से युद्ध में है। वह परमेश्वर की व्यवस्था के आगे नहीं झुकती, और वास्तव में झुक भी नहीं सकती।
hi.R: शारीरिक स्वभाव परमेश्वर का शत्रु है। वह परमेश्वर की व्यवस्था मानने से इनकार करता है, और वह उसे कभी मान भी नहीं सकता।

uk.L: Тому що мислення тіла — ворожнеча до Бога, бо Законові Божому воно не кориться, та й не може.
uk.B: Це тому, що устремління тіла воює з Богом. Воно не підкоряється Божому Законові, і насправді не здатне на це.
uk.R: Грішна природа — ворог Бога. Вона не хоче слухатися Божого Закону і ніколи не змогла б його слухатися.

ja.L: なぜなら、肉の思いは神に対する敵意[だ]からです。というのは、それは神の律法に服従せず、実に服従することもできないのです。
ja.B: それは、肉の思いが神に敵対しているからです。肉の思いは神の律法に従いません。実際、従うことができないのです。
ja.R: 罪に傾く性質は神の敵です。神の律法に従おうとはしませんし、決して従うこともできません。

decisions.choice: hostility: enmity, being an enemy
decisions.reason: echthra is the state of enemies at war. Paul has said that we were God's enemies before he reconciled us (5:10).

decisions.choice: the subject of "does not submit" and "is not able" is the mindset of the flesh
decisions.reason: The verbs are singular and continue from "the mindset of the flesh". Paul is not saying that people cannot ever turn to God; he says that the flesh, as such, will never submit to God's law.

decisions.choice: flesh: human nature under sin's sway
decisions.reason: In Romans 7-8 the flesh is human life in its weakness, under sin's sway and set against God's Spirit (7:5, 7:18, 7:25; Galatians 5:16-17). Paul does not mean the body as such, which God will give life to (verse 11).

decisions.choice: is at war with God (B); is God's enemy (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable keep the strength of the word for enmity (m1).

decisions.choice: the sinful self
decisions.reason: Readable says what "flesh" means (m3).

source.text: οἱ δὲ ἐν σαρκὶ ὄντες θεῷ ἀρέσαι οὐ δύνανται.

records.literal_gloss: The [ones] and in flesh being God to please not are able.

en.L: And those who are in [the] flesh are not able to please God.
en.B: People who are in the flesh have no power to please God.
en.R: People who are ruled by their sinful selves cannot do what pleases God.

es.L: Y los que están en [la] carne no son capaces de agradar a Dios.
es.B: Los que están en la carne no tienen poder para agradar a Dios.
es.R: Las personas dominadas por su yo pecador no pueden hacer lo que agrada a Dios.

sw.L: Na wale walio katika mwili hawawezi kumpendeza Mungu.
sw.B: Watu walio chini ya utawala wa asili ya dhambi hawana uwezo wa kumpendeza Mungu.
sw.R: Watu wanaotawaliwa na asili yao ya dhambi hawawezi kufanya yale yanayompendeza Mungu.

fr.L: Et ceux qui sont dans [la] chair ne peuvent pas plaire à Dieu.
fr.B: Ceux qui sont dans la chair n’ont pas le pouvoir de plaire à Dieu.
fr.R: Les gens qui sont dirigés par leur nature pécheresse ne peuvent pas faire ce qui plaît à Dieu.

ko.L: 육신 안에 있는 사람들은 하나님을 기쁘시게 할 수 없습니다.
ko.B: 육신 안에 있는 사람들은 하나님을 기쁘시게 할 힘이 없습니다.
ko.R: 죄에 끌리는 본성의 다스림을 받는 사람들은 하나님께서 기뻐하시는 일을 할 수 없습니다.

vi.L: Và những người ở trong xác thịt không thể làm vui lòng Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Những người ở trong xác thịt không có khả năng làm vui lòng Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Những người bị bản tính tội lỗi cai trị thì không thể làm điều đẹp lòng Đức Chúa Trời.

pt.L: E os que estão na carne não podem agradar a Deus.
pt.B: As pessoas que estão na carne não têm condições de agradar a Deus.
pt.R: As pessoas dominadas pela sua natureza pecadora não conseguem fazer o que agrada a Deus.

am.L: በሥጋ ያሉትም እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ሊያሰኙ አይችሉም።
am.B: በሥጋ ያሉ ሰዎች እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ለማሰኘት አቅም የላቸውም።
am.R: በኃጢአተኛው ማንነታቸው የሚገዙ ሰዎች እግዚአብሔርን ደስ የሚያሰኘውን ማድረግ አይችሉም።

ru.L: А находящиеся во плоти не могут угодить Богу.
ru.B: Те, кто во плоти, не в силах угодить Богу.
ru.R: Люди, которыми управляет их греховная природа, не могут делать то, что угодно Богу.

hi.L: और जो शरीर में हैं, वे परमेश्वर को प्रसन्न नहीं कर सकते।
hi.B: जो लोग शरीर में हैं, उनमें परमेश्वर को प्रसन्न करने की शक्ति नहीं।
hi.R: जिन लोगों पर उनके शारीरिक स्वभाव का शासन है, वे वह नहीं कर सकते जिससे परमेश्वर प्रसन्न होते हैं।

uk.L: А ті, хто є в тілі, Богові догодити не можуть.
uk.B: Люди, які перебувають у тілі, не мають сили догодити Богові.
uk.R: Люди, якими керує їхня грішна природа, не можуть робити того, що подобається Богові.

ja.L: また、肉にある者たちは、神を喜ばせることができません。
ja.B: 肉の中にいる人たちは、神に喜んでいただくことができません。
ja.R: 罪に傾く性質に支配されている人たちは、神が喜ばれることをすることができません。

decisions.choice: in the flesh: in the old state ruled by sin
decisions.reason: Paul said "when we were in the flesh" of the life before Christ (7:5). He still lives in a body (Galatians 2:20), so "in the flesh" here is the state of life ruled by sin, not having a body.

decisions.choice: please God: be acceptable to him, do what he approves
decisions.reason: areskō is to please someone, to win their approval, as in 1 Thessalonians 4:1.

decisions.choice: ruled by their sinful selves
decisions.reason: Readable says what "in the flesh" means (m1).

source.text: Ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐκ ἐστὲ ἐν σαρκὶ ἀλλὰ ἐν πνεύματι, εἴπερ πνεῦμα θεοῦ οἰκεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: You but not are in flesh but in Spirit, if indeed Spirit of God dwells in you.

en.L: But you are not in [the] flesh but in [the] Spirit, if indeed [the] Spirit of God dwells in you.
en.B: But you are not in the flesh; you are in the Spirit, if God's Spirit really does live in you.
en.R: But you are not ruled by your sinful selves. The Spirit rules you, if God's Spirit really lives in you.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes no están|vosotros no estáis}} en [la] carne sino en [el] Espíritu, si en verdad [el] Espíritu de Dios habita en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes no están|vosotros no estáis}} en la carne; {{plural_you:están|estáis}} en el Espíritu, si de verdad el Espíritu de Dios vive en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Pero a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no {{plural_you:los|os}} domina {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} yo pecador. El Espíritu {{plural_you:los|os}} gobierna, si de verdad el Espíritu de Dios vive en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

sw.L: Lakini ninyi hamko katika mwili bali katika Roho, kama kweli Roho wa Mungu anaishi ndani yenu.
sw.B: Lakini ninyi hamko chini ya utawala wa asili ya dhambi; mko chini ya utawala wa Roho, ikiwa kweli Roho wa Mungu amefanya makao ndani yenu.
sw.R: Lakini ninyi hamtawaliwi na asili yenu ya dhambi. Roho ndiye anayewatawala, ikiwa kweli Roho wa Mungu anaishi ndani yenu.

fr.L: Mais vous, vous n’êtes pas dans [la] chair mais dans [l’]Esprit, si du moins [l’]Esprit de Dieu habite en vous.
fr.B: Mais vous, vous n’êtes pas dans la chair ; vous êtes dans l’Esprit, si vraiment l’Esprit de Dieu habite en vous.
fr.R: Mais vous, votre nature pécheresse ne vous dirige plus. C’est l’Esprit qui vous dirige, si l’Esprit de Dieu vit vraiment en vous.

ko.L: 그러나 여러분은 육신 안에 있지 않고 성령 안에 있습니다. 하나님의 영이 여러분 안에 사신다면 말입니다.
ko.B: 그러나 여러분은 육신 안에 있지 않고 성령 안에 있습니다. 하나님의 영께서 정말로 여러분 안에 사신다면 말입니다.
ko.R: 그러나 여러분은 죄에 끌리는 본성의 다스림을 받지 않습니다. 성령께서 여러분을 다스리십니다. 하나님의 영께서 정말로 여러분 안에 살고 계신다면 말입니다.

vi.L: Nhưng anh chị em không ở trong xác thịt mà ở trong Thánh Linh, nếu thật Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời ngự trong anh chị em.
vi.B: Nhưng anh chị em không ở trong xác thịt; anh chị em ở trong Thánh Linh, nếu Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời thật sự ngự trong anh chị em.
vi.R: Nhưng anh chị em không bị bản tính tội lỗi cai trị. Thánh Linh cai trị anh chị em, nếu Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời thật sự sống trong anh chị em.

pt.L: Vocês, porém, não estão na carne, mas no Espírito, se de fato [o] Espírito de Deus habita em vocês.
pt.B: Mas vocês não estão na carne; vocês estão no Espírito, se o Espírito de Deus realmente mora em vocês.
pt.R: Mas vocês não são dominados pela natureza pecadora. O Espírito domina vocês, se o Espírito de Deus de fato mora em vocês.

am.L: እናንተ ግን በሥጋ አይደላችሁም፤ በመንፈስ እንጂ፤ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በእውነት በእናንተ የሚኖር ከሆነ።
am.B: እናንተ ግን የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በእርግጥ በእናንተ ውስጥ የሚኖር ከሆነ በሥጋ አይደላችሁም፤ በመንፈስ ናችሁ።
am.R: እናንተ ግን በኃጢአተኛው ማንነታችሁ አትገዙም። የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በእውነት በእናንተ ውስጥ የሚኖር ከሆነ የሚገዛችሁ መንፈስ ነው።

ru.L: Но вы не во плоти, но в Духе, если только Дух Бога живёт в вас.
ru.B: Но вы не во плоти; вы в Духе, если Дух Бога действительно живёт в вас.
ru.R: Но вами управляет не ваша греховная природа. Вами управляет Дух, если Дух Бога действительно живёт в вас.

hi.L: परंतु तुम शरीर में नहीं, पर आत्मा में हो, यदि परमेश्वर का आत्मा सचमुच तुममें बसता है।
hi.B: पर तुम शरीर में नहीं हो; तुम आत्मा में हो, यदि परमेश्वर का आत्मा सचमुच तुममें रहता है।
hi.R: पर तुम पर तुम्हारे शारीरिक स्वभाव का शासन नहीं है। तुम पर आत्मा का शासन है, यदि परमेश्वर का आत्मा सचमुच तुममें रहता है।

uk.L: Ви ж не в тілі, а в Дусі, якщо справді Дух Божий живе у вас.
uk.B: Але ви не в тілі, ви в Дусі, якщо Божий Дух справді живе у вас.
uk.R: Але вами не керує ваша грішна природа. Вами керує Дух, якщо Божий Дух справді живе у вас.

ja.L: しかし、あなたがたは肉にあるのではなく、霊にあるのです。もし本当に、神の霊があなたがたのうちに住んでおられるのなら[ですが]。
ja.B: しかし、あなたがたは肉の中にいるのではなく、霊の中にいます。神の霊が本当にあなたがたのうちに住んでおられるなら、そうなのです。
ja.R: しかし、みなさんは罪に傾く性質に支配されてはいません。聖霊がみなさんを導いておられます。その聖霊が本当にみなさんのうちに住んでおられるなら、そうなのです。

decisions.choice: if indeed: a condition Paul assumes is met, with a gentle check
decisions.reason: eiper ("if indeed") assumes the readers do have the Spirit, while reminding them that this is what being in the Spirit depends on. Paul uses it again in verse 17.

decisions.choice: in the flesh, in the Spirit: two ways of existing, each with its ruling power
decisions.reason: As in verse 8, "in the flesh" is the old life ruled by sin; "in the Spirit" is the new life where God's Spirit lives and rules.

decisions.choice: dwells: lives in, makes a home in
decisions.reason: oikeō is to live in a house. Paul pictures the Spirit at home in the believer, as God dwelt among his people (1 Corinthians 3:16).

decisions.choice: ruled by your sinful selves; the Spirit rules you
decisions.reason: Readable says what the two phrases mean (m2).

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: The first plural "you" of the chapter. As through Romans, each plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting: ustedes (the default) or vosotros.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 영" with the honorific ("사신다", "하나님의 영께서"); "살다" for dwell, as in 7:17
decisions.reason: The Spirit of God is the Holy Spirit, so the verb takes -시- as for God and Christ. "거하다" and "내주하다" are church words; "살다" is plain and keeps the link with sin "living" in the speaker in 7:17-20, which the Spirit now replaces.

decisions.choice: "ngự" (L, B); "sống" (R) for the Spirit dwelling (also 8:11)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of sin in 7:17-20, to live in, make a home in (m3). For God's Spirit Vietnamese uses the respectful "ngự", said of God dwelling among his people; "cư ngụ" stays for sin.

decisions.choice: the condition after the statement: "……のなら[ですが]" (L); "……なら、そうなのです" (B, R)
alternatives: the condition first, as Japanese usually orders it
decisions.reason: Paul states the fact and then adds the gentle check (m1). Japanese would usually put the condition first, but that would make it sound like a doubt; adding it afterward keeps Paul's order and tone.

source.text: εἰ δέ τις πνεῦμα Χριστοῦ οὐκ ἔχει, οὗτος οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: If but anyone Spirit of Christ not has, this [one] not is of him.

en.L: But if anyone does not have [the] Spirit of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, this [one] is not {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}.
en.B: If anyone lacks the Spirit of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, that person is not {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}.
en.R: Anyone who does not have the Spirit of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is not one of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.

es.L: Y si alguien no tiene [el] Espíritu {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, este no es {{deity_pronoun:suyo|Suyo}}.
es.B: Si alguien carece del Espíritu {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, esa persona no {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenece.
es.R: Quien no tiene el Espíritu {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} no es parte de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.

sw.L: Lakini ikiwa mtu yeyote hana Roho wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, huyo si {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Ikiwa mtu hana Roho wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, mtu huyo si {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Mtu asiye na Roho wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} si mmoja wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

fr.L: Mais si quelqu’un n’a pas [l’]Esprit du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, celui-là n’est pas à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un n’a pas l’Esprit du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, il ne {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartient pas.
fr.R: Celui qui n’a pas l’Esprit du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ne fait pas partie de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.

ko.L: 누구든지 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 영이 없으면, 그 사람은 그분의 [사람이] 아닙니다.
ko.B: 누구든지 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 영을 모시고 있지 않으면, 그 사람은 그분께 속한 사람이 아닙니다.
ko.R: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 영을 모시고 있지 않은 사람은 그분의 백성이 아닙니다.

vi.L: Nhưng nếu ai không có Thánh Linh của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, người ấy không thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Nếu ai không có Thánh Linh của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, người ấy không thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ai không có Thánh Linh của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} thì không phải là người thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: Mas, se alguém não tem [o] Espírito {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, esse não é {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.
pt.B: Se alguém não tem o Espírito {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, essa pessoa não pertence a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.R: Quem não tem o Espírito {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} não faz parte do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo.

am.L: ማንም {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} መንፈስ ከሌለው ግን ይህ [ሰው] የእርሱ አይደለም።
am.B: ማንም {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} መንፈስ ከሌለው ያ ሰው የእርሱ አይደለም።
am.R: {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} መንፈስ የሌለው ሰው ሁሉ ከሕዝቡ አንዱ አይደለም።

ru.L: Если же кто не имеет Духа {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}, тот не {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Если у кого-то нет Духа {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}, этот человек не принадлежит {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.
ru.R: Тот, у кого нет Духа {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}, не из {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} народа.

hi.L: परंतु यदि किसी में मसीह का आत्मा नहीं, तो वह उनका नहीं।
hi.B: यदि किसी के पास मसीह का आत्मा नहीं है, तो वह व्यक्ति उनका नहीं है।
hi.R: जिसके पास मसीह का आत्मा नहीं है, वह उनके लोगों में से नहीं है।

uk.L: А якщо хтось Духа {{christos:Христового|Месії}} не має, той не {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}.
uk.B: Якщо в когось немає Духа {{christos:Христового|Месії}}, ця людина не належить {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}.
uk.R: Хто не має Духа {{christos:Христового|Месії}}, той не належить до {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} людей.

ja.L: もしだれかが{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の霊を持っていないなら、その人はその方のもの[では]ありません。
ja.B: {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の霊を持っていない人がいるなら、その人は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}のものではありません。
ja.R: {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の霊を持っていない人は、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}に属する人ではありません。

decisions.choice: the Spirit of God is the Spirit of Christ
alternatives: a different spirit, such as Christ's attitude
decisions.reason: In one breath Paul calls the same Spirit "the Spirit of God" and "the Spirit of Christ" (verses 9-11), as in Galatians 4:6 ("the Spirit of his Son"). The Spirit belongs to the Father and to the Son.

decisions.choice: his: Christ's
decisions.reason: The pronoun points back to Christ, just named: whoever lacks his Spirit does not belong to him.

decisions.choice: "その方の" (L); the name repeated (B, R)
decisions.reason: The pronoun points to Christ (m2). Japanese does not use "彼" for Christ or God, so Literal says "その方" and Balanced and Readable repeat the name.

source.text: εἰ δὲ Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν, τὸ μὲν σῶμα νεκρὸν διὰ ἁμαρτίαν, τὸ δὲ πνεῦμα ζωὴ διὰ δικαιοσύνην.

records.literal_gloss: If but Christ in you, the indeed body dead because of sin, the but Spirit life because of righteousness.

en.L: But if {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} [is] in you, the body [is] dead because of sin, but the Spirit [is] life because of righteousness.
en.B: But if {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is in you, the body is marked for death because of sin, but the Spirit is life for you because of righteousness.
en.R: But if {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} lives in you, your body will still die because of sin. But the Spirit gives you life, because of the righteousness God has given you.

es.L: Pero si {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} [está] en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, el cuerpo [está] muerto debido al pecado, pero el Espíritu [es] vida debido a [la] justicia.
es.B: Pero si {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} está en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, el cuerpo está destinado a la muerte por el pecado, pero el Espíritu es vida para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} por la justicia.
