es.R: Pero si {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} vive en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo de todos modos morirá a causa del pecado. Pero el Espíritu {{plural_you:les|os}} da vida, por la justicia que Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} ha dado.

sw.L: Lakini ikiwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} [yumo] ndani yenu, mwili [ni] mfu kwa sababu ya dhambi, lakini Roho [ni] uzima kwa sababu ya haki.
sw.B: Lakini ikiwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} yuko ndani yenu, mwili umeandikiwa kufa kwa sababu ya dhambi, lakini Roho ni uzima kwenu kwa sababu ya haki.
sw.R: Lakini ikiwa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} anaishi ndani yenu, miili yenu bado itakufa kwa sababu ya dhambi. Lakini Roho anawapa uzima, kwa sababu ya haki ambayo Mungu amewapa.

fr.L: Mais si {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} [est] en vous, le corps [est] mort à cause du péché, mais l’Esprit [est] vie à cause de la justice.
fr.B: Mais si {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} est en vous, le corps est voué à la mort à cause du péché, mais l’Esprit est vie pour vous à cause de la justice.
fr.R: Mais si {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} vit en vous, votre corps va quand même mourir à cause du péché. Mais l’Esprit vous donne la vie, à cause de la justice que Dieu vous a donnée.

ko.L: 그러나 만일 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여러분 안에 [계시면], 몸은 죄 때문에 죽은 것이지만, 영은 의 때문에 생명입니다.
ko.B: 그러나 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여러분 안에 계시면, 몸은 죄 때문에 죽을 수밖에 없지만, 성령께서는 의 때문에 여러분에게 생명이 되십니다.
ko.R: 그러나 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여러분 안에 살고 계시면, 여러분의 몸은 죄 때문에 여전히 죽을 것입니다. 그러나 하나님께서 주신 의 때문에 성령께서 여러분에게 생명을 주십니다.

vi.L: Nhưng nếu {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} [ở] trong anh chị em, thì thân thể [là] chết vì tội lỗi, nhưng Thánh Linh [là] sự sống vì sự công chính.
vi.B: Nhưng nếu {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} ở trong anh chị em, thì dù thân thể phải chết vì tội lỗi, Thánh Linh vẫn là sự sống cho anh chị em vì sự công chính.
vi.R: Nhưng nếu {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} sống trong anh chị em, thì thân thể anh chị em vẫn sẽ chết vì tội lỗi. Nhưng Thánh Linh ban sự sống cho anh chị em, vì sự công chính mà Đức Chúa Trời đã ban cho anh chị em.

pt.L: Mas, se {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} [está] em vocês, o corpo [está] morto por causa do pecado, mas o Espírito [é] vida por causa da justiça.
pt.B: Mas, se {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} está em vocês, o corpo está destinado à morte por causa do pecado, mas o Espírito é vida para vocês por causa da justiça.
pt.R: Mas, se {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} vive em vocês, o corpo de vocês ainda vai morrer por causa do pecado. Mas o Espírito dá vida a vocês, por causa da justiça que Deus deu a vocês.

am.L: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በእናንተ ውስጥ ከሆነ ግን፣ አካል በኃጢአት ምክንያት ሙት [ነው]፤ መንፈስ ግን በጽድቅ ምክንያት ሕይወት [ነው]።
am.B: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በእናንተ ውስጥ ካለ ግን፣ አካል በኃጢአት ምክንያት ለሞት የተወሰነ ነው፤ መንፈስ ግን በጽድቅ ምክንያት ሕይወት ይሆንላችኋል።
am.R: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በእናንተ ውስጥ የሚኖር ከሆነ ግን፣ አካላችሁ በኃጢአት ምክንያት አሁንም ይሞታል። መንፈስ ግን እግዚአብሔር በሰጣችሁ ጽድቅ ምክንያት ሕይወት ይሰጣችኋል።

ru.L: Если же {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} в вас, то тело мертво из-за греха, а Дух — жизнь из-за праведности.
ru.B: Но если {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} в вас, то тело обречено смерти из-за греха, а Дух — жизнь для вас из-за праведности.
ru.R: Но если {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} живёт в вас, ваше тело всё равно умрёт из-за греха. Но Дух даёт вам жизнь из-за праведности, которую дал вам Бог.

hi.L: परंतु यदि मसीह तुममें हैं, तो देह पाप के कारण मरी हुई है, परंतु आत्मा धार्मिकता के कारण जीवन है।
hi.B: पर यदि मसीह तुममें हैं, तो देह पाप के कारण मृत्यु के लिए ठहराई गई है, पर आत्मा धार्मिकता के कारण तुम्हारे लिए जीवन है।
hi.R: पर यदि मसीह तुममें रहते हैं, तो पाप के कारण तुम्हारा शरीर फिर भी मरेगा। पर आत्मा तुम्हें जीवन देता है, उस धार्मिकता के कारण जो परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें दी है।

uk.L: А якщо {{christos:Христос|Месія}} у вас, то тіло мертве через гріх, а Дух — життя через праведність.
uk.B: Але якщо {{christos:Христос|Месія}} у вас, то тіло приречене на смерть через гріх, а Дух — це життя для вас через праведність.
uk.R: Але якщо {{christos:Христос|Месія}} живе у вас, ваше тіло все одно помре через гріх. Та Дух дає вам життя завдяки праведності, яку дав вам Бог.

ja.L: しかし、もし{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}があなたがたのうちに[おられる]なら、体は罪のゆえに死んで[います]が、霊は義のゆえに命[です]。
ja.B: しかし、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}があなたがたのうちにおられるなら、体は罪のために死ぬべきものですが、霊は義のゆえに、あなたがたの命となっています。
ja.R: しかし、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}がみなさんのうちに生きておられるなら、みなさんの体は、罪のためにやはり死にます。けれども聖霊は、みなさんに命を与えてくださいます。神がみなさんを正しい者と認めてくださったからです。

decisions.choice: the Spirit, God's Spirit, is life
decisions.reason: pneuma could be the believer's own spirit, alive while the body dies. But Paul writes "life", a noun, not "alive", and in verses 2, 6 and 11 it is God's Spirit who gives life. So the sense is most likely that the Spirit is life for the believer.

decisions.choice: the body is dead: mortal, bound to die because of sin
decisions.reason: Verse 11 calls the same bodies "mortal". Since Adam, death came to all because of sin (5:12), and believers' bodies still die; but God will give them life.

decisions.choice: because of righteousness: God's gift of right standing with him
alternatives: the righteous life the Spirit produces
decisions.reason: In Romans righteousness is above all what God gives in Christ, the right standing of 5:17 and 5:21 ("grace reigning through righteousness to eternal life"). It may include the righteous life that follows (6:18), but the contrast with "because of sin" points to God's verdict.

decisions.choice: Christ in you: the same as the Spirit dwelling in you
decisions.reason: Paul moves from "the Spirit of God dwells in you" to "Christ in you" without a break. Christ lives in believers by his Spirit.

decisions.choice: marked for death
decisions.reason: Balanced says what "dead" means here (m2): the body is bound to die, not already a corpse.

decisions.choice: the righteousness God has given you
decisions.reason: Readable says whose righteousness it is (m3).

decisions.choice: umeandikiwa kufa
decisions.reason: The body is not yet dead but bound to die because of sin (m2). "Kuandikiwa" (to be destined) says this as the English Balanced "marked for death" does; Literal keeps the bare adjective "mfu".

decisions.choice: "영" (L); "성령께서" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads this as God's Spirit, who is life, and footnotes the reading "your spirit is alive". Literal keeps the bare "영", which allows both; Balanced and Readable follow the meaning decision with "성령" and the honorific.

decisions.choice: "Thánh Linh", capitalised, at every level
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads this as God's Spirit, who is life, with a footnote for the human spirit. Vietnamese must choose between "Thánh Linh" and "tâm linh" (the human spirit, 8:16), and follows the meaning decision.

decisions.choice: Дух, with a capital
decisions.reason: The meaning decision (m1) reads this as God's Spirit, the life-giver, so it is capitalised at every level.

decisions.choice: "देह" for the body (soma) at Literal and Balanced, as through Romans 6-8
decisions.reason: Paul sets the body beside the flesh here, and Literal and Balanced say "शरीर" for flesh, so they say "देह" for the body, as in 6:6-7:24, and the two Greek words stay apart (also 8:11, 8:13, 8:23). Readable, which says "शारीरिक स्वभाव" for flesh, keeps "शरीर" for the body.

decisions.choice: "義" (L, B); "神がみなさんを正しい者と認めてくださった" (R)
decisions.reason: Righteousness here is God's gift of right standing (m3). The Romans terms keep "義" at Literal and Balanced and let Readable say what God has done; the verb is the one Readable uses for "justify" in verses 30 and 33.

decisions.choice: "死ぬべきもの"
decisions.reason: The body is mortal, bound to die, not already a corpse (m2); Balanced says so, and uses the same word for "mortal" in verse 11.

source.text: εἰ δὲ τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ ἐγείραντος τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐκ νεκρῶν οἰκεῖ ἐν ὑμῖν, ὁ ἐγείρας ἐκ νεκρῶν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν ζῳοποιήσει καὶ τὰ θνητὰ σώματα ὑμῶν διὰ τὸ ἐνοικοῦν αὐτοῦ πνεῦμα ἐν ὑμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: If and the Spirit of the [one] having raised Jesus out of dead dwells in you, the [one] having raised out of dead Christ Jesus will give life also to the mortal bodies of you because of the dwelling of him Spirit in you.

en.L: And if the Spirit of the one who raised Jesus from [the] dead dwells in you, the one who raised {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus from [the] dead will give life also to your mortal bodies because of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit who dwells in you.
en.B: And if the Spirit of the one who raised Jesus from the dead has made a home in you, then God, who raised {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus from the dead, will bring your mortal bodies to life as well, because {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit lives in you.
en.R: God raised Jesus from death. If God's Spirit lives in you, then God, who raised {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus from death, will also give life to your bodies, which now must die. He will do this because {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit lives in you.

es.L: Y si el Espíritu del que resucitó a Jesús de entre [los] muertos habita en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, el que resucitó {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}} de entre [los] muertos dará vida también a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cuerpos mortales a causa de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu que habita en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Y si el Espíritu de aquel que resucitó a Jesús de entre los muertos ha hecho morada en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, entonces Dios, que resucitó {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}} de entre los muertos, dará vida también a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cuerpos mortales, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu vive en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: Dios resucitó a Jesús de la muerte. Si el Espíritu de Dios vive en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, entonces Dios, que resucitó {{christos:a Cristo Jesús|al Mesías Jesús}} de la muerte, también dará vida a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cuerpos, que ahora tienen que morir. Lo hará porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu vive en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

sw.L: Na ikiwa Roho wa yule aliyemfufua Yesu kutoka kwa wafu anaishi ndani yenu, yule aliyemfufua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kutoka kwa wafu ataipa uzima pia miili yenu inayokufa kwa sababu ya Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} anayeishi ndani yenu.
sw.B: Na ikiwa Roho wa yule aliyemfufua Yesu kutoka kwa wafu amefanya makao ndani yenu, basi Mungu, aliyemfufua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kutoka kwa wafu, ataipa uzima pia miili yenu inayokufa, kwa sababu Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} anaishi ndani yenu.
sw.R: Mungu alimfufua Yesu kutoka kwa wafu. Ikiwa Roho wa Mungu anaishi ndani yenu, basi Mungu, aliyemfufua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kutoka kwa wafu, ataipa uzima pia miili yenu, ambayo sasa ni lazima ife. Atafanya hivyo kwa sababu Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} anaishi ndani yenu.

fr.L: Et si l’Esprit de celui qui a ressuscité Jésus d’entre [les] morts habite en vous, celui qui a ressuscité d’entre [les] morts le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus donnera aussi la vie à vos corps mortels à cause de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit qui habite en vous.
fr.B: Et si l’Esprit de celui qui a ressuscité Jésus d’entre les morts demeure en vous, alors Dieu, qui a ressuscité d’entre les morts le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus, rendra aussi la vie à vos corps mortels, parce que {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit habite en vous.
fr.R: Dieu a ressuscité Jésus de la mort. Si l’Esprit de Dieu vit en vous, alors Dieu, qui a ressuscité de la mort le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus, donnera aussi la vie à vos corps, qui maintenant doivent mourir. Il le fera parce que {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Esprit vit en vous.

ko.L: 그리고 만일 예수를 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리신 분의 영이 여러분 안에 사시면, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리신 분께서 여러분 안에 사시는 그분의 영 때문에 여러분의 죽을 몸도 살리실 것입니다.
ko.B: 예수를 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리신 분의 영께서 여러분 안에 사시면, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리신 하나님께서 여러분 안에 사시는 그분의 영으로 말미암아 여러분의 죽을 몸도 살리실 것입니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 예수를 죽은 사람들 가운데서 살리셨습니다. 그 하나님의 영께서 여러분 안에 살고 계시면, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} 예수를 살리신 하나님께서 언젠가 죽을 여러분의 몸도 살리실 것입니다. 하나님께서 이렇게 하시는 것은 그분의 영께서 여러분 안에 살고 계시기 때문입니다.

vi.L: Và nếu Thánh Linh của Đấng đã khiến Đức Giê-xu sống lại từ kẻ chết ngự trong anh chị em, thì Đấng đã khiến {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} Giê-xu sống lại từ kẻ chết cũng sẽ ban sự sống cho thân thể hay chết của anh chị em, vì Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự trong anh chị em.
vi.B: Và nếu Thánh Linh của Đấng đã khiến Đức Giê-xu sống lại từ cõi chết đang ngự trong anh chị em, thì Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng đã khiến Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} sống lại từ cõi chết, cũng sẽ ban sự sống cho thân thể hay chết của anh chị em, vì Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang ngự trong anh chị em.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến Đức Giê-xu sống lại từ cõi chết. Nếu Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời sống trong anh chị em, thì Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng đã khiến Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} sống lại từ cõi chết, cũng sẽ ban sự sống cho thân thể anh chị em, là thân thể bây giờ phải chết. Ngài sẽ làm điều này vì Thánh Linh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống trong anh chị em.

pt.L: E, se o Espírito daquele que ressuscitou Jesus dentre [os] mortos habita em vocês, aquele que ressuscitou {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} Jesus dentre [os] mortos dará vida também aos corpos mortais de vocês, por causa do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Espírito que habita em vocês.
pt.B: E, se o Espírito daquele que ressuscitou Jesus dentre os mortos fez sua morada em vocês, então Deus, que ressuscitou {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus dentre os mortos, também dará vida aos corpos mortais de vocês, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Espírito vive em vocês.
pt.R: Deus ressuscitou Jesus. Se o Espírito de Deus mora em vocês, então Deus, que ressuscitou {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} Jesus, também vai dar vida ao corpo de vocês, que agora tem de morrer. Ele vai fazer isso porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Espírito mora em vocês.

am.L: ኢየሱስን ከሙታን ያስነሣው [የእርሱ] መንፈስ በእናንተ የሚኖር ከሆነ፣ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ኢየሱስን ከሙታን ያስነሣው በእናንተ በሚኖረው በመንፈሱ ምክንያት ለሟች አካላችሁ ደግሞ ሕይወትን ይሰጣል።
am.B: ኢየሱስን ከሙታን ያስነሣው የእርሱ መንፈስ በእናንተ ውስጥ መኖሪያውን ካደረገ፣ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ኢየሱስን ከሙታን ያስነሣው እግዚአብሔር፣ መንፈሱ በእናንተ ውስጥ ስለሚኖር፣ ሟች አካላችሁንም ደግሞ ሕያው ያደርጋል።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ኢየሱስን ከሞት አስነሣው። የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ በእናንተ ውስጥ የሚኖር ከሆነ፣ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ኢየሱስን ከሞት ያስነሣው እግዚአብሔር አሁን መሞት ላለበት አካላችሁም ደግሞ ሕይወትን ይሰጣል። ይህን የሚያደርገው መንፈሱ በእናንተ ውስጥ ስለሚኖር ነው።

ru.L: Если же Дух Воскресившего Иисуса из мёртвых живёт в вас, то Воскресивший {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} Иисуса из мёртвых оживит и ваши смертные тела через {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} Духа, живущего в вас.
ru.B: И если Дух того, кто воскресил Иисуса из мёртвых, поселился в вас, то Бог, воскресивший {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} Иисуса из мёртвых, оживит и ваши смертные тела, потому что {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} Дух живёт в вас.
ru.R: Бог воскресил Иисуса из мёртвых. Если Дух Бога живёт в вас, то Бог, который воскресил {{christos:Христа|Мессию}} Иисуса из мёртвых, даст жизнь и вашим телам, которые теперь должны умереть. Он сделает это, потому что {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} Дух живёт в вас.

hi.L: और यदि उनका आत्मा, जिन्होंने यीशु को मरे हुओं में से जिलाया, तुममें बसता है, तो जिन्होंने मसीह यीशु को मरे हुओं में से जिलाया, वे तुम्हारी नश्वर देहों को भी अपने उस आत्मा के कारण जो तुममें बसता है, जीवन देंगे।
hi.B: और यदि उनका आत्मा, जिन्होंने यीशु को मरे हुओं में से जिलाया, तुममें अपना घर बना चुका है, तो परमेश्वर, जिन्होंने मसीह यीशु को मरे हुओं में से जिलाया, तुम्हारी नश्वर देहों को भी जीवित करेंगे, क्योंकि उनका आत्मा तुममें रहता है।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ने यीशु को मृत्यु से जिलाया। यदि परमेश्वर का आत्मा तुममें रहता है, तो परमेश्वर, जिन्होंने मसीह यीशु को मृत्यु से जिलाया, तुम्हारे शरीरों को भी जीवन देंगे, जिन्हें अभी मरना है। वे यह इसलिए करेंगे क्योंकि उनका आत्मा तुममें रहता है।

uk.L: А якщо Дух того, хто воскресив Ісуса з мертвих, живе у вас, то той, хто воскресив {{christos:Христа|Месію}} Ісуса з мертвих, оживить і ваші смертні тіла через {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} Духа, що живе у вас.
uk.B: А якщо Дух того, хто воскресив Ісуса з мертвих, оселився у вас, то Бог, який воскресив {{christos:Христа|Месію}} Ісуса з мертвих, оживить і ваші смертні тіла, бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} Дух живе у вас.
uk.R: Бог воскресив Ісуса з мертвих. Якщо Божий Дух живе у вас, то Бог, який воскресив {{christos:Христа|Месію}} Ісуса з мертвих, дасть життя і вашим тілам, які тепер мусять померти. Він зробить це, бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} Дух живе у вас.

ja.L: また、もしイエスを死者の中から起こされた方の霊が、あなたがたのうちに住んでおられるなら、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスを死者の中から起こされた方は、あなたがたのうちに住んでおられるご自分の霊のゆえに、あなたがたの死ぬべき体にも命を与えてくださいます。
ja.B: そして、イエスを死者の中から復活させた方の霊が、あなたがたのうちに住んでおられるなら、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスを死者の中から復活させた神は、あなたがたの死ぬべき体にも命を与えてくださいます。ご自分の霊が、あなたがたのうちに住んでおられるからです。
ja.R: 神は、イエスを死者の中からよみがえらせてくださいました。その神の聖霊がみなさんのうちに住んでおられるなら、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}・イエスをよみがえらせた神は、今は死ななければならないみなさんの体にも、命を与えてくださいます。神がそうしてくださるのは、聖霊がみなさんのうちに住んでおられるからです。

decisions.choice: will give life to your mortal bodies: the resurrection of the body
decisions.reason: The verb is future and the object is the mortal body, the body that dies (verse 10). Paul means that God will raise believers as he raised Jesus (6:5, 1 Corinthians 15:22).

decisions.choice: because of his Spirit who dwells in you
alternatives: "through his Spirit who dwells in you"
decisions.reason: Manuscripts are divided between two forms that differ by one ending: "because of his Spirit" (the SBLGNT) and "through his Spirit". The first gives the Spirit's presence as the reason God will raise the body; the second makes the Spirit the one through whom he does it. (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

decisions.choice: the one who raised Jesus: God
decisions.reason: Paul describes God by what he did in raising Jesus, as in 4:24. The verse names the Father, the Son and the Spirit together.

decisions.choice: if: a condition Paul assumes is true of his readers
decisions.reason: As in verse 9, Paul speaks of what is true for his readers, while saying what it depends on.

decisions.choice: God, who raised
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God, whom the phrase describes (m3).

decisions.choice: God raised Jesus from death; your bodies, which now must die
decisions.reason: Readable states first the fact the condition rests on, then the promise, and explains "mortal".

decisions.choice: "그분의 영 때문에" (L); "그분의 영으로 말미암아" (B); "그분의 영께서 ... 살고 계시기 때문에" (R)
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT reads "because of his Spirit" (meaning decision, which footnotes the reading "through his Spirit"). Korean follows the text: "때문에" (L, R) and "말미암아" (B) give the cause, not the means.

decisions.choice: Воскресивший
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the participle as a title of God, capitalised as in 4:24; Balanced and Readable name God (m3).

decisions.choice: "……のゆえに" (L); "……からです" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT has "because of his Spirit" (m2): the Spirit's presence is the reason God will raise the body. "によって" would give the other reading, the Spirit as the means, so every level gives a reason.

decisions.choice: "起こされた" (L); "復活させた" (B); "よみがえらせた" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture of raising up; Balanced uses the common word for resurrection, and Readable the everyday "よみがえる", which a young reader knows.

source.text: Ἄρα οὖν, ἀδελφοί, ὀφειλέται ἐσμέν, οὐ τῇ σαρκὶ τοῦ κατὰ σάρκα ζῆν, εἰ γὰρ κατὰ σάρκα ζῆτε μέλλετε ἀποθνῄσκειν, εἰ δὲ πνεύματι τὰς πράξεις τοῦ σώματος θανατοῦτε, ζήσεσθε.

records.literal_gloss: So then, brothers, debtors we are, not to the flesh, of the according to flesh to live, \v 13 if for according to flesh you live, you are about to die; if but by Spirit the deeds of the body you put to death, you will live.

en.L: So then, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live according to [the] flesh. \v 13 For if you live according to [the] flesh, you are going to die; but if by [the] Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
en.B: So then, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, we are under an obligation, but not to the flesh, to live as the flesh dictates. \v 13 If you live as the flesh dictates, you are headed for death. But if by the Spirit you keep putting the body's practices to death, you will live.
en.R: So, {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}, we do owe something, but we owe nothing to our sinful selves. We do not have to live the way they want. \v 13 If you live the way your sinful self wants, you will die. But if, with the Spirit's power, you keep killing off the sinful things you do with your body, you will live.

es.L: Por consiguiente, hermanos, somos deudores, no de la carne, para vivir según [la] carne; \v 13 porque si {{plural_you:viven|vivís}} según [la] carne, {{plural_you:van|vais}} a morir; pero si por [el] Espíritu {{plural_you:dan|dais}} muerte a las prácticas del cuerpo, {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}}.
es.B: Así pues, hermanos, tenemos una obligación, pero no con la carne, para vivir como la carne manda. \v 13 Si {{plural_you:viven|vivís}} como la carne manda, {{plural_you:van|vais}} camino de la muerte. Pero si por el Espíritu {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} dando muerte a las prácticas del cuerpo, {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}}.
es.R: Así que, hermanos, sí tenemos una deuda, pero no le debemos nada a nuestro yo pecador. No tenemos que vivir como él quiere. \v 13 Si {{plural_you:viven|vivís}} como quiere {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} yo pecador, {{plural_you:morirán|moriréis}}. Pero si, con el poder del Espíritu, {{plural_you:siguen|seguís}} acabando con lo malo que {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} con {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} cuerpo, {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}}.

sw.L: Basi, ndugu, sisi ni wadaiwa, si wa mwili, ili tuishi kwa kadiri ya mwili; \v 13 kwa maana mkiishi kwa kadiri ya mwili, mnaelekea kufa; lakini kwa Roho mkiyaua matendo ya mwili, mtaishi.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, ndugu, tunadaiwa, lakini si na asili ya dhambi, ili tuishi kama inavyotuamuru. \v 13 Mkiishi kama asili ya dhambi inavyoamuru, mnaelekea kifo. Lakini kwa Roho mkiendelea kuyaua matendo ya mwili, mtaishi.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, ndugu, tunadaiwa kitu, lakini hatudaiwi chochote na asili yetu ya dhambi. Hatulazimiki kuishi jinsi inavyotaka. \v 13 Mkiishi jinsi asili yenu ya dhambi inavyotaka, mtakufa. Lakini kwa nguvu ya Roho mkiendelea kuyakomesha mambo maovu mnayoyatenda kwa miili yenu, mtaishi.

fr.L: Ainsi donc, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, nous sommes débiteurs, non envers la chair, pour vivre selon [la] chair. \v 13 Car si vous vivez selon [la] chair, vous allez mourir ; mais si par [l’]Esprit vous faites mourir les actions du corps, vous vivrez.
fr.B: Ainsi donc, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, nous avons une dette, mais pas envers la chair, pour vivre comme la chair le dicte. \v 13 Si vous vivez comme la chair le dicte, vous allez vers la mort. Mais si, par l’Esprit, vous ne cessez de faire mourir les pratiques du corps, vous vivrez.
fr.R: Ainsi, {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, nous avons bien une dette, mais nous ne devons rien à notre nature pécheresse. Nous ne sommes pas obligés de vivre comme elle le veut. \v 13 Si vous vivez comme votre nature pécheresse le veut, vous mourrez. Mais si, avec la puissance de l’Esprit, vous continuez à faire mourir le mal que vous faites avec votre corps, vous vivrez.

ko.L: 그러므로 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 우리는 빚진 사람입니다. 그러나 육신을 따라 살도록 육신에게 [빚진 것은] 아닙니다. \v 13 여러분이 육신을 따라 살면 반드시 죽을 것이지만, 성령으로 몸의 행실을 죽이면 살 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 우리는 빚을 진 사람들입니다. 그러나 육신에게 빚을 져서 육신이 시키는 대로 살아야 하는 것은 아닙니다. \v 13 여러분이 육신이 시키는 대로 살면 죽음에 이를 것입니다. 그러나 성령으로 몸의 악한 행실을 계속 죽이면 살 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러므로 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 여러분, 우리는 갚아야 할 빚이 있습니다. 그러나 죄에 끌리는 본성에게는 아무 빚도 없습니다. 우리는 그 본성이 원하는 대로 살 필요가 없습니다. \v 13 여러분이 죄에 끌리는 본성이 원하는 대로 살면, 여러분은 죽을 것입니다. 그러나 성령의 능력으로 여러분이 몸으로 하는 죄된 일들을 계속 없애 버리면, 여러분은 살 것입니다.

vi.L: Vậy thì, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, chúng ta là người mắc nợ, không phải mắc nợ xác thịt để sống theo xác thịt; \v 13 vì nếu anh chị em sống theo xác thịt, anh chị em sẽ chết; nhưng nếu bởi Thánh Linh anh chị em giết chết các việc làm của thân thể, anh chị em sẽ sống.
vi.B: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, chúng ta có một món nợ, nhưng không phải nợ xác thịt để phải sống theo đòi hỏi của xác thịt. \v 13 Nếu anh chị em sống theo đòi hỏi của xác thịt, anh chị em đang đi đến sự chết. Nhưng nếu nhờ Thánh Linh anh chị em cứ tiếp tục giết chết những việc làm của thân thể, anh chị em sẽ sống.
vi.R: Vậy, thưa {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}, chúng ta có mắc nợ, nhưng chúng ta không nợ gì bản tính tội lỗi của mình cả. Chúng ta không phải sống theo ý nó muốn. \v 13 Nếu anh chị em sống theo ý bản tính tội lỗi muốn, anh chị em sẽ chết. Nhưng nếu nhờ quyền năng của Thánh Linh, anh chị em cứ tiếp tục diệt trừ những việc tội lỗi mình làm bằng thân thể, thì anh chị em sẽ sống.

pt.L: Assim, então, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, somos devedores, não à carne, para vivermos segundo a carne. \v 13 Pois, se vocês vivem segundo a carne, vão morrer; mas, se pelo Espírito vocês fazem morrer as práticas do corpo, vocês viverão.
pt.B: Assim, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, temos uma obrigação, mas não com a carne, para vivermos como a carne manda. \v 13 Se vocês vivem como a carne manda, estão a caminho da morte. Mas, se pelo Espírito vocês continuam fazendo morrer as práticas do corpo, vocês viverão.
pt.R: Então, {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}, nós devemos alguma coisa, mas não devemos nada à nossa natureza pecadora. Não temos de viver do jeito que ela quer. \v 13 Se vocês vivem do jeito que a natureza pecadora quer, vocês vão morrer. Mas, se com o poder do Espírito vocês continuam matando as coisas erradas que fazem com o corpo, vocês vão viver.

am.L: ስለዚህ እንግዲህ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ ባለ ዕዳዎች ነን፤ እንደ ሥጋ እንድንኖር ለሥጋ ግን አይደለም። \v 13 እንደ ሥጋ ብትኖሩ ልትሞቱ ነውና፤ በመንፈስ ግን የአካልን ሥራዎች ብትገድሉ ሕያዋን ትሆናላችሁ።
am.B: ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ ግዴታ አለብን፤ ነገር ግን ሥጋ እንደሚያዝዘው እንድንኖር ለሥጋ አይደለም። \v 13 ሥጋ እንደሚያዝዘው ብትኖሩ ወደ ሞት እያመራችሁ ነው። በመንፈስ ግን የአካልን ልማዶች ዘወትር ብትገድሉ በሕይወት ትኖራላችሁ።
am.R: ስለዚህ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} ሆይ፣ የምንከፍለው ዕዳ አለብን፤ ለኃጢአተኛው ማንነታችን ግን ምንም ዕዳ የለብንም። እርሱ እንደሚፈልገው መኖር የለብንም። \v 13 ኃጢአተኛው ማንነታችሁ እንደሚፈልገው ብትኖሩ ትሞታላችሁ። በመንፈስ ኃይል ግን በአካላችሁ የምትሠሩትን ኃጢአት ዘወትር ብትገድሉ በሕይወት ትኖራላችሁ።

ru.L: Итак, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}, мы должники не плоти, чтобы жить по плоти; \v 13 ведь если вы живёте по плоти, вы умрёте, а если Духом умерщвляете дела тела, будете жить.
ru.B: Итак, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}, мы в долгу, но не перед плотью, чтобы жить так, как она велит. \v 13 Если вы живёте так, как велит плоть, вы идёте к смерти. Но если Духом вы умерщвляете дела тела, вы будете жить.
ru.R: Итак, {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}, мы должны, но мы ничего не должны своей греховной природе. Мы не обязаны жить так, как она хочет. \v 13 Если вы живёте так, как хочет ваша греховная природа, вы умрёте. Но если силой Духа вы будете продолжать убивать в себе греховные дела, которые совершаете телом, вы будете жить.

hi.L: इसलिए, हे {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, हम ऋणी हैं, पर शरीर के नहीं, कि शरीर के अनुसार जिएँ। \v 13 क्योंकि यदि तुम शरीर के अनुसार जियोगे, तो मरनेवाले हो; परंतु यदि आत्मा के द्वारा देह के कामों को मारोगे, तो जीवित रहोगे।
hi.B: इसलिए, {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, हम पर एक ऋण है, पर शरीर का नहीं, कि शरीर के कहे अनुसार जिएँ। \v 13 यदि तुम शरीर के कहे अनुसार जियोगे, तो मृत्यु की ओर जा रहे हो। पर यदि आत्मा के द्वारा तुम देह के कामों को मारते रहोगे, तो जीवित रहोगे।
hi.R: इसलिए, {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}, हम पर कुछ ऋण तो है, पर हम अपने शारीरिक स्वभाव के कुछ भी ऋणी नहीं हैं। हमें उसके कहे अनुसार जीना नहीं है। \v 13 यदि तुम अपने शारीरिक स्वभाव के कहे अनुसार जियोगे, तो तुम मरोगे। पर यदि आत्मा की शक्ति से तुम अपने शरीर से किए जानेवाले पाप के कामों को मारते रहोगे, तो तुम जीवित रहोगे।

uk.L: Отже, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}, ми боржники не тілу, щоб жити згідно з тілом. \v 13 Бо якщо живете згідно з тілом, то маєте померти; якщо ж Духом умертвляєте діла тіла, житимете.
uk.B: Тож, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}, ми маємо обовʼязок, але не перед тілом, щоб жити так, як воно велить. \v 13 Якщо ви живете так, як велить тіло, на вас чекає смерть. Але якщо Духом ви постійно умертвляєте вчинки тіла, то житимете.
uk.R: Отже, {{gender:брати і сестри|брати}}, ми справді маємо борг, але нічого не винні своїй грішній природі. Ми не мусимо жити так, як вона хоче. \v 13 Якщо ви живете так, як хоче ваша грішна природа, ви помрете. Але якщо силою Духа ви постійно вбиваєте ті грішні вчинки, які робите своїм тілом, ви житимете.

ja.L: こういうわけで、{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしたちは負債のある者です。[しかし]肉に対して、肉に従って生きる[負債がある]のではありません。\v 13 というのは、もし肉に従って生きるなら、あなたがたは死ぬことになります。しかし、もし霊によって体の行いを殺すなら、あなたがたは生きます。
ja.B: こういうわけで、{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしたちには果たすべき義務があります。しかしそれは、肉に対して、肉の言うままに生きる義務ではありません。\v 13 肉の言うままに生きるなら、あなたがたは死に向かっています。しかし、霊によって体の行いを殺し続けるなら、あなたがたは生きます。
ja.R: ですから、{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、わたしたちには果たさなければならないことがあります。でも、罪に傾く性質に対しては、何の借りもありません。その性質が望むとおりに生きる必要はないのです。\v 13 罪に傾く性質の望むとおりに生きるなら、みなさんは死にます。しかし、聖霊の力によって、体を使ってする罪の行いを殺し続けるなら、みなさんは生きます。

decisions.choice: we are debtors, not to the flesh: the debt is owed to God's Spirit, though Paul does not finish the thought
decisions.reason: Paul says only to whom we owe nothing. The rest of the sentence, and verses 2-11, show that what believers owe is to live by the Spirit who gives them life.

decisions.choice: flesh: human nature under sin's sway, set against the Spirit
decisions.reason: As in verses 3-9, the flesh is human life ruled by sin and opposed to the Spirit, not the body as such.

decisions.choice: you are going to die: death as the end of that way of life, cut off from God
alternatives: only bodily death, which comes to all
decisions.reason: Everyone dies in the body, including those who live by the Spirit (verse 10). The contrast with "you will live", the life of verses 6 and 11, shows that Paul means death in the full sense, the wages of sin (6:23).

decisions.choice: the deeds of the body: sinful practices carried out through the body
decisions.reason: Paul has spoken of sin reigning in the mortal body and using its members (6:12-13). The "deeds of the body" are what the body does under that rule; the body itself is not evil.

decisions.choice: by the Spirit you put to death: the Spirit is the power, and the killing goes on
decisions.reason: The dative "by the Spirit" gives the means: believers do this in the Spirit's strength, not their own. The present tense of the verb points to something done again and again, not once for all.

decisions.choice: brothers: fellow believers, women and men
decisions.reason: Paul addresses the whole church in Rome as members of one family, as in 1:13 and 7:1; the plural includes the sisters.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The inclusive default names everyone Paul addresses (m6); the traditional setting keeps "brothers".

decisions.choice: keep putting to death (B); keep killing off (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out the ongoing action of the present tense (m5).

decisions.choice: the sinful things you do with your body; your sinful self
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the deeds of the body" (m4) and "flesh" (m2) mean here.

decisions.choice: hermanos, no setting
decisions.reason: As at 1:13 and 12:1, Spanish "hermanos" already includes the sisters (m6), so there is no gender span here or in verse 29.

decisions.choice: ndugu, no setting
decisions.reason: As at 1:13 and 12:1, "ndugu" already means brothers and sisters (m6), so Swahili needs no gender span here or in verse 29.

decisions.choice: matendo ya mwili (L, B); mambo maovu mnayoyatenda kwa miili yenu (R)
decisions.reason: Here the Greek word is the body, not the flesh: sinful practices carried out through the body (m4). So every level says "mwili" or "miili", and "asili ya dhambi" is kept for the flesh in verses 12-13a.

decisions.choice: "몸의 행실을 죽이다" (L); "몸의 악한 행실을 계속 죽이다" (B); "몸으로 하는 죄된 일들을 계속 없애 버리다" (R)
decisions.reason: The deeds of the body are sinful practices carried out through the body, and the killing goes on (meaning decisions). Balanced adds "악한" and "계속" so the reader does not hear a command to harm the body; Readable says "없애 버리다".

decisions.choice: "giết chết" (L); "cứ tiếp tục giết chết" (B); "cứ tiếp tục diệt trừ" (R)
decisions.reason: The Spirit is the power, and the killing goes on (m5). Balanced and Readable add "cứ tiếp tục" for the ongoing action, as the English says "keep"; "chế ngự" (to bring under control) would be too weak for the Greek verb.

decisions.choice: {{gender:братья и сёстры|братья}}
decisions.reason: As in 7:1: the inclusive default names everyone Paul addresses (m6).

decisions.choice: умерщвляете
decisions.reason: The imperfective "умерщвляете" carries the ongoing action of the present tense (m5); Readable says "будете продолжать убивать".

decisions.choice: {{gender:भाइयो और बहनो|भाइयो}}
decisions.reason: Paul writes to the whole church, women and men (meaning decision m6), so the inclusive vocative is the default and "भाइयो" the alternative, as the style guide has it for adelphoi.

decisions.choice: "діла тіла" with "тіло" for soma, beside "тіло" for sarx in the same sentence
decisions.reason: Ukrainian uses one word where Paul has two; here the body (soma) is the means through which sinful practices are done (m4), while "згідно з тілом" is the moral sense of sarx (m2). Readable makes the difference plain.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、" without "わたしの" at every level
alternatives: "わたしの{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}、" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the English, the inclusive default names the whole church Paul addresses (m6), and the traditional setting keeps "兄弟たち". The Greek has no "my" here, so no level adds "わたしの"; Romans adds it only where the Greek has it (7:4; 15:14).

decisions.choice: "負債のある者" (L); "果たすべき義務" (B); "果たさなければならないこと" and "何の借りもありません" (R)
decisions.reason: Paul says only to whom the debt is not owed (m1). Literal keeps the word for a debtor; Balanced and Readable say obligation, and Readable keeps the picture of a debt for what is not owed to the flesh.

source.text: ὅσοι γὰρ πνεύματι θεοῦ ἄγονται, οὗτοι υἱοί εἰσιν θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: As many as for by Spirit of God are led, these sons are of God.

en.L: For as many as are led by [the] Spirit of God, these are {{gender:children|sons}} of God.
en.B: Those whom God's Spirit is leading are God's {{gender:children|sons}}.
en.R: All the people God's Spirit leads are God's own {{gender:children|sons}}.

es.L: Porque todos aquellos a quienes guía [el] Espíritu de Dios, esos son hijos de Dios.
es.B: Aquellos a quienes el Espíritu de Dios va guiando son hijos de Dios.
es.R: Todas las personas que el Espíritu de Dios guía son los propios hijos de Dios.

sw.L: Kwa maana wote ambao Roho wa Mungu huwaongoza, hawa ni wana wa Mungu.
sw.B: Wale ambao Roho wa Mungu anawaongoza siku kwa siku, hao ndio wana wa Mungu.
sw.R: Watu wote ambao Roho wa Mungu anawaongoza ni wana halisi wa Mungu.

fr.L: Car tous ceux qui sont conduits par [l’]Esprit de Dieu, ceux-là sont {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Dieu.
fr.B: Ceux que l’Esprit de Dieu conduit sont les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Dieu.
fr.R: Tous ceux que l’Esprit de Dieu conduit sont vraiment les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Dieu.

ko.L: 하나님의 영의 인도를 받는 사람은 누구나 하나님의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}입니다.
ko.B: 하나님의 영께서 이끄시는 사람들은 하나님의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}입니다.
ko.R: 하나님의 영께서 이끄시는 사람은 모두 하나님의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}입니다.

vi.L: Vì tất cả những ai được Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời dẫn dắt, những người ấy là con cái của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Những ai được Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời dẫn dắt đều là con cái của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Tất cả những người được Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời dẫn dắt đều là chính con cái của Đức Chúa Trời.

pt.L: Pois todos os que são guiados pelo Espírito de Deus, esses são filhos de Deus.
pt.B: Os que são guiados pelo Espírito de Deus são filhos de Deus.
pt.R: Todos os que são guiados pelo Espírito de Deus são filhos do próprio Deus.

am.L: በእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ የሚመሩ ሁሉ እነርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናቸውና።
am.B: የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ የሚመራቸው የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ናቸው።
am.R: የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ የሚመራቸው ሰዎች ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔር የገዛ ልጆቹ ናቸው።

ru.L: Ведь все, кто водим Духом Бога, — они {{gender:дети|сыновья}} Бога.
ru.B: Те, кого ведёт Дух Бога, — {{gender:дети|сыновья}} Бога.
ru.R: Все люди, которых ведёт Дух Бога, — {{gender:дети|сыновья}} самого Бога.

hi.L: क्योंकि जितने परमेश्वर के आत्मा के द्वारा चलाए जाते हैं, वे ही परमेश्वर {{gender:की सन्तान|के पुत्र}} हैं।
hi.B: जिन्हें परमेश्वर का आत्मा चला रहा है, वे परमेश्वर {{gender:की सन्तान|के पुत्र}} हैं।
hi.R: जितने लोगों को परमेश्वर का आत्मा चलाता है, वे सब परमेश्वर {{gender:की अपनी सन्तान|के अपने पुत्र}} हैं।

uk.L: Бо всі, кого Дух Божий веде, ті є {{gender:дітьми|синами}} Божими.
uk.B: Ті, кого веде Божий Дух, — Божі {{gender:діти|сини}}.
uk.R: Усі люди, яких веде Божий Дух, — це власні {{gender:діти|сини}} Бога.

ja.L: というのは、神の霊によって導かれる者はみな、神の子たちだからです。
ja.B: 神の霊に導かれている人たちは、みな神の子です。
ja.R: 聖霊に導かれている人はみな、神ご自身の子なのです。

decisions.choice: sons: the standing of a son and heir, given to women and men alike
decisions.reason: huios is the word for a son, and in a family it carried the standing of a son and heir. Paul gives that standing to every believer, women and men alike (Galatians 3:26-29), and in verses 16-17 he says the same with the word for children, which has no gender.

decisions.choice: led: guided day by day
decisions.reason: agō is to lead or guide. The present tense describes the Spirit's ongoing direction of a believer's life, the life of putting sin to death in verse 13 (compare Galatians 5:18).

decisions.choice: {{gender:children|sons}}
decisions.reason: The word gives the standing of a son and heir (m1), which Paul gives to men and women alike. The inclusive default says who has it; the traditional setting keeps "sons", which shows the standing more plainly.

decisions.choice: hijos, no setting
decisions.reason: Where the English offers "children" with "sons" as the traditional form, Spanish "hijos" already covers sons and daughters and keeps the standing of a son and heir (m1), as in Galatians 3:26 and 4:5. So verses 14, 15, 19 and 23 have no gender span.

decisions.choice: a quienes guía [el] Espíritu de Dios
alternatives: los que son guiados por el Espíritu de Dios
decisions.reason: The Greek passive is turned into an active verb with the Spirit as subject; the sense is the same, and the familiar passive wording is avoided.

decisions.choice: wana, no setting
decisions.reason: "Wana" is used of sons and daughters alike and keeps the heir's standing (m1), as in Galatians 3:26 and 4:5; "watoto" would lose it and is kept for the other word for children in verses 16, 17 and 21. So verses 14, 15, 19 and 23 have no gender span.

decisions.choice: {{gender:enfants|fils}} (for the whole chapter)
decisions.reason: As in English, and as the French of John and Hebrews: "enfants" by default names everyone who has the standing of a son and heir, and "fils" is the traditional alternative, which shows that standing more plainly.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:자녀|아들}}" for "sons" at every level, here and in verses 15, 19 and 23
decisions.reason: The Greek "sons" means the standing of a son and heir, given to women and men alike (meaning decision). As settled for Matthew, Korean gives "자녀" by default with "아들" as the alternative. The span is followed by a particle that suits both words ("입니다", "로", "들"). "자녀" for "children" in verses 16-17 and 21 takes no span.

decisions.choice: "con cái" with no gender span (also 8:19, 9:26)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is "sons", the standing of a son and heir given to women and men alike (m1). Vietnamese "con cái" means children of both sexes and is the natural word for God's children, as in the Vietnamese Luke (6:35); "con trai" would read as male children only. So the English gender span has no counterpart. "Con cái" also stands for the other Greek word for children in 8:16-17 and 8:21.

decisions.choice: filhos, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting to choose between "children" and "sons". Portuguese "filhos" says both at once: it is the word for a son and heir (m1) and also means sons and daughters together, so no setting is needed, as in Matthew 5:9. The same in verses 15, 19 and 23 ("adoção como filhos").

decisions.choice: os que são guiados pelo Espírito
alternatives: os que são conduzidos pelo Espírito
decisions.reason: The passive "são guiados" keeps the present tense of the Spirit's day-by-day leading (m2); "conduzidos" would sound like being transported.

decisions.choice: "ልጆች" (children) with no gender span, here and in 8:19; "ልጅነት" (sonship, adoption) with no span in 8:15 and 8:23
alternatives: a gender span with "ወንዶች ልጆች" (male children) as the alternative
decisions.reason: The English offers "children" and "sons". "የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች" already covers sons and daughters, and "ወንዶች ልጆች" would stress maleness, which the Greek word does not do here, so Amharic needs no span. The son's standing as heir is carried by "ልጅነት" and by "ወራሾች" (heirs) in 8:17.

decisions.choice: {{gender:дети|сыновья}}
decisions.reason: The word gives the standing of a son and heir, which Paul gives to women and men alike (m1); the inclusive default says who has it, as the English does. "Сыны" is the old form; "сыновья" is kept for the alternative.

decisions.choice: {{gender:की सन्तान|के पुत्र}}
decisions.reason: "Sons" means the standing of a son and heir, given to women and men alike (meaning decision m1), so "सन्तान" is the default, as the style guide settled in Matthew. The postposition goes inside each option, since "सन्तान" is feminine and "पुत्र" masculine. The same in 8:15, 8:19 and 8:23.

decisions.choice: "神の子" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs a span for sons (m1), but Japanese "子" is already the word for a son and heir in a family and includes daughters, so no span is needed. "息子" would sound like a private family word, not the standing Paul means. The same holds for "adoption as sons" in verses 15 and 23.

source.text: οὐ γὰρ ἐλάβετε πνεῦμα δουλείας πάλιν εἰς φόβον, ἀλλὰ ἐλάβετε πνεῦμα υἱοθεσίας ἐν ᾧ κράζομεν· Αββα ὁ πατήρ·

records.literal_gloss: Not for you received a spirit of slavery again to fear, but you received Spirit of adoption as sons, in whom we cry: Abba, the Father;

en.L: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery [bringing you] back into fear, but you received [the] Spirit of adoption as {{gender:children|sons}}, by whom we cry, "Abba, Father!"
en.B: What you received was not a spirit of slavery that would put you back under fear. You received the Spirit of adoption as {{gender:children|sons}}, and in the Spirit we call out, "Abba, Father!"
en.R: When God gave you the Spirit, God did not make you slaves again, living in fear. By giving you the Spirit, God gave you adoption as {{gender:children|sons}}. And by the Spirit we cry out to God, "Abba! Father!"

es.L: Porque no {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}} un espíritu de esclavitud [que {{plural_you:los|os}} lleve] otra vez al temor, sino que {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}} [el] Espíritu de adopción como hijos, mediante el cual clamamos: «¡Abba, Padre!»
es.B: Lo que {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}} no fue un espíritu de esclavitud que {{plural_you:los|os}} volviera a someter al miedo. {{plural_you:Recibieron|Recibisteis}} el Espíritu de adopción como hijos, y en el Espíritu clamamos: «¡Abba, Padre!»
es.R: Cuando Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} dio el Espíritu, no {{plural_you:los|os}} hizo esclavos otra vez, para vivir con miedo. Con el Espíritu, Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} adoptó como hijos. Y por el Espíritu clamamos a Dios: «¡Abba! ¡Padre!»

sw.L: Kwa maana hamkupokea roho ya utumwa [iwarudishe] tena katika hofu, bali mlimpokea Roho wa kufanywa wana; kwa huyo tunalia, "Aba, Baba!"
sw.B: Hamkupokea roho ya utumwa ambayo ingewarudisha tena chini ya hofu. Mlimpokea Roho wa kufanywa wana, na katika Roho tunaita, "Aba, Baba!"
sw.R: Mungu alipowapa Roho, hakuwafanya watumwa tena wa kuishi kwa hofu. Kwa kuwapa Roho, Mungu aliwafanya wana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Na kwa Roho tunamlilia Mungu, "Aba! Baba!"

fr.L: Car vous n’avez pas reçu un esprit d’esclavage [pour retomber] de nouveau dans la crainte, mais vous avez reçu [l’]Esprit d’adoption comme {{gender:enfants|fils}}, par lequel nous crions : « Abba, Père ! »
fr.B: Ce que vous avez reçu, ce n’est pas un esprit d’esclavage qui vous ramènerait sous la crainte. Vous avez reçu l’Esprit d’adoption comme {{gender:enfants|fils}}, et dans l’Esprit, nous crions : « Abba, Père ! »
fr.R: Quand Dieu vous a donné l’Esprit, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a pas fait de vous des esclaves, qui vivent de nouveau dans la peur. En vous donnant l’Esprit, Dieu vous a adoptés comme {{gender:enfants|fils}}. Et par l’Esprit, nous crions à Dieu : « Abba ! Père ! »

ko.L: 여러분은 다시 두려움에 [빠뜨리는] 종의 영을 받지 않고, {{gender:자녀|아들}}로 삼으시는 영을 받았습니다. 그 영 안에서 우리는 "아바, 아버지!" 하고 부르짖습니다.
ko.B: 여러분이 받은 것은 여러분을 다시 두려움 아래 두는 종의 영이 아닙니다. 여러분은 {{gender:자녀|아들}}로 삼아 주시는 성령을 받았습니다. 그 성령 안에서 우리는 "아바, 아버지!" 하고 부릅니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 여러분에게 성령을 주셨을 때, 여러분을 다시 두려움 속에 사는 종으로 만드신 것이 아닙니다. 성령을 주셔서 여러분을 {{gender:자녀|아들}}로 삼아 주셨습니다. 그래서 우리는 성령의 힘으로 하나님께 "아바! 아버지!" 하고 부르짖습니다.

vi.L: Vì anh chị em đã không nhận lấy một tinh thần nô lệ để lại [sống] trong sợ hãi, nhưng anh chị em đã nhận lấy Thánh Linh của sự nhận làm con, trong Thánh Linh ấy chúng ta kêu lên: "A-ba, Cha!"
vi.B: Anh chị em đã không nhận một tinh thần nô lệ để lại phải sống trong sợ hãi. Anh chị em đã nhận Thánh Linh, là Đấng làm cho anh chị em được nhận làm con, và trong Thánh Linh chúng ta kêu lên: "A-ba, Cha!"
vi.R: Khi Đức Chúa Trời ban Thánh Linh cho anh chị em, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không biến anh chị em thành nô lệ một lần nữa, phải sống trong sợ hãi. Khi ban Thánh Linh, Đức Chúa Trời đã nhận anh chị em làm con. Và nhờ Thánh Linh, chúng ta kêu lên với Đức Chúa Trời: "A-ba! Cha ơi!"

pt.L: Pois vocês não receberam um espírito de escravidão [que os leve] de novo ao medo, mas receberam [o] Espírito de adoção como filhos, no qual clamamos: "Aba, Pai!"
pt.B: O que vocês receberam não foi um espírito de escravidão, que os colocaria de novo debaixo do medo. Vocês receberam o Espírito de adoção como filhos, e no Espírito clamamos: "Aba, Pai!"
pt.R: Quando Deus deu o Espírito a vocês, não fez de vocês escravos outra vez, vivendo com medo. Ao dar o Espírito a vocês, Deus os adotou como filhos. E pelo Espírito nós clamamos a Deus: "Aba! Pai!"

am.L: እንደ ገና ለፍርሃት የባርነትን መንፈስ አልተቀበላችሁምና፤ ነገር ግን «አባ፣ አባት!» ብለን የምንጮኽበትን የልጅነት መንፈስ ተቀበላችሁ፤
am.B: የተቀበላችሁት ዳግመኛ ከፍርሃት በታች የሚያስገባችሁን የባርነት መንፈስ አይደለም። የተቀበላችሁት የልጅነትን መንፈስ ነው፤ በእርሱም «አባ፣ አባት!» ብለን እንጣራለን።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር መንፈሱን ሲሰጣችሁ ዳግመኛ በፍርሃት የምትኖሩ ባሪያዎች አላደረጋችሁም። መንፈሱን በመስጠት ልጆቹ አድርጎ ወሰዳችሁ። በመንፈሱም ወደ እግዚአብሔር «አባ! አባት!» ብለን እንጮኻለን።

ru.L: Ведь вы не получили духа рабства, [чтобы] снова [жить] в страхе, но получили Духа усыновления, в котором мы взываем: «Авва, Отец!»
ru.B: Вы получили не дух рабства, который снова вернул бы вас под власть страха. Вы получили Духа усыновления, и в Духе мы взываем: «Авва, Отец!»
ru.R: Когда Бог дал вам Духа, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не сделал вас снова рабами, живущими в страхе. Дав вам Духа, Бог усыновил вас. И Духом мы взываем к Богу: «Авва, Отец!»

hi.L: क्योंकि तुम्हें दासत्व का आत्मा नहीं मिला कि फिर भयभीत हो, परंतु {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्र}} के रूप में गोद लिए जाने का आत्मा मिला है, जिसके द्वारा हम पुकारते हैं, "अब्बा, हे पिता!"
hi.B: तुम्हें जो मिला, वह दासत्व का आत्मा नहीं था जो तुम्हें फिर से भय के अधीन कर दे। तुम्हें {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्र}} के रूप में गोद लिए जाने का आत्मा मिला है, और आत्मा में हम पुकारते हैं, "अब्बा, हे पिता!"
hi.R: जब परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें आत्मा दिया, तो उन्होंने तुम्हें फिर से दास नहीं बनाया कि तुम भय में जियो। आत्मा देकर परमेश्वर ने तुम्हें {{gender:अपनी सन्तान|अपने पुत्र}} होने का अधिकार दिया। और आत्मा के द्वारा हम परमेश्वर को पुकारते हैं, "अब्बा, हे पिता!"

uk.L: Бо ви не отримали духа рабства, [щоб] знову [повернутися] до страху, а отримали Духа усиновлення, яким ми кличемо: «Авва, Отче!»
uk.B: Ви отримали не духа рабства, який знову поставив би вас під владу страху. Ви отримали Духа усиновлення, і в Дусі ми вигукуємо: «Авва, Отче!»
uk.R: Коли Бог дав вам Духа, Бог не зробив вас знову рабами, які живуть у страху. Даючи вам Духа, Бог усиновив вас. І силою Духа ми кличемо до Бога: «Авва! Отче!»

ja.L: というのは、あなたがたは再び恐れに[陥らせる]奴隷の霊を受けたのではなく、子とする霊を受けたからです。この霊によって、わたしたちは「アッバ、父よ」と叫びます。
ja.B: あなたがたが受けたのは、再び恐れの中に引き戻す奴隷の霊ではありません。神の子とされる霊を受けたのです。この霊によって、わたしたちは「アッバ、父よ」と呼びかけます。
ja.R: 神がみなさんに聖霊を与えられたとき、神はみなさんを、もう一度、恐れながら生きる奴隷にしたのではありません。聖霊を与えることで、神はみなさんを神の子としてくださったのです。そして、わたしたちは聖霊によって、神に向かって「アッバ、父よ」と叫びます。

decisions.choice: a spirit of slavery: the Spirit they received is not one who enslaves
decisions.reason: Paul is not saying that they received a spirit of slavery before. He sets the Spirit they did receive against what that Spirit is not: one who would make them slaves again, as they were under sin (6:17-20). The lowercase shows that the phrase names what the Spirit is not.

decisions.choice: adoption as sons: being made a son and heir by law
alternatives: the feeling of being God's children
decisions.reason: huiothesia is the legal word for adoption. In Roman law an adopted son received the full rights of a son born into the family, including the inheritance (verse 17). Paul gives that standing to every believer, women as much as men (Galatians 4:5-7).

decisions.choice: Abba: the Aramaic word for "father", followed by the Greek word
decisions.reason: Abba is the Aramaic word a child used for a father, and the word Jesus used in his own prayer (Mark 14:36). The churches kept the Aramaic word and added its translation, as Galatians 4:6 also does. Believers address God the way the Son does.

decisions.choice: by whom we cry: in the Spirit's power we call God Father
alternatives: a new sentence beginning "By him we cry", leading into verse 16
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT punctuation joins "in whom we cry" to the Spirit of adoption. krazō is to cry out aloud, here in prayer. In Galatians 4:6 it is the Spirit who cries; here "we" do, by the Spirit.

decisions.choice: from "you" to "we"
decisions.reason: Paul says "you received" and then "we cry": he and his readers pray in the same way, Jew and Gentile alike.

decisions.choice: adoption as {{gender:children|sons}}
decisions.reason: The word gives the standing of a son and heir (m2), which Paul gives to men and women alike. The inclusive default says who is adopted; the traditional setting keeps "sons".

decisions.choice: God gave you the Spirit
decisions.reason: Readable names the giver, God, so the sentence can say plainly what he did and did not do.

decisions.choice: «¡Abba, Padre!» (L, B); «¡Abba! ¡Padre!» (R)
decisions.reason: The Aramaic word is kept, followed by "Padre" as the Greek gives its translation (m3), as in Galatians 4:6. "Adopción como hijos" has no gender setting (see verse 14).

decisions.choice: roho ya utumwa (lowercase, class 9); Roho wa kufanywa wana (personal agreement); Aba, Baba
decisions.reason: The spirit of slavery is not a spirit they received (m1), so it is written lowercase with the agreement of a thing ("roho ya utumwa ... ingewarudisha"), while God's Spirit takes personal agreement ("mlimpokea Roho wa"). The Aramaic word is written "Aba", as in Galatians 4:6, since Swahili spelling does not double consonants. "Kufanywa wana" has no gender setting (see verse 14).

decisions.choice: slave(s), slavery
decisions.reason: "Slave" at every level, as the style guide keeps it where slavery itself is the point: a spirit of slavery set against the Spirit of adoption as children.

decisions.choice: "adoption comme {{gender:enfants|fils}}"
decisions.reason: "Adoption filiale" is the traditional French phrase, but it says "son" in an adjective that cannot carry the setting. "Adoption comme enfants / comme fils" lets the reader choose, as in English.

decisions.choice: "esclavage", "esclaves" at every level
decisions.reason: As the English: a spirit of slavery is set against the Spirit of adoption, so slavery itself is the point and the word stays at every level.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:자녀|아들}}로 삼으시는 영" (L); "{{gender:자녀|아들}}로 삼아 주시는 성령" (B, R) for the Spirit of adoption; "아바, 아버지" at every level
decisions.reason: Adoption is being made a son and heir by law (meaning decision). "양자" is the exact legal word but in Korean suggests one adopted son and has no inclusive form, so the Korean says "자녀로 삼다" ("아들로 삼다" as the setting's alternative), which carries the gender setting. "아바" keeps the Aramaic word, as in the Korean Mark 14:36.

decisions.choice: "종의 영" (L, B); "종으로 만드신" (R)
decisions.reason: "종" as through chapters 6-8; here slavery is set against being God's child, and Korean "종" already means one who belongs to a master.

decisions.choice: "một tinh thần nô lệ", lowercase (L, B)
decisions.reason: The spirit of slavery is not the Spirit they received, who does not enslave (m1), so Vietnamese says "tinh thần" (a disposition), lowercase, set against "Thánh Linh" in the second half.

decisions.choice: "sự nhận làm con" (L), "được nhận làm con" (B, R), with no gender span; "A-ba, Cha!"
decisions.reason: Adoption is being made a son and heir by law (m2). Vietnamese "con" takes in sons and daughters, so the English span has nothing to choose between. "A-ba" is the Aramaic word, kept as in the Vietnamese Mark (14:36), followed by "Cha" (m3).

decisions.choice: Aba
decisions.reason: The Aramaic word is spelled as Portuguese writes its sounds (docs/portuguese-style.md section 11), followed by its translation "Pai", as the Greek does (m3).

decisions.choice: adoção como filhos, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: As in verse 14: "filhos" already includes sons and daughters while keeping the heir's standing (m2).

decisions.choice: "አባ፣ አባት!"
decisions.reason: Paul gives the Aramaic word and then the Greek word for "father". "አባ" is also an Amharic word for father, so the Amharic reader hears both words as Paul's first readers did.

decisions.choice: усыновление, with no gender span
decisions.reason: Key term: huiothesia is "усыновление" at every level. The English adds a gender span on "sons"; Russian "усыновление" is the legal word for taking a child as one's own and is used here of daughters and sons alike, so no setting is used. A reviewer may prefer a span.

decisions.choice: Отец
decisions.reason: Guide's form of address: "Отец", not the vocative "Отче", as for Jesus' prayers in the Gospels.

decisions.choice: "गोद लिए जाने" (L, B); "सन्तान होने का अधिकार" (R)
decisions.reason: Adoption is being made a son and heir by law (meaning decision m2). Literal and Balanced say "गोद लिया जाना", the everyday word for adoption; Readable says what it gives, the right of a child. The same in 8:23.

decisions.choice: "अब्बा, हे पिता!"
decisions.reason: The Aramaic word is kept, followed by the address "हे पिता", as in Mark 14:36.

decisions.choice: усиновлення, with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Усиновлення" is the ordinary Ukrainian legal word for adopting a child of either sex, so it already says what the English inclusive default says (m2); the same in 8:23 and 9:4.

decisions.choice: "奴隷" at every level; "子とする" (L), "神の子とされる" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Slavery itself is the point here, set against the standing of a child and heir, so "奴隷" stays at every level, as in the English. The Romans terms give "子とすること" (L) and "神の子とされること" (B, R) for adoption (m2); "養子" is accurate but in Japanese can sound like a lesser place in the family, the opposite of Paul's point.

decisions.choice: 「アッバ、父よ」
decisions.reason: Paul keeps the Aramaic word and adds the Greek one (m3); Japanese writes the Aramaic in katakana and translates the second word as an address, "父よ".

source.text: αὐτὸ τὸ πνεῦμα συμμαρτυρεῖ τῷ πνεύματι ἡμῶν ὅτι ἐσμὲν τέκνα θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Itself the Spirit bears witness with the spirit of us that we are children of God.

en.L: The Spirit {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} bears witness together with our spirit that we are children of God.
en.B: The Spirit {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} joins our own spirit in testifying that we are God's children.
en.R: The Spirit {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} agrees with what our own spirit says: we are God's children.

es.L: El Espíritu mismo atestigua juntamente con nuestro espíritu que somos hijos de Dios.
es.B: El Espíritu mismo se une a nuestro propio espíritu para declarar que somos hijos de Dios.
es.R: El Espíritu mismo confirma lo que dice nuestro propio espíritu: somos hijos de Dios.

sw.L: Roho {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} anashuhudia sambamba na roho yetu ya kuwa sisi ni watoto wa Mungu.
sw.B: Roho {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} anaungana na roho yetu katika kutoa ushahidi kwamba sisi ni watoto wa Mungu.
sw.R: Roho {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} anakubaliana na kile ambacho roho yetu inasema: sisi ni watoto wa Mungu.

fr.L: L’Esprit {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} rend témoignage avec notre esprit que nous sommes enfants de Dieu.
fr.B: L’Esprit {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} se joint à notre esprit pour témoigner que nous sommes enfants de Dieu.
fr.R: L’Esprit {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} est d’accord avec ce que dit notre propre esprit : nous sommes les enfants de Dieu.

ko.L: 성령께서 친히 우리의 영과 함께 우리가 하나님의 자녀라는 것을 증언하십니다.
ko.B: 성령께서 친히 우리의 영과 함께, 우리가 하나님의 자녀라는 것을 증언하십니다.
ko.R: 성령께서 친히 우리의 영이 말하는 것에 함께 동의하십니다. 우리는 하나님의 자녀라는 것입니다.

vi.L: Chính Thánh Linh cùng làm chứng với tâm linh chúng ta rằng chúng ta là con cái của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Chính Thánh Linh cùng với tâm linh của chúng ta làm chứng rằng chúng ta là con cái Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Chính Thánh Linh xác nhận điều mà tâm linh của chúng ta nói: chúng ta là con cái của Đức Chúa Trời.

pt.L: O próprio Espírito dá testemunho junto com o nosso espírito de que somos filhos de Deus.
pt.B: O próprio Espírito se une ao nosso espírito para testemunhar que somos filhos de Deus.
pt.R: O próprio Espírito confirma o que o nosso espírito diz: somos filhos de Deus.

am.L: መንፈስ ራሱ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች እንደ ሆንን ከመንፈሳችን ጋር ይመሰክራል።
am.B: እኛ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች መሆናችንን መንፈስ ራሱ ከመንፈሳችን ጋር ሆኖ ይመሰክራል።
am.R: መንፈስ ቅዱስ ራሱ የገዛ መንፈሳችን በሚናገረው ይስማማል፤ እኛ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ነን።

ru.L: Сам Дух свидетельствует вместе с нашим духом, что мы дети Бога.
ru.B: Сам Дух вместе с нашим собственным духом свидетельствует, что мы дети Бога.
ru.R: Сам Дух подтверждает то, что говорит нам наш собственный дух: мы дети Бога.

hi.L: आत्मा स्वयं हमारी आत्मा के साथ गवाही देता है कि हम परमेश्वर की सन्तान हैं।
hi.B: आत्मा स्वयं हमारी अपनी आत्मा के साथ मिलकर गवाही देता है कि हम परमेश्वर की सन्तान हैं।
hi.R: आत्मा स्वयं उस बात से सहमत है जो हमारी अपनी आत्मा कहती है: हम परमेश्वर की सन्तान हैं।

uk.L: Сам Дух свідчить разом із нашим духом, що ми діти Божі.
uk.B: Сам Дух разом із нашим власним духом засвідчує, що ми Божі діти.
uk.R: Сам Дух погоджується з тим, що каже наш власний дух: ми Божі діти.

ja.L: 霊ご自身が、わたしたちの霊と共に、わたしたちが神の子どもであることを証ししておられます。
ja.B: 霊ご自身が、わたしたちの霊と一緒になって、わたしたちが神の子どもであることを証言してくださいます。
ja.R: 聖霊ご自身も、わたしたちの霊と同じことを言ってくださいます。わたしたちは神の子どもなのです。

decisions.choice: our spirit: the believer's own human spirit
decisions.reason: Paul sets "the Spirit himself" beside "our spirit", so the second is the human spirit, the inner self that prays "Abba" (verse 15).

decisions.choice: bears witness with: two witnesses agree
decisions.reason: summartureō is to testify together with someone. The Spirit adds his witness to that of our spirit, so that two witnesses confirm the matter, as the law required (Deuteronomy 19:15). Some read it as the Spirit testifying to our spirit; the word itself means "with".

decisions.choice: children: the word for children, of either sex
decisions.reason: teknon has no gender. Paul moves from "sons" (verse 14) to "children" without changing the sense: those who belong to God's family.

decisions.choice: the Spirit {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}
decisions.reason: The Greek pronoun is neuter only because the word for spirit is neuter. The Spirit is a person who testifies, prays and searches, so he is never called "it".

decisions.choice: el Espíritu mismo, no setting; nuestro espíritu (lowercase); hijos
decisions.reason: The Spirit is never "it": Spanish says "el Espíritu mismo", which is masculine like the noun. "Mismo" is an intensifier, not a pronoun, so it takes no deity_pronoun span, unlike the English "himself". "Our spirit" is the believer's own human spirit (m1) and is written lowercase. Spanish has only "hijos" for the word for children here (m3), the same word it uses for "sons" in verses 14-15; the difference cannot be shown.

decisions.choice: Roho {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}; roho yetu (lowercase, class 9); watoto
decisions.reason: "Mwenyewe" is a free pronoun, the kind the deity_pronoun setting applies to in Swahili, so it carries the span as the English "himself" does; God's Spirit takes personal agreement ("anashuhudia"). The human spirit (m1) is written lowercase with the agreement of a thing ("roho yetu ... inasema"), which keeps the two apart. The word for children here is "watoto" (m3), not "wana" as in verses 14-15.

decisions.choice: "l'Esprit {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}"; "il" for the Spirit with the span (for the whole chapter)
decisions.reason: French "Esprit" is masculine, so the pronouns for the Spirit are "il", "lui-même", and, being pronouns for God, they carry the deity_pronoun span as in English. "Notre esprit", the human spirit, is in lower case.

decisions.choice: "성령께서 친히" for "the Spirit himself", here and in verse 26
decisions.reason: Korean says "himself" for an honored subject with "친히"; the English deity_pronoun span has no Korean counterpart.

decisions.choice: "Chính Thánh Linh", with no pronoun (also 8:26)
decisions.reason: Vietnamese stresses "the Spirit himself" with "chính" before the noun, so no pronoun is needed, and there is no deity_pronoun span where the English has one.

decisions.choice: "tâm linh chúng ta", lowercase
decisions.reason: This is the believer's own spirit (m1), "tâm linh" as in 1:9, kept apart from "Thánh Linh"; "linh hồn" is the soul.

decisions.choice: O próprio Espírito, with no pronoun
decisions.reason: Portuguese says "o próprio Espírito", which agrees with the masculine "Espírito" and needs no pronoun, so there is no deity_pronoun span where the English has "himself". The Spirit is never called "isso".

decisions.choice: Сам Дух, with no setting
decisions.reason: The English "himself" has a setting; Russian "сам" is exempt from it, as the style guide has it for сам, свой and себя. It stands at the start of the sentence here and is capitalised for that reason only.

decisions.choice: "आत्मा ... देता है" (God's Spirit, masculine); "हमारी आत्मा" (the human spirit, feminine)
decisions.reason: The two spirits stand side by side here (meaning decision m1). As in 1:9, God's Spirit takes masculine agreement and the human spirit the ordinary feminine, so the reader can tell them apart.

decisions.choice: "Сам Дух", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: English writes "the Spirit himself" with a span; Ukrainian says "сам", which, like the reflexive "свій" and "себе", takes none in the brief. The same in 8:26.

decisions.choice: "霊ご自身" with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Japanese has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun span has no Japanese form. "ご自身" speaks of the Spirit as a person who testifies, never as "it", which is what the English decision asks.

decisions.choice: "子ども" here and in verses 17 and 21; "子" for the word for sons (verses 14, 19)
decisions.reason: Literal can show that Paul moves from the word for sons to the word for children (m3) without a change of sense; both Japanese words include daughters.

source.text: εἰ δὲ τέκνα, καὶ κληρονόμοι· κληρονόμοι μὲν θεοῦ, συγκληρονόμοι δὲ Χριστοῦ, εἴπερ συμπάσχομεν ἵνα καὶ συνδοξασθῶμεν.

records.literal_gloss: If and children, also heirs: heirs indeed of God, joint-heirs and of Christ, if indeed we suffer with [him] so that also we may be glorified with [him].

en.L: And if children, also heirs: heirs of God and co-heirs of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, if indeed we suffer with [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] so that we may also be glorified with [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}].
en.B: If we are children, we are also heirs. We are God's heirs, and we inherit alongside {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, if we suffer together with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} so that we will also be glorified together with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: And because we are God's children, we will receive everything God has promised to give {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} children. We will receive it together with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. But we must suffer with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} now, so that we will also share {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory later.

es.L: Y si [somos] hijos, también [somos] herederos: herederos de Dios, y coherederos junto con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, si de veras sufrimos con [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}] para que también seamos glorificados con [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}].
es.B: Si somos hijos, también somos herederos. Somos herederos de Dios, y heredamos junto con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, si sufrimos junto con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} para ser también glorificados junto con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Y como somos hijos de Dios, recibiremos todo lo que Dios ha prometido dar a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} hijos. Lo recibiremos junto con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. Pero ahora tenemos que sufrir con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, para que después también compartamos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.

sw.L: Na ikiwa [ni] watoto, basi [ni] warithi pia: warithi wa Mungu na warithi wenza wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, ikiwa kweli tunateseka pamoja [na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}] ili tutukuzwe pia pamoja [na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}].
sw.B: Ikiwa sisi ni watoto, basi sisi ni warithi pia. Sisi ni warithi wa Mungu, na tunarithi pamoja na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, ikiwa tunateseka pamoja naye ili tutukuzwe pia pamoja naye.
sw.R: Na kwa kuwa sisi ni watoto wa Mungu, tutapokea kila kitu ambacho Mungu ameahidi kuwapa watoto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Tutakipokea pamoja na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Lakini sasa ni lazima tuteseke pamoja naye, ili baadaye tushiriki pia utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

fr.L: Et si [nous sommes] enfants, [nous sommes] aussi héritiers : héritiers de Dieu et cohéritiers du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, si du moins nous souffrons avec [{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] afin d’être aussi glorifiés avec [{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}].
fr.B: Si nous sommes enfants, nous sommes aussi héritiers. Nous sommes héritiers de Dieu, et nous recevons l’héritage avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, si nous souffrons avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} pour être aussi glorifiés avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Et puisque nous sommes les enfants de Dieu, nous recevrons tout ce que Dieu a promis de donner à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} enfants. Nous le recevrons avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Mais nous devons souffrir avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} maintenant, pour avoir part aussi à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire plus tard.

ko.L: 자녀이면 또한 상속자입니다. 곧 하나님의 상속자요, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 함께 [한] 상속자입니다. 우리가 [그분과] 함께 고난을 받는다면 말입니다. 이는 우리가 또한 [그분과] 함께 영광을 받게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 우리가 자녀이면 상속자이기도 합니다. 우리는 하나님의 상속자이고, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 함께 상속을 받을 사람입니다. 우리가 그분과 함께 고난을 받는다면, 그분과 함께 영광도 받게 될 것입니다.
ko.R: 우리는 하나님의 자녀이기 때문에, 하나님께서 그분의 자녀들에게 주시기로 약속하신 모든 것을 받을 것입니다. 우리는 그것을 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 함께 받을 것입니다. 그러나 지금은 그분과 함께 고난을 받아야 합니다. 그래야 나중에 그분의 영광에도 함께 참여할 것입니다.

vi.L: Và nếu [chúng ta là] con cái, thì cũng là người thừa kế: người thừa kế của Đức Chúa Trời và người đồng thừa kế với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, nếu thật chúng ta cùng chịu khổ [với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] để chúng ta cũng được cùng tôn vinh [với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}].
vi.B: Nếu chúng ta là con cái, thì chúng ta cũng là người thừa kế. Chúng ta là người thừa kế của Đức Chúa Trời, và cùng thừa kế với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}, nếu chúng ta cùng chịu khổ với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để cũng được tôn vinh cùng với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Và vì chúng ta là con cái của Đức Chúa Trời, chúng ta sẽ nhận mọi điều Đức Chúa Trời đã hứa ban cho con cái {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Chúng ta sẽ nhận những điều ấy cùng với {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}. Nhưng bây giờ chúng ta phải cùng chịu khổ với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để sau này chúng ta cũng được dự phần vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: E, se [somos] filhos, [somos] também herdeiros: herdeiros de Deus e coerdeiros {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}, se de fato sofremos com [{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}] para que também sejamos glorificados com [{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}].
pt.B: Se somos filhos, somos também herdeiros. Somos herdeiros de Deus, e herdamos junto {{christos:com Cristo|com o Messias}}, se sofremos junto com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} para que também sejamos glorificados junto com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.R: E, como somos filhos de Deus, vamos receber tudo o que Deus prometeu dar aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} filhos. Vamos receber isso junto {{christos:com Cristo|com o Messias}}. Mas agora precisamos sofrer com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, para que mais tarde também participemos da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória.

am.L: ልጆች ከሆንን ደግሞ ወራሾች [ነን]፤ የእግዚአብሔር ወራሾች፣ {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሕ}} ጋርም አብረን ወራሾች ነን፤ ይኸውም [ከእርሱ ጋር] ደግሞ እንድንከብር [ከእርሱ ጋር] መከራ የምንቀበል ከሆነ ነው።
am.B: ልጆች ከሆንን ደግሞ ወራሾች ነን። የእግዚአብሔር ወራሾች ነን፤ {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሕ}} ጋርም አብረን እንወርሳለን፤ ይህም ከእርሱ ጋር አብረን እንድንከብር ከእርሱ ጋር አብረን መከራ የምንቀበል ከሆነ ነው።
am.R: የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ስለ ሆንን እግዚአብሔር ለልጆቹ ሊሰጥ ቃል የገባውን ሁሉ እንቀበላለን። ይህንንም {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሕ}} ጋር አብረን እንቀበላለን። ነገር ግን በኋላ ክብሩን እንድንካፈል አሁን ከእርሱ ጋር መከራ መቀበል አለብን።

ru.L: А если дети, то и наследники: наследники Бога и сонаследники {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}, если только мы страдаем с [{{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}], чтобы и прославиться с [{{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}].
ru.B: Если мы дети, то мы и наследники. Мы наследники Бога и наследуем вместе {{christos:со Христом|с Мессией}}, если страдаем вместе с {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, чтобы вместе с {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} и прославиться.
ru.R: И раз мы дети Бога, мы получим всё, что Бог обещал дать своим детям. Мы получим это вместе {{christos:со Христом|с Мессией}}. Но сейчас мы должны страдать вместе с {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, чтобы потом разделить и {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} славу.

hi.L: और यदि सन्तान हैं, तो वारिस भी: परमेश्वर के वारिस और मसीह के संगी वारिस, यदि हम सचमुच उनके साथ दुःख उठाएँ कि उनके साथ महिमा भी पाएँ।
hi.B: यदि हम सन्तान हैं, तो वारिस भी हैं। हम परमेश्वर के वारिस हैं, और मसीह के साथ मीरास पाते हैं, यदि हम उनके साथ दुःख उठाएँ ताकि उनके साथ महिमा भी पाएँ।
hi.R: और क्योंकि हम परमेश्वर की सन्तान हैं, इसलिए हम वह सब पाएँगे जो परमेश्वर ने अपनी सन्तान को देने की प्रतिज्ञा की है। हम उसे मसीह के साथ पाएँगे। पर अभी हमें उनके साथ दुःख उठाना है, ताकि बाद में हम उनकी महिमा में भी भागी हों।

uk.L: А якщо діти, то й спадкоємці: спадкоємці Божі і співспадкоємці {{christos:Христові|Месії}}, якщо справді ми страждаємо [з {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}], щоб і бути прославленими [з {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}].
uk.B: Якщо ми діти, то ми й спадкоємці. Ми Божі спадкоємці і разом із {{christos:Христом|Месією}} отримуємо спадщину, якщо ми страждаємо разом з {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, щоб разом з {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} і бути прославленими.
uk.R: А оскільки ми Божі діти, ми отримаємо все, що Бог пообіцяв дати своїм дітям. Ми отримаємо це разом із {{christos:Христом|Месією}}. Але тепер ми мусимо страждати з {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, щоб згодом мати частку і в {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} славі.

ja.L: そして、もし子どもであるなら、相続人でもあります。神の相続人であり、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}との共同相続人です。もし本当に、わたしたちが[その方と]共に苦しんでいるなら[です]。それは、[その方と]共に栄光を受けるためです。
ja.B: 子どもであるなら、相続人でもあります。わたしたちは神の相続人であり、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}と共に相続する者です。わたしたちが{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}と共に苦しんでいるなら、そうなのです。それは、共に栄光を受けるためです。
ja.R: わたしたちは神の子どもなので、神が子どもたちに与えると約束されたすべてのものを受け継ぎます。それを{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}と一緒に受け継ぐのです。でも今は、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}と共に苦しまなければなりません。それは、後で{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の栄光にもあずかるためです。

decisions.choice: heirs: those who will receive the inheritance
decisions.reason: Children inherit from their father. The inheritance God promised Abraham was the world (4:13); for believers it is the coming glory of verse 18 and the renewed creation of verse 21.

decisions.choice: if indeed we suffer with him: suffering with Christ is part of belonging to him
alternatives: a doubt whether they will suffer
decisions.reason: eiper (as in verse 9) states a condition Paul expects to be met. Those who share Christ's inheritance share his path, through suffering to glory.

decisions.choice: so that we may also be glorified with him: suffering leads to glory
decisions.reason: hina gives the purpose and goal: suffering with Christ is the road to sharing his glory, as verse 18 goes on to say.

decisions.choice: we will receive everything God has promised; share his glory later
decisions.reason: Readable explains what being an heir means (m1) and what being glorified with Christ means.

decisions.choice: pamoja naye, no span (B, R); [pamoja na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}] (L)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "naye", where the pronoun is joined to the conjunction and cannot take a capital, so there is no span where the English has "him". Literal brackets the supplied "with him" and writes the free pronoun "yeye", which takes the span.

decisions.choice: "상속자" (L, B); "함께 [한] 상속자" (L) / "함께 상속을 받을 사람" (B) for co-heirs
decisions.reason: "후사" is older church language; "상속자" is the modern legal word for one who will receive the inheritance (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "người thừa kế", "đồng thừa kế" (L), "cùng thừa kế" (B); "được tôn vinh" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Heirs are those who will receive the inheritance (m1); "thừa kế" is the plain legal word. "Tôn vinh" is the verb set for glorify in the style guide; Readable says "share his glory", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "相続人", "共同相続人" (L); "共に相続する者" (B); "受け継ぐ" (R)
decisions.reason: Children inherit from their father (m1). "相続人" is the everyday legal word; Readable turns the noun into the verb "受け継ぐ" and says what is inherited, as the English Readable does.

source.text: Λογίζομαι γὰρ ὅτι οὐκ ἄξια τὰ παθήματα τοῦ νῦν καιροῦ πρὸς τὴν μέλλουσαν δόξαν ἀποκαλυφθῆναι εἰς ἡμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: I reckon for that not worthy the sufferings of the now time toward the about-to-be glory to be revealed to us.

en.L: For I reckon that the sufferings of the present time [are] not worthy [to be set] against the coming glory to be revealed to us.
en.B: I have weighed it up: what we suffer in this present time does not begin to balance the glory that is going to be revealed to us.
en.R: We suffer now. But I am sure that our suffering is very small next to the glory God will show us in the future.

es.L: Porque estimo que los sufrimientos del tiempo actual no [son] de peso [comparados] con la gloria que va a ser revelada a nosotros.
es.B: Lo he pensado bien: lo que sufrimos en este tiempo presente ni siquiera empieza a igualar en peso la gloria que se nos va a revelar.
es.R: Ahora sufrimos. Pero estoy seguro de que nuestro sufrimiento es muy poca cosa al lado de la gloria que Dios nos mostrará en el futuro.

sw.L: Kwa maana ninaona kwamba mateso ya wakati uliopo [hayastahili] kulinganishwa na utukufu ujao utakaodhihirishwa kwetu.
sw.B: Nimelipima jambo hili: tunayoteseka katika wakati huu uliopo hayakaribii hata kidogo uzito wa utukufu utakaofunuliwa kwetu.
sw.R: Sasa tunateseka. Lakini nina hakika kwamba mateso yetu ni madogo sana ukilinganisha na utukufu ambao Mungu atatuonyesha baadaye.

fr.L: Car j’estime que les souffrances du temps présent ne sont pas dignes [d’être comparées] à la gloire à venir qui doit être révélée pour nous.
fr.B: Je l’ai bien pesé : ce que nous souffrons dans le temps présent ne fait pas le poids face à la gloire qui va nous être révélée.
fr.R: Nous souffrons maintenant. Mais je suis sûr que nos souffrances sont toutes petites à côté de la gloire que Dieu nous montrera à l’avenir.

ko.L: 내가 여기기로는, 현재의 고난들은 장차 우리에게 나타날 영광과 비교할 가치가 없습니다.
ko.B: 나는 이렇게 생각합니다. 지금 이때 우리가 겪는 고난은 앞으로 우리에게 나타날 영광에 비하면 견줄 것이 못 됩니다.
ko.R: 우리는 지금 고난을 겪고 있습니다. 그러나 나는 확신합니다. 우리의 고난은 하나님께서 앞으로 우리에게 보여 주실 영광에 비하면 아주 작은 것입니다.

vi.L: Vì tôi cho rằng những đau khổ của thời hiện tại không đáng [so sánh] với vinh quang sắp được bày tỏ cho chúng ta.
vi.B: Tôi đã cân nhắc kỹ: những đau khổ chúng ta chịu trong thời hiện tại chẳng đáng gì so với vinh quang sắp được bày tỏ cho chúng ta.
vi.R: Bây giờ chúng ta chịu khổ. Nhưng tôi chắc chắn rằng sự đau khổ của chúng ta thật nhỏ bé so với vinh quang mà Đức Chúa Trời sẽ cho chúng ta thấy trong tương lai.

pt.L: Pois calculo que os sofrimentos do tempo de agora não [têm] peso diante da glória que há de ser revelada a nós.
pt.B: Pesei bem isto: o que sofremos neste tempo presente nem chega perto de equilibrar a glória que vai ser revelada a nós.
pt.R: Nós sofremos agora. Mas tenho certeza de que o nosso sofrimento é muito pequeno perto da glória que Deus vai nos mostrar no futuro.

am.L: የአሁኑ ዘመን መከራ ለእኛ ሊገለጥ ካለው ክብር ጋር [ሊወዳደር] የማይገባው እንደ ሆነ እቆጥራለሁና።
am.B: ይህን መዝኜዋለሁ፤ በዚህ በአሁኑ ዘመን የምንቀበለው መከራ ለእኛ ሊገለጥ ካለው ክብር ጋር ሲነጻጸር ምንም አይደለም።
am.R: አሁን መከራ እንቀበላለን። ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ወደ ፊት ከሚያሳየን ክብር ጋር ሲነጻጸር መከራችን እጅግ ትንሽ እንደ ሆነ እርግጠኛ ነኝ።

ru.L: Ведь я считаю, что страдания нынешнего времени ничего не стоят в сравнении с будущей славой, которая откроется в нас.
ru.B: Я взвесил это: то, что мы страдаем в это нынешнее время, нельзя и сравнить со славой, которая будет нам открыта.
ru.R: Сейчас мы страдаем. Но я уверен, что наши страдания совсем малы по сравнению со славой, которую Бог покажет нам в будущем.

hi.L: क्योंकि मैं यह हिसाब लगाता हूँ कि इस वर्तमान समय के दुःख उस आनेवाली महिमा के सामने, जो हम पर प्रकट होगी, तुलना के योग्य नहीं हैं।
hi.B: मैंने इसे तौलकर देखा है: इस वर्तमान समय में जो दुःख हम सहते हैं, वे उस महिमा के सामने कुछ भी नहीं, जो हम पर प्रकट होनेवाली है।
hi.R: अभी हम दुःख उठाते हैं। पर मुझे पूरा भरोसा है कि हमारा दुःख उस महिमा के सामने बहुत छोटा है जो परमेश्वर भविष्य में हमें दिखाएँगे।

uk.L: Бо я вважаю, що страждання теперішнього часу не варті [порівняння] зі славою, яка має обʼявитися нам.
uk.B: Я все зважив: те, що ми терпимо в цей теперішній час, навіть близько не врівноважує слави, яка має відкритися нам.
uk.R: Тепер ми страждаємо. Але я певен, що наші страждання дуже малі порівняно зі славою, яку Бог покаже нам у майбутньому.

ja.L: というのは、今の時の苦しみは、これからわたしたちに現されようとしている栄光と[釣り合うだけの]価値がない、とわたしは考えるからです。
ja.B: よく考えて、わたしはこう結論しました。この今の時にわたしたちが受ける苦しみは、これからわたしたちに現される栄光とは、とても釣り合うものではありません。
ja.R: わたしたちは今、苦しんでいます。けれども、神がこれから見せてくださる栄光に比べれば、その苦しみはほんの小さなものだと、わたしは確信しています。

decisions.choice: not worthy: not of equal weight
decisions.reason: axios first meant "of equal weight" on a pair of scales. Set beside the coming glory, present sufferings weigh almost nothing (2 Corinthians 4:17).

decisions.choice: I reckon: I have thought it through and conclude
decisions.reason: logizomai is a word for careful reckoning, the same word as "counted" in chapter 4. Paul states a settled judgment.

decisions.choice: revealed to us: shown to us and given to us
decisions.reason: eis can mean "to", "toward" or "upon". The glory will be shown to believers and they will share it (verse 17); the passive leaves God as the one who reveals it.

decisions.choice: the present time: the time between Christ's coming and his return
