es.L: Porque a los que conoció de antemano, también los predestinó [a ser] configurados según la imagen de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo, a fin de que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} fuera primogénito en medio de muchos hermanos.
es.B: A los que Dios conoció de antemano, también los destinó de antemano a ser formados a imagen de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo, para que el Hijo fuera el primogénito en medio de muchos hermanos.
es.R: Desde mucho antes, Dios ya conocía a los que serían {{deity_pronoun:suyos|Suyos}}. Decidió entonces que llegarían a ser como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo. Así el Hijo sería el primero y el de más honor entre muchos hermanos.

sw.L: Kwa maana wale aliowajua kabla, aliwaamulia pia tangu awali [wawe] wenye kufanana na sura ya Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, ili {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} apate kuwa mzaliwa wa kwanza kati ya ndugu wengi.
sw.B: Wale ambao Mungu aliwajua tangu awali, aliwatenga pia tangu awali wafanywe kuwa na sura ya Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, ili Mwana awe mzaliwa wa kwanza kati ya ndugu wengi.
sw.R: Zamani sana, Mungu alikuwa tayari anawajua wale ambao wangekuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Aliamua wakati huo kwamba watafanywa kufanana kabisa na Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Hivyo Mwana angekuwa wa kwanza na mwenye heshima kuu kati ya ndugu wengi.

fr.L: Car ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a connus d’avance, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi prédestinés [à être] conformes à l’image de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils, pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} soit premier-né parmi beaucoup de {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}.
fr.B: Ceux que Dieu a connus d’avance, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi destinés d’avance à être façonnés à l’image de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils, pour que le Fils soit le premier-né parmi de nombreux {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}.
fr.R: Il y a longtemps, Dieu savait déjà qui seraient les {{deity_pronoun:siens|Siens}}. Il a décidé alors qu’ils deviendraient tout à fait semblables à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils. Ainsi, le Fils serait le premier, celui qui a le plus d’honneur, parmi beaucoup de {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}.

ko.L: 하나님께서는 미리 아신 사람들을 또한 그 아들의 형상과 같은 모습이 되도록 미리 정하셨습니다. 이는 그 아들이 많은 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 가운데서 맏아들이 되게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 하나님께서는 미리 아신 사람들을 또한 미리 정하셔서, 그분의 아들의 형상을 닮게 하셨습니다. 그것은 그 아들이 많은 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 가운데서 맏아들이 되게 하시려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 오래전에 이미 그분의 사람이 될 사람들을 아셨습니다. 그리고 그때 그들을 그분의 아들과 똑같이 만드시기로 정하셨습니다. 그래서 그 아들은 많은 {{gender:형제자매|형제}} 가운데서 가장 먼저 나시고 가장 높임을 받는 분이 되셨습니다.

vi.L: Vì những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã biết trước, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã định trước [để họ] trở nên giống như hình ảnh của Con {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm Con trưởng giữa nhiều {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}.
vi.B: Những người Đức Chúa Trời đã biết trước thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã định trước để họ được đổi nên giống hình ảnh của Con {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để Con trở thành Con trưởng giữa nhiều {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}.
vi.R: Từ rất lâu trước, Đức Chúa Trời đã biết những người sẽ thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngay từ lúc ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã quyết định rằng họ sẽ được làm cho giống hệt như Con của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Như vậy Con sẽ là anh cả, đứng đầu và được tôn trọng nhất giữa nhiều {{gender:anh chị em|anh em}}.

pt.L: Porque os que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} conheceu de antemão, também predestinou [para serem] conformes à imagem do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Filho, para que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} seja o primogênito entre muitos {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}.
pt.B: Aqueles que Deus conheceu de antemão, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} também marcou de antemão para serem moldados à imagem do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Filho, para que o Filho seja o primogênito entre muitos {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}.
pt.R: Muito tempo antes, Deus já conhecia aqueles que seriam {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}}. Ele decidiu, já naquele tempo, que eles seriam feitos iguais ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Filho. Assim o Filho seria o primeiro e o mais honrado entre muitos {{gender:irmãos e irmãs|irmãos}}.

am.L: ምክንያቱም አስቀድሞ ያወቃቸውን የልጁን መልክ እንዲመስሉ ደግሞ አስቀድሞ ወሰናቸው፤ ይኸውም እርሱ በብዙ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} መካከል በኩር እንዲሆን ነው።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር አስቀድሞ ያወቃቸውን የልጁን መልክ እንዲይዙ አስቀድሞ ለይቶ ወሰናቸው፤ ይህም ልጁ በብዙ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} መካከል በኩር እንዲሆን ነው።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ከብዙ ጊዜ በፊት የእርሱ የሚሆኑትን አወቀ። ያን ጊዜም ልክ እንደ ልጁ እንዲሆኑ ወሰነ። ስለዚህ ልጁ በብዙ {{gender:ወንድሞችና እኅቶች|ወንድሞች}} መካከል የመጀመሪያና እጅግ የተከበረ ይሆናል።

ru.L: Потому что кого {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} предузнал, тех и предопределил [быть] подобными образу {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} Сына, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} был первенцем среди многих {{gender:братьев и сестёр|братьев}}.
ru.B: Тех, кого Бог знал заранее, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} заранее и определил к тому, чтобы они стали подобны образу {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} Сына, чтобы Сын был первенцем среди многих {{gender:братьев и сестёр|братьев}}.
ru.R: Задолго до этого Бог уже знал тех, кто будет {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}. Тогда же {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} решил, что они станут такими же, как {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} Сын. Так Сын стал первым и самым почётным среди многих {{gender:братьев и сестёр|братьев}}.

hi.L: क्योंकि जिन्हें उन्होंने पहले से जाना, उन्हें पहले से ठहराया भी कि [वे] उनके पुत्र के स्वरूप में ढलें, ताकि [पुत्र] बहुत से {{gender:भाई-बहनों|भाइयों}} में पहिलौठे हों।
hi.B: जिन्हें परमेश्वर ने पहले से जाना, उन्हें उन्होंने पहले से यह भी ठहराया कि वे उनके पुत्र के स्वरूप में ढाले जाएँ, ताकि पुत्र बहुत से {{gender:भाई-बहनों|भाइयों}} में पहिलौठे हों।
hi.R: बहुत पहले ही परमेश्वर जानते थे कि कौन उनके होंगे। उन्होंने तभी तय कर दिया कि ये लोग बिलकुल उनके पुत्र जैसे बनाए जाएँगे। इस प्रकार पुत्र बहुत से {{gender:भाई-बहनों|भाइयों}} में पहले और सबसे आदरणीय होंगे।

uk.L: Бо кого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наперед пізнав, тих {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} і наперед визначив [бути] подібними до образу свого Сина, щоб {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} був первістком серед багатьох {{gender:братів і сестер|братів}}.
uk.B: Тих, кого Бог знав заздалегідь, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} і заздалегідь визначив, щоб вони набули образу свого Сина, аби Син був первістком серед багатьох {{gender:братів і сестер|братів}}.
uk.R: Ще задовго до того Бог уже знав тих, хто буде {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}}. Тоді ж {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} вирішив, що вони стануть такими, як {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} Син. Так Син буде першим і найшанованішим серед багатьох {{gender:братів і сестер|братів}}.

ja.L: なぜなら、神は前もって知っておられた者たちを、御子のかたちと同じ姿にしようと、あらかじめ定められたからです。それは、御子が多くの{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}の中で長子となるためでした。
ja.B: 神は、前もって知っておられた人たちを、御子と同じかたちに変えようと、前もって定めておられました。それは、御子が多くの{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}の中で長子となるためです。
ja.R: ずっと前から、神はご自分のものとなる人たちを知っておられました。そしてそのとき、その人たちを御子とそっくりな者にすると決められたのです。こうして御子は、多くの{{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}の中で、最初の、最も尊ばれる方となります。

decisions.choice: foreknew: knew and chose beforehand, in a relationship
alternatives: knew in advance what people would do
decisions.reason: In the Bible God's "knowing" people often means choosing them and setting his love on them (Amos 3:2). Paul uses the same verb of Israel in 11:2, "his people whom he foreknew".

decisions.choice: predestined: decided beforehand, marked out in advance
decisions.reason: proorizō is to set a boundary or decide something ahead of time. Here God decides beforehand what those he knew will become: like his Son.

decisions.choice: conformed to the image of his Son: sharing the Son's form and glory
decisions.reason: The phrase includes the change of character that begins now (2 Corinthians 3:18) and the glorified body to come (Philippians 3:21, the same word). Humans were made in God's image (Genesis 1:27); the Son is that image (2 Corinthians 4:4).

decisions.choice: firstborn: first in time and first in rank
decisions.reason: The firstborn had the place of honor and the double share (Psalm 89:28 in Hebrew numbering, of the king). Christ is also the first to rise from the dead (Colossians 1:18), and others will follow him.

decisions.choice: brothers: the members of God's family, women and men
decisions.reason: Those conformed to the Son become his brothers and sisters, God's family.

decisions.choice: {{gender:brothers and sisters|brothers}}
decisions.reason: The inclusive default names the whole family (m5); the traditional setting keeps "brothers".

decisions.choice: knew beforehand, marked out beforehand (B); decided then (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say in plain words what the two verbs mean (m1, m2). Literal keeps the traditional words.

decisions.choice: the first and most honored
decisions.reason: Readable explains what "firstborn" means here (m4).

decisions.choice: conoció de antemano, predestinó (L); conoció de antemano, destinó de antemano (B)
decisions.reason: As in 11:2 ("conoció de antemano") and Ephesians 1:5 ("predestinado" at Literal, "de antemano nos destinó" at Balanced). Balanced repeats "de antemano" so the two verbs are heard as a pair, as the English Balanced does with "beforehand". "Hermanos" has no gender setting (see verse 12).

decisions.choice: aliowajua kabla, aliwaamulia tangu awali (L); aliwajua tangu awali, aliwatenga tangu awali (B)
alternatives: aliowajua tangu asili, aliwachagua tangu asili
decisions.reason: As in 11:2 ("aliowajua kabla", "aliowajua tangu awali") and Ephesians 1:5 ("kutuamulia tangu awali" at Literal, "alitutenga tangu awali" at Balanced). Balanced repeats "tangu awali" so the two verbs are heard as a pair. "Ndugu" has no gender setting (see verse 12).

decisions.choice: "맏아들" (L, B); "가장 먼저 나시고 가장 높임을 받는 분" (R); "{{gender:형제자매|형제}}" for the many brothers
decisions.reason: Firstborn means first in time and first in rank (meaning decision); "맏아들" is the plain Korean word, said of the Son, so it takes no gender span. The many brothers are God's family, women and men, as the setting shows.

decisions.choice: "미리 알다" and "미리 정하다" at every level (R: "오래전에 이미 ... 아셨다", "그때 ... 정하셨다")
decisions.reason: "예지" and "예정" are technical terms; the plain verbs keep both senses (meaning decisions) and stay readable.

decisions.choice: "biết trước", "định trước" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Foreknew is knowing and choosing beforehand (m1), predestined is deciding beforehand (m2). "Định trước" says what the verb says; "tiền định" is a doctrinal term that brings in later debates.

decisions.choice: "Con trưởng" (L, B); "anh cả, đứng đầu" (R)
decisions.reason: Firstborn means first in time and first in rank (m4). "Con trưởng" is the word in the Vietnamese Colossians (1:15, 1:18). Readable says "anh cả", the eldest brother, which fits the family picture of many brothers and sisters.

decisions.choice: {{gender:братьев и сестёр|братьев}}
decisions.reason: The whole family of God, women and men (m5), inflected inside each option.

decisions.choice: предузнал; предопределил
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the traditional words; Balanced and Readable say what they mean (m1, m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: {{gender:भाई-बहनों|भाइयों}}
decisions.reason: The members of God's family, women and men (meaning decision m5), in the oblique form the style guide gives for adelphoi.
The Son and the believers would both be "वे" in Hindi, the Son by the honorific plural; Literal supplies "the Son" in brackets so the reader knows who is the firstborn, and Balanced names him.

decisions.choice: наперед визначив (L); заздалегідь визначив (B)
decisions.reason: proorizō is marking out beforehand (m2); "визначив" says that the outcome is fixed, where "призначив" would suggest an appointment to an office. Kept in 8:30.

decisions.choice: {{gender:きょうだいたち|兄弟たち}}
decisions.reason: As in the English, the inclusive default names the whole of God's family, women and men (m5), and the traditional setting keeps "兄弟たち".

decisions.choice: "あらかじめ定められた" (L), "前もって定めておられました" (B), "決められた" (R); "長子" (L, B), "最初の、最も尊ばれる方" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is deciding beforehand (m2); "予定" now means an appointment in everyday Japanese, so it is avoided. "長子" is the eldest son with the place of honor (m4); Readable says what that means, as the English Readable does.

source.text: οὓς δὲ προώρισεν, τούτους καὶ ἐκάλεσεν· καὶ οὓς ἐκάλεσεν, τούτους καὶ ἐδικαίωσεν· οὓς δὲ ἐδικαίωσεν, τούτους καὶ ἐδόξασεν.

records.literal_gloss: Whom and he predestined, these also he called; and whom he called, these also he justified; whom and he justified, these also he glorified.

en.L: And those whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} predestined, these {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also called; and those whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called, these {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also justified; and those whom {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} justified, these {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also glorified.
en.B: And those {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} marked out beforehand, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also called. Those {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also declared righteous. And those {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} declared righteous, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also glorified.
en.R: Those God decided on ahead of time, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also called. Those {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also put right with {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. And those {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} put right with {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also gave a share in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.

es.L: Y a quienes predestinó, a esos también los llamó; y a quienes llamó, a esos también los justificó; y a quienes justificó, a esos también los glorificó.
es.B: Y a quienes destinó de antemano, también los llamó. A quienes llamó, también los justificó. Y a quienes justificó, también los glorificó.
es.R: A quienes Dios había señalado de antemano, también los llamó. A quienes llamó, también los declaró justos. Y a quienes declaró justos, también les dio parte en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.

sw.L: Na wale aliowaamulia tangu awali, hao pia aliwaita; na wale aliowaita, hao pia aliwahesabia haki; na wale aliowahesabia haki, hao pia aliwatukuza.
sw.B: Na wale aliowatenga tangu awali, aliwaita pia. Wale aliowaita, aliwahesabia haki pia. Na wale aliowahesabia haki, aliwatukuza pia.
sw.R: Wale ambao Mungu aliamua juu yao tangu awali, aliwaita pia. Wale aliowaita, aliwahesabia haki, akawaweka katika uhusiano mwema naye. Na wale aliowahesabia haki, aliwapa pia sehemu katika utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

fr.L: Et ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prédestinés, ceux-là {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi appelés ; et ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a appelés, ceux-là {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi justifiés ; et ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a justifiés, ceux-là {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi glorifiés.
fr.B: Et ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a destinés d’avance, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi appelés. Ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a appelés, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi justifiés. Et ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a justifiés, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi glorifiés.
fr.R: Ceux que Dieu a choisis d’avance, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi appelés. Ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a appelés, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a aussi déclarés justes. Et ceux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a déclarés justes, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a aussi donné une part de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.

ko.L: 그리고 미리 정하신 사람들을 또한 부르셨고, 부르신 사람들을 또한 의롭다고 인정하셨고, 의롭다고 인정하신 사람들을 또한 영화롭게 하셨습니다.
ko.B: 하나님께서는 미리 정하신 사람들을 부르셨고, 부르신 사람들을 의롭다고 인정하셨으며, 의롭다고 인정하신 사람들에게 영광을 주셨습니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 미리 정하신 사람들을 부르셨습니다. 부르신 사람들을 의롭다고 인정해 주셨습니다. 그리고 의롭다고 인정해 주신 사람들에게 그분의 영광을 함께 나누어 주셨습니다.

vi.L: Và những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định trước, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã gọi; và những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã gọi, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã xưng công chính; và những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã xưng công chính, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã tôn vinh.
vi.B: Những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã định trước, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã kêu gọi. Những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã kêu gọi, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã xưng công chính. Và những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã xưng công chính, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã tôn vinh.
vi.R: Những người Đức Chúa Trời đã chọn từ trước, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng đã kêu gọi. Những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã kêu gọi, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng công nhận là công chính. Và những người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã công nhận là công chính, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng cho dự phần vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: E os que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} predestinou, a esses também chamou; e os que chamou, a esses também justificou; e os que justificou, a esses também glorificou.
pt.B: E aqueles que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} marcou de antemão, também chamou. Aqueles que chamou, também declarou justos. E aqueles que declarou justos, também glorificou.
pt.R: Aqueles que Deus escolheu antes, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} também chamou. Aqueles que chamou, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} também aceitou como justos. E aqueles que aceitou como justos, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} também fez participar da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória.

am.L: አስቀድሞ የወሰናቸውንም እነዚህን ደግሞ ጠራቸው፤ የጠራቸውንም እነዚህን ደግሞ አጸደቃቸው፤ ያጸደቃቸውንም እነዚህን ደግሞ አከበራቸው።
am.B: አስቀድሞ ለይቶ የወሰናቸውንም ደግሞ ጠራቸው። የጠራቸውን ደግሞ አጸደቃቸው። ያጸደቃቸውንም ደግሞ አከበራቸው።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር አስቀድሞ የወሰነላቸውን ደግሞ ጠራቸው። የጠራቸውን ደግሞ ከራሱ ጋር ትክክለኛ ግንኙነት እንዲኖራቸው አደረገ። ከራሱ ጋር ያስተካከላቸውንም ደግሞ ክብሩን አካፈላቸው።

ru.L: А кого {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} предопределил, тех и призвал; а кого призвал, тех и оправдал; а кого оправдал, тех и прославил.
ru.B: И тех, кого {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} заранее определил, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} и призвал. Тех, кого {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} призвал, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} и оправдал. А тех, кого {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} оправдал, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} и прославил.
ru.R: Тех, кого Бог выбрал заранее, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} и призвал. Тех, кого {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} призвал, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} и оправдал перед собой. А тех, кого {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} оправдал, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} и сделал участниками своей славы.

hi.L: फिर जिन्हें उन्होंने पहले से ठहराया, उन्हें बुलाया भी; और जिन्हें बुलाया, उन्हें धर्मी भी ठहराया; और जिन्हें धर्मी ठहराया, उन्हें महिमा भी दी।
hi.B: और जिन्हें उन्होंने पहले से ठहराया, उन्हें बुलाया भी। जिन्हें बुलाया, उन्हें धर्मी भी ठहराया। और जिन्हें धर्मी ठहराया, उन्हें महिमा भी दी।
hi.R: जिन्हें परमेश्वर ने पहले से चुन लिया, उन्हें उन्होंने बुलाया भी। जिन्हें बुलाया, उन्हें अपनी दृष्टि में सही भी ठहराया। और जिन्हें अपनी दृष्टि में सही ठहराया, उन्हें अपनी महिमा में भागी भी बनाया।

uk.L: А кого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} наперед визначив, тих {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} і покликав; і кого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} покликав, тих {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} і виправдав; а кого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} виправдав, тих {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} і прославив.
uk.B: А тих, кого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} заздалегідь визначив, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} і покликав. Тих, кого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} покликав, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} і виправдав. А тих, кого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} виправдав, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} і прославив.
uk.R: Тих, про кого Бог вирішив заздалегідь, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} і покликав. Тих, кого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} покликав, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} і виправдав: визнав їх праведними перед собою. А тих, кого {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} виправдав, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} і зробив учасниками своєї слави.

ja.L: 神があらかじめ定めた者たち、この者たちを神は召しもし、召した者たち、この者たちを義ともし、義とした者たち、この者たちに栄光も与えられました。
ja.B: 神は、前もって定めた人たちを召してくださいました。召した人たちを義としてくださいました。そして、義とした人たちには、栄光を与えてくださいました。
ja.R: 神は、前もって決めておられた人たちを召してくださいました。召した人たちを、正しい者と認めてくださいました。そして、正しい者と認めた人たちに、ご自分の栄光を分け与えてくださいました。

decisions.choice: called: God's call that brings people to himself
alternatives: an invitation that may be refused
decisions.reason: In Paul "called" means God's effective call through the gospel, which brings people to faith (1:6-7, 9:24; 1 Corinthians 1:24).

decisions.choice: justified: declared righteous by God
decisions.reason: dikaioō is the verb of 3:24-26 and 5:1: God declares the ungodly righteous through faith in Christ (4:5).

decisions.choice: glorified: a future glory spoken of as already done
decisions.reason: Glory is still to be revealed (verses 17-18, 21). Paul uses the past tense because, in God's purpose, it is as certain as the calling and justifying that have already happened.

decisions.choice: declared righteous
decisions.reason: Balanced says what "justify" means (m2), as elsewhere in Romans.

decisions.choice: put right with himself; gave a share in his glory
decisions.reason: Readable says "put right with himself" for justify, as in 3:24-26, and explains "glorified" as being given a share in God's glory (m3).

decisions.choice: justificó (L, B); declaró justos (R)
decisions.reason: As settled at 2:13 and used in 3:24-30 and 4:2, Literal and Balanced keep "justificar", and Readable says "declarar justo", the verdict the word describes (m2). The same holds in verse 33. Spanish marks God only in the verbs here, so it has no deity_pronoun spans where the English has "he".

decisions.choice: aliwahesabia haki (every level; R adds akawaweka katika uhusiano mwema naye)
decisions.reason: "Kuhesabiwa haki" is the settled phrase for this verb in Romans and is kept at every level, here and in verse 33; Readable adds what it means, in the words of 4:1 R, where the English Readable says "put right with himself". The past tense of "glorified" is kept, as the meaning decision explains (m3).

decisions.choice: "의롭다고 인정하다" at every level, as through the letter; "영화롭게 하다" (L); "영광을 주다" (B); "영광을 함께 나누어 주다" (R)
decisions.reason: Glorified is a future glory spoken of as already done (meaning decision); Korean keeps the past tense at every level. "영광" is the key-term word.

decisions.choice: "xưng công chính" (L, B), "công nhận là công chính" (R); "tôn vinh" (L, B), "cho dự phần vinh quang" (R)
decisions.reason: The verbs settled for justify at 2:13 and for glorify in the style guide. The past tense of "glorified" is kept (m3), though the glory is still to come.

decisions.choice: one pronoun for a chain of verbs
decisions.reason: Portuguese shows the subject in the verb, so Literal and Balanced write "ele" (with its span) once and let the chain of verbs follow, where English repeats "he" in every clause. Readable repeats it at the head of each clause for clarity. Readable says "aceitou como justos" for justify, as in 5:1.

decisions.choice: "አጸደቃቸው" (he justified them, L, B); "ከራሱ ጋር ትክክለኛ ግንኙነት እንዲኖራቸው አደረገ" (he gave them a right relationship with himself, R)
alternatives: "ጻድቃን ብሎ አወጃቸው" (declared them righteous) at Balanced
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the church word "ማጽደቅ" for God's verdict, as through Romans; Readable says what the verdict does, following the English Readable ("put right with himself"), here and in 8:33.

decisions.choice: оправдал
decisions.reason: Key term, as in 2:13: "оправдать" at every level.

decisions.choice: "अपनी दृष्टि में सही ठहराया" (R); "धर्मी ठहराया" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Readable says what being justified means, declared right in God's sight (meaning decision m2), here and in 8:33; Literal and Balanced keep the key term.

decisions.choice: виправдав at every level; Readable adds "визнав їх праведними перед собою"
alternatives: "визнав праведними" alone at Balanced, as the English says "declared righteous"
decisions.reason: The Ukrainian brief keeps "виправдати" at every level in Romans, so the link with 3:24-5:1 is not lost; Readable explains the word once here instead of replacing it (m2).

decisions.choice: "義とし" (L, B), "正しい者と認めて" (R); "栄光も与えられました" in the past tense at every level
decisions.reason: The Romans terms give "義とする" (L, B) and "正しい者と認める" (R) for justify (m2). The honorific "義とされ" would read as a passive, so God's actions take "くださる" or the plain form inside the chain. Paul uses the past tense for the glory still to come because it is certain in God's purpose (m3), and every level keeps it.

source.text: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν πρὸς ταῦτα;

records.literal_gloss: What then will we say to these [things]?

en.L: What then will we say to these things?
en.B: So what is our response to all this?
en.R: So what can we say about all this?

es.L: ¿Qué diremos entonces frente a estas cosas?
es.B: Entonces, ¿cuál es nuestra respuesta a todo esto?
es.R: Entonces, ¿qué podemos decir de todo esto?

sw.L: Basi tutasema nini kwa mambo haya?
sw.B: Basi, tujibu nini kuhusu haya yote?
sw.R: Basi tunaweza kusema nini kuhusu mambo haya yote?

fr.L: Que dirons-nous donc devant ces choses ?
fr.B: Que répondre donc à tout cela ?
fr.R: Alors, que pouvons-nous dire de tout cela ?

ko.L: 그러면 이 일들에 대하여 우리가 무엇이라고 말하겠습니까?
ko.B: 그렇다면 이 모든 일에 대해 우리는 무엇이라고 답하겠습니까?
ko.R: 그러면 이 모든 일에 대해 우리가 무슨 말을 할 수 있겠습니까?

vi.L: Vậy chúng ta sẽ nói gì về những điều này?
vi.B: Vậy chúng ta đáp lại thế nào trước tất cả những điều này?
vi.R: Vậy chúng ta có thể nói gì về tất cả những điều này?

pt.L: Que diremos, então, diante destas coisas?
pt.B: O que, então, vamos responder a tudo isso?
pt.R: Então, o que podemos dizer sobre tudo isso?

am.L: እንግዲህ ለእነዚህ ነገሮች ምን እንላለን?
am.B: ታዲያ ለዚህ ሁሉ ምላሻችን ምንድን ነው?
am.R: ታዲያ ስለዚህ ሁሉ ምን ማለት እንችላለን?

ru.L: Что же скажем на это?
ru.B: Что же нам сказать на всё это?
ru.R: Что же мы скажем на всё это?

hi.L: तो हम इन बातों के विषय में क्या कहें?
hi.B: तो इन सब बातों का हमारा उत्तर क्या है?
hi.R: तो इन सब बातों के बारे में हम क्या कह सकते हैं?

uk.L: Що ж тоді скажемо на це?
uk.B: Тож як нам відповісти на все це?
uk.R: Що ж ми можемо сказати про все це?

ja.L: それでは、これらのことに対して、わたしたちは何と言うのでしょうか？
ja.B: それでは、これらのことについて、わたしたちは何と言うべきでしょうか？
ja.R: では、これらのことについて、わたしたちは何と言えばよいでしょうか？

decisions.choice: these things: everything Paul has said, especially in chapter 8
decisions.reason: Paul often asks "What then will we say?" to draw a conclusion (4:1, 6:1). Here he answers with the questions of verses 31-35.

source.text: εἰ ὁ θεὸς ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν, τίς καθ’ ἡμῶν;

records.literal_gloss: If the God for us, who against us?

en.L: If God [is] for us, who [is] against us?
en.B: If God is on our side, who can stand against us?
en.R: If God is on our side, no one can win against us.

es.L: Si Dios [está] a favor de nosotros, ¿quién [estará] contra nosotros?
es.B: Si Dios está de nuestro lado, ¿quién puede hacernos frente?
es.R: Si Dios está de nuestro lado, nadie puede vencernos.

sw.L: Ikiwa Mungu [yuko] kwa ajili yetu, ni nani [aliye] dhidi yetu?
sw.B: Ikiwa Mungu yuko upande wetu, ni nani anayeweza kusimama dhidi yetu?
sw.R: Ikiwa Mungu yuko upande wetu, hakuna mtu anayeweza kutushinda.

fr.L: Si Dieu [est] pour nous, qui [est] contre nous ?
fr.B: Si Dieu est de notre côté, qui pourra se dresser contre nous ?
fr.R: Si Dieu est de notre côté, personne ne pourra gagner contre nous.

ko.L: 하나님께서 우리를 위하시면, 누가 우리를 대적하겠습니까?
ko.B: 하나님께서 우리 편이시면, 누가 우리를 대적할 수 있겠습니까?
ko.R: 하나님께서 우리 편이시니, 아무도 우리를 이길 수 없습니다.

vi.L: Nếu Đức Chúa Trời vì chúng ta, ai chống lại chúng ta?
vi.B: Nếu Đức Chúa Trời đứng về phía chúng ta, ai có thể chống lại chúng ta?
vi.R: Nếu Đức Chúa Trời đứng về phía chúng ta, thì không ai có thể thắng được chúng ta.

pt.L: Se Deus [é] por nós, quem [é] contra nós?
pt.B: Se Deus está do nosso lado, quem pode se levantar contra nós?
pt.R: Se Deus está do nosso lado, ninguém pode nos vencer.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ለእኛ [ከሆነ] ማን በእኛ ላይ [ይሆናል]?
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ከጎናችን ከሆነ ማን ሊቋቋመን ይችላል?
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ከጎናችን ከሆነ ማንም ሊያሸንፈን አይችልም።

ru.L: Если Бог за нас, кто против нас?
ru.B: Если Бог на нашей стороне, кто устоит против нас?
ru.R: Если Бог на нашей стороне, никто не сможет победить нас.

hi.L: यदि परमेश्वर हमारी ओर हैं, तो हमारा विरोधी कौन [है]?
hi.B: यदि परमेश्वर हमारी ओर हैं, तो कौन हमारे विरुद्ध खड़ा हो सकता है?
hi.R: यदि परमेश्वर हमारी ओर हैं, तो कोई हम पर जीत नहीं पा सकता।

uk.L: Якщо Бог за нас, хто проти нас?
uk.B: Якщо Бог на нашому боці, хто встоїть проти нас?
uk.R: Якщо Бог на нашому боці, ніхто не зможе нас перемогти.

ja.L: もし神がわたしたちのために[おられる]なら、だれがわたしたちに逆らう[でしょう]か？
ja.B: 神がわたしたちの味方であるなら、だれがわたしたちに立ち向かえるでしょうか？
ja.R: 神がわたしたちの味方なのですから、わたしたちに勝てる者はだれもいません。

decisions.choice: if: since God is for us
alternatives: a real doubt whether God is for us
decisions.reason: Paul states a condition he holds to be true, as verse 32 shows.

decisions.choice: who is against us: no one who can prevail
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer "no one". Believers do have enemies (verses 35-36), but none who can stand against God.

decisions.choice: no one can win against us
decisions.reason: Readable states the answer the question expects (m2).

source.text: ὅς γε τοῦ ἰδίου υἱοῦ οὐκ ἐφείσατο, ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν πάντων παρέδωκεν αὐτόν, πῶς οὐχὶ καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα ἡμῖν χαρίσεται;

records.literal_gloss: Who indeed the own Son not spared, but for us all handed over him, how not also with him the all things to us will he freely give?

en.L: He who indeed did not spare {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own Son but handed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over for us all, how will {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} not also with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} freely give us all things?
en.B: God did not hold back even {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own Son, but handed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} over for us all. How could {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} fail, then, to give us everything along with {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} as a free gift?
en.R: God did not keep back {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own Son. He gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} up to die for all of us. So we can be sure that God will also give us everything else, along with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Son.

es.L: Aquel que de hecho no se reservó a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio Hijo, sino que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} entregó a favor de todos nosotros, ¿cómo no va a darnos también gratuitamente, junto con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, todas las cosas?
es.B: Dios no se guardó ni siquiera a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio Hijo, sino que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} entregó por todos nosotros. ¿Cómo podría, entonces, dejar de darnos con {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} todo lo demás como un regalo?
es.R: Dios no se quedó con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio Hijo. Lo entregó para que muriera por todos nosotros. Así que podemos estar seguros de que Dios también nos dará todo lo demás, junto con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo.

sw.L: Yeye ambaye hakumzuilia hata Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe, bali alimkabidhi kwa ajili yetu sote, je, hatatupa pia bure vitu vyote pamoja na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}?
sw.B: Mungu hakumzuilia hata Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe, bali alimkabidhi kwa ajili yetu sote. Basi angewezaje kukosa kutupa kila kitu pamoja naye kama zawadi ya bure?
sw.R: Mungu hakumzuilia Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe. Alimtoa afe kwa ajili yetu sote. Kwa hiyo tunaweza kuwa na uhakika kwamba Mungu atatupa pia kila kitu kingine, pamoja na Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

fr.L: Lui qui n’a pas épargné {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre Fils, mais qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a livré pour nous tous, comment ne nous donnera-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pas aussi gracieusement toutes choses avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ?
fr.B: Dieu n’a pas même épargné {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre Fils, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a livré pour nous tous. Comment donc pourrait-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne pas nous donner aussi tout avec {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, comme un don gratuit ?
fr.R: Dieu n’a pas refusé de donner {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre Fils. Il {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a livré à la mort pour nous tous. Alors nous pouvons être sûrs que Dieu nous donnera aussi tout le reste, avec {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils.

ko.L: 자기 아들을 아끼지 않으시고 우리 모두를 위하여 그분을 넘겨주신 분께서, 어찌 그 아들과 함께 모든 것을 우리에게 은혜로 주시지 않겠습니까?
ko.B: 하나님께서는 자기 아들까지도 아끼지 않으시고 우리 모두를 위해 내주셨습니다. 그런데 어떻게 그 아들과 함께 모든 것을 우리에게 거저 주시지 않겠습니까?
ko.R: 하나님께서는 그분의 아들까지도 아끼지 않으셨습니다. 우리 모두를 위해 그 아들을 죽음에 내주셨습니다. 그러니 하나님께서 그 아들과 함께 다른 모든 것도 우리에게 주실 것이 분명합니다.

vi.L: Đấng đã không tiếc chính Con của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nhưng đã phó {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vì tất cả chúng ta, làm sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại không cùng với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} rộng ban cho chúng ta mọi sự?
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời đã không tiếc ngay cả chính Con của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nhưng đã phó Con vì tất cả chúng ta. Vậy làm sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại không ban cho chúng ta mọi sự cùng với Con như một món quà của ân điển?
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời đã không giữ lại chính Con của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài đã để Con chịu chết vì tất cả chúng ta. Vậy chúng ta có thể chắc chắn rằng Đức Chúa Trời cũng sẽ ban cho chúng ta mọi điều khác, cùng với Con của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: Aquele que não poupou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio Filho, mas {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} entregou por todos nós, como não nos dará também com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, de graça, todas as coisas?
pt.B: Deus não reteve nem o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio Filho, mas {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} entregou por todos nós. Como deixaria, então, de nos dar de presente todas as coisas junto com {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}?
pt.R: Deus não guardou para si o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} próprio Filho. Ele {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} entregou para morrer por todos nós. Por isso podemos ter certeza de que Deus também vai nos dar todas as outras coisas, junto com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} Filho.

am.L: የገዛ ልጁን ያልራራለት፣ ነገር ግን ስለ ሁላችን አሳልፎ የሰጠው፣ እንዴት ከእርሱ ጋር ደግሞ ሁሉን ነገር በጸጋ አይሰጠንም?
am.B: እግዚአብሔር የገዛ ልጁን እንኳ አልከለከለም፤ ይልቁንም ስለ ሁላችን አሳልፎ ሰጠው። ታዲያ ከእርሱ ጋር ሁሉን ነገር በነጻ ስጦታ አድርጎ እንዴት አይሰጠንም?
am.R: እግዚአብሔር የገዛ ልጁን አልከለከለም። ስለ ሁላችን እንዲሞት አሳልፎ ሰጠው። ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር ከልጁ ጋር ሌላውንም ሁሉ ደግሞ እንደሚሰጠን እርግጠኞች መሆን እንችላለን።

ru.L: Тот, кто не пощадил своего Сына, но предал {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} за всех нас, как не подарит нам с {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} и всего?
ru.B: Бог не пожалел даже своего Сына, но отдал {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} за всех нас. Как же {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} может не подарить нам вместе с {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} и всего остального?
ru.R: Бог не удержал у себя своего Сына. Он отдал {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} на смерть за всех нас. Поэтому мы можем быть уверены, что Бог даст нам и всё остальное вместе со своим Сыном.

hi.L: जिन्होंने अपने निज पुत्र को भी न रख छोड़ा, परंतु उन्हें हम सब के लिए सौंप दिया, वे उनके साथ हमें और सब कुछ अनुग्रह से क्यों न देंगे?
hi.B: परमेश्वर ने अपने पुत्र को भी नहीं रोक रखा, बल्कि उन्हें हम सब के लिए सौंप दिया। तो वे उनके साथ हमें सब कुछ मुफ़्त वरदान के रूप में क्यों न देंगे?
hi.R: परमेश्वर ने अपने पुत्र को भी अपने पास नहीं रख लिया। उन्होंने उन्हें हम सब के लिए मरने को दे दिया। इसलिए हम निश्चित हो सकते हैं कि परमेश्वर अपने पुत्र के साथ हमें बाक़ी सब कुछ भी देंगे।

uk.L: Той, хто навіть власного Сина не пощадив, а передав {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} за нас усіх, як же {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} не подарує нам разом з {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} і всього?
uk.B: Бог не пожалів навіть свого власного Сина, а передав {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} за нас усіх. Тож хіба {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} може не дати нам разом з {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}} усього як дар?
uk.R: Бог не пошкодував навіть свого власного Сина. Він віддав {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} на смерть за всіх нас. Тож ми можемо бути певні, що Бог дасть нам і все інше разом зі своїм Сином.

ja.L: 実に、ご自分の御子を惜しむことなく、わたしたちすべてのために引き渡された方が、御子と共にすべてのものを、どうしてわたしたちに恵みとして与えてくださらないでしょうか？
ja.B: 神は、ご自分の御子さえ手もとに留めておかず、わたしたちすべてのために引き渡されました。それなら、御子と共に、ほかのすべてのものも恵みとして与えてくださらないはずがあるでしょうか？
ja.R: 神は、ご自分の御子さえ手放されました。わたしたちみんなのために、御子を死に渡されたのです。ですから、神が御子と一緒に、ほかのすべてのものもわたしたちに与えてくださることは、確かです。

decisions.choice: did not spare his own Son: as Abraham did not withhold Isaac
decisions.reason: In the Greek Old Testament the angel says to Abraham, "you did not spare your beloved son" (Genesis 22:12, 16), with the same verb. What Abraham was spared, God did.

decisions.choice: handed over: gave up to death
decisions.reason: paradidōmi is the verb of 4:25, "handed over because of our trespasses", and of the passion accounts. God gave his Son over to die.

decisions.choice: freely give: give as an act of grace
decisions.reason: charizomai is to give freely, from the same root as grace. If God gave the greatest gift, he will give the rest.

decisions.choice: a question expecting "he certainly will"
decisions.reason: Paul argues from the greater to the lesser: the question means that God will certainly give believers everything with his Son.

decisions.choice: gave him up to die
decisions.reason: Readable says what "handed over" means (m2).

decisions.choice: So we can be sure that God will also give us everything
alternatives: how will he not also give us all things?
decisions.reason: Readable states the answer the question expects (m4).

decisions.choice: no se reservó (L); no se guardó (B); nos dará gratuitamente (L); como un regalo (B)
decisions.reason: To "spare" here is to hold back for oneself, as Abraham did not withhold Isaac (m1). "No se reservó" and "no se guardó" say that plainly, where "no perdonó" would be heard as "did not forgive". The giving is an act of grace (m3), so Literal adds "gratuitamente" and Balanced "como un regalo".

decisions.choice: hakumzuilia (did not withhold); alimkabidhi (handed over)
decisions.reason: "Kuzuilia" is to keep something back from someone, which is the sense of "not spare" (m1). "Kukabidhi" is to hand a person over to others, the sense of the verb (m2); Readable says plainly that he gave him up to die. "Mwana wake mwenyewe" (his own Son): "mwenyewe" goes with the Son here and takes no span.

decisions.choice: "넘겨주다" (L); "내주다" (B); "죽음에 내주다" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one rendered "넘겨주다" at 1:24 and "넘겨지다" at 4:25; here it means giving up to death (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "phó" (L, B); "để ... chịu chết" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is handed over, gave up to death (m2), with God as the one who hands over, as in 1:24, so "phó"; Readable says that he let his Son die, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Con" named (B, R) where the Greek says "him"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "Ngài" would stand for both God and the Son in one sentence, so Balanced and Readable name the Son, as in 3:25.

decisions.choice: "恵みとして与えてくださる"
decisions.reason: The verb is to give freely, from the same root as grace (m3), so Literal and Balanced use "恵み", the key term for grace. "賜る" is an older honorific word that modern readers rarely use.

source.text: τίς ἐγκαλέσει κατὰ ἐκλεκτῶν θεοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: Who will bring a charge against chosen [ones] of God?

en.L: Who will bring a charge against [the] chosen ones of God?
en.B: Who will bring any accusation against those God has chosen?
en.R: Who can accuse the people God has chosen?

es.L: ¿Quién presentará acusación contra [los] elegidos de Dios?
es.B: ¿Quién va a acusar de algo a los que Dios ha elegido?
es.R: ¿Quién puede acusar a las personas que Dios ha elegido?

sw.L: Ni nani atakayeleta mashtaka dhidi ya wateule wa Mungu?
sw.B: Ni nani atakayeleta shtaka lolote dhidi ya wale ambao Mungu amewachagua?
sw.R: Ni nani anayeweza kuwashtaki watu ambao Mungu amewachagua?

fr.L: Qui accusera [les] élus de Dieu ?
fr.B: Qui portera une accusation contre ceux que Dieu a choisis ?
fr.R: Qui peut accuser les gens que Dieu a choisis ?

ko.L: 누가 하나님께서 택하신 사람들을 고발하겠습니까?
ko.B: 누가 하나님께서 택하신 사람들을 고발할 수 있겠습니까?
ko.R: 누가 하나님께서 택하신 사람들을 고소할 수 있겠습니까?

vi.L: Ai sẽ buộc tội những người được Đức Chúa Trời chọn?
vi.B: Ai sẽ cáo buộc những người Đức Chúa Trời đã chọn?
vi.R: Ai có thể tố cáo những người Đức Chúa Trời đã chọn?

pt.L: Quem fará acusação contra [os] escolhidos de Deus?
pt.B: Quem vai apresentar alguma acusação contra aqueles que Deus escolheu?
pt.R: Quem pode acusar as pessoas que Deus escolheu?

am.L: በእግዚአብሔር ምርጦች ላይ ማን ይከሳል?
am.B: እግዚአብሔር በመረጣቸው ላይ ማን ክስ ያቀርባል?
am.R: እግዚአብሔር የመረጣቸውን ሰዎች ማን ሊከስ ይችላል?

ru.L: Кто обвинит избранных Бога?
ru.B: Кто выдвинет какое-нибудь обвинение против тех, кого избрал Бог?
ru.R: Кто может обвинить людей, которых избрал Бог?

hi.L: परमेश्वर के चुने हुओं पर दोष कौन लगाएगा?
hi.B: जिन्हें परमेश्वर ने चुना है, उन पर कौन कोई आरोप लगाएगा?
hi.R: जिन लोगों को परमेश्वर ने चुना है, उन पर कौन आरोप लगा सकता है?

uk.L: Хто висуне звинувачення проти обраних Божих?
uk.B: Хто звинуватить тих, кого вибрав Бог?
uk.R: Хто може звинуватити людей, яких вибрав Бог?

ja.L: だれが、神に選ばれた者たちを訴えるでしょうか？
ja.B: 神が選ばれた人たちを、だれが訴えることができるでしょうか？
ja.R: 神が選ばれた人たちを、いったいだれが訴えられるでしょうか？

decisions.choice: bring a charge: accuse in court
decisions.reason: enkaleō is a law-court word: to bring a formal charge. Paul pictures the final judgment.

decisions.choice: chosen ones: those God has chosen for himself
decisions.reason: eklektoi is the Old Testament name for God's people (Isaiah 65:9). It sums up verses 29-30.

decisions.choice: a question, answered by the next sentence
decisions.reason: Verses 33-35 are a series of questions. The SBLGNT reads the words after each question as Paul's answer.

source.text: θεὸς ὁ δικαιῶν·

records.literal_gloss: God the [one] justifying;

en.L: God [is] the one who justifies.
en.B: God is the one who declares them righteous.
en.R: It is God who puts them right with {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}.

es.L: Dios [es] quien justifica.
es.B: Dios es quien los justifica.
es.R: Es Dios quien los declara justos.

sw.L: Mungu [ni] yule anayehesabia haki.
sw.B: Ni Mungu anayewahesabia haki.
sw.R: Mungu ndiye anayewahesabia haki na kuwaweka katika uhusiano mwema naye.

fr.L: Dieu [est] celui qui justifie.
fr.B: C’est Dieu qui les justifie.
fr.R: C’est Dieu qui les déclare justes.

ko.L: 의롭다고 인정하시는 분은 하나님이십니다.
ko.B: 그들을 의롭다고 인정하시는 분은 하나님이십니다.
ko.R: 그들을 의롭다고 인정해 주시는 분은 바로 하나님이십니다.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời [là] Đấng xưng công chính.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời là Đấng xưng họ là công chính.
vi.R: Chính Đức Chúa Trời công nhận họ là công chính.

pt.L: Deus [é] quem justifica.
pt.B: Deus é quem os declara justos.
pt.R: É Deus quem os aceita como justos.

am.L: የሚያጸድቅ እግዚአብሔር [ነው]።
am.B: የሚያጸድቃቸው እግዚአብሔር ነው።
am.R: ከራሱ ጋር ትክክለኛ ግንኙነት እንዲኖራቸው የሚያደርገው እግዚአብሔር ራሱ ነው።

ru.L: Бог — Оправдывающий.
ru.B: Бог — тот, кто их оправдывает.
ru.R: Это Бог оправдывает их перед собой.

hi.L: परमेश्वर ही हैं जो धर्मी ठहराते हैं।
hi.B: परमेश्वर ही हैं जो उन्हें धर्मी ठहराते हैं।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ही उन्हें अपनी दृष्टि में सही ठहराते हैं।

uk.L: Бог — той, хто виправдовує.
uk.B: Бог — це той, хто їх виправдовує.
uk.R: Саме Бог виправдовує їх і визнає праведними перед собою.

ja.L: 義とするのは神[です]。
ja.B: その人たちを義としてくださるのは、神です。
ja.R: その人たちを正しい者と認めてくださるのは、神ご自身です。

decisions.choice: a statement: God is the one who justifies
alternatives: a question: "Will God, who justifies, bring a charge?"
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT punctuates these words as an answer. Some read them as a further question expecting "no". Either way, the judge who declares believers righteous will not accuse them (Isaiah 50:8-9, which this passage echoes).

decisions.choice: God who justifies: an echo of Isaiah 50:8
decisions.reason: The servant of the LORD says, "He who vindicates me is near; who will contend with me?" Paul uses the same law-court picture.

decisions.choice: declares them righteous
decisions.reason: Balanced says what "justify" means, as in verse 30; it supplies "them", the chosen ones.

decisions.choice: puts them right with himself
decisions.reason: Readable uses the wording of verse 30.

source.text: τίς ὁ κατακρινῶν;

records.literal_gloss: Who [is] the [one] condemning?

en.L: Who [is] the one who will condemn?
en.B: Who is going to condemn them?
en.R: Who will say they are guilty and must be punished?

es.L: ¿Quién [es] el que va a condenar?
es.B: ¿Quién va a condenarlos?
es.R: ¿Quién dirá que son culpables y que deben ser castigados?

sw.L: Nani [ndiye] atakayewatia hatiani?
sw.B: Ni nani atakayewatia hatiani?
sw.R: Ni nani atakayesema kwamba wana hatia na lazima waadhibiwe?

fr.L: Qui [est] celui qui condamnera ?
fr.B: Qui va les condamner ?
fr.R: Qui dira qu’ils sont coupables et qu’ils doivent être punis ?

ko.L: 정죄할 사람이 누구입니까?
ko.B: 누가 그들을 정죄하겠습니까?
ko.R: 누가 그들에게 유죄라고 말하고 벌을 받아야 한다고 하겠습니까?

vi.L: Ai [là] người sẽ kết án?
vi.B: Ai sẽ kết án họ?
vi.R: Ai sẽ nói rằng họ có tội và phải bị phạt?

pt.L: Quem [é] o que condenará?
pt.B: Quem vai condená-los?
pt.R: Quem vai dizer que eles são culpados e devem ser castigados?

am.L: የሚኮንን ማን [ነው]?
am.B: ማን ይኮንናቸዋል?
am.R: ጥፋተኞች ናቸው፤ መቀጣት አለባቸው የሚል ማን ነው?

ru.L: Кто осуждающий?
ru.B: Кто станет их осуждать?
ru.R: Кто скажет, что они виновны и должны быть наказаны?

hi.L: दोषी ठहरानेवाला कौन है?
hi.B: कौन उन्हें दोषी ठहराएगा?
hi.R: कौन कहेगा कि वे दोषी हैं और उन्हें दंड मिलना चाहिए?

uk.L: Хто той, хто засудить?
uk.B: Хто ж їх засудить?
uk.R: Хто скаже, що вони винні й мусять бути покарані?

ja.L: 罪に定める者はだれ[でしょう]か？
ja.B: だれが、その人たちを罪に定めるでしょうか？
ja.R: その人たちを有罪とし、罰を下せる者が、いったいいるでしょうか？

decisions.choice: the one who will condemn: future
decisions.reason: The same letters can be read as a present or a future participle; the SBLGNT accents it as future, looking to the last judgment.

decisions.choice: say they are guilty and must be punished
decisions.reason: Readable says what "condemn" means, as in verse 1.

decisions.choice: kuwatia hatiani
decisions.reason: "Kuhukumu" is to judge, which may end in acquittal; the verb here is the verdict of guilty and its sentence, the noun of verse 1 (m1). "Kutia hatiani" (to find guilty) says that, and Readable spells out guilt and punishment as the English Readable does.

source.text: Χριστὸς ὁ ἀποθανών, μᾶλλον δὲ ἐγερθείς, ὅς καί ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θεοῦ, ὃς καὶ ἐντυγχάνει ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν·

records.literal_gloss: Christ the [one] having died, rather and having been raised, who also is at right hand of the God, who also intercedes for us;

en.L: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} [is] the one who died, and more than that, was raised, who also is at [the] right hand of God, who also intercedes for us.
en.B: {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} is the one who died; still more, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} was raised, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is at the right hand of God, where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} pleads on our behalf.
en.R: {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} died, and more than that, God raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to life. Now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has the place of honor at God's right side, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} speaks to God for us.

es.L: {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} [es] quien murió, y aún más, quien fue resucitado, quien también está a [la] derecha de Dios, quien además ruega por nosotros.
es.B: {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} es quien murió; más todavía, fue resucitado, y está a la derecha de Dios, donde ruega a nuestro favor.
es.R: {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} murió, y más que eso, Dios {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó. Ahora tiene el lugar de honor a la derecha de Dios, y habla con Dios a favor nuestro.

sw.L: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} [ndiye] yule aliyekufa, na zaidi ya hilo, alifufuliwa, ambaye pia yuko mkono wa kulia wa Mungu, ambaye pia anaomba kwa ajili yetu.
sw.B: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ndiye aliyekufa; zaidi ya hapo, alifufuliwa, naye yuko mkono wa kulia wa Mungu, ambapo anaomba kwa niaba yetu.
sw.R: {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alikufa, na zaidi ya hilo, Mungu alimfufua. Sasa ana nafasi ya heshima upande wa kulia wa Mungu, naye anazungumza na Mungu kwa ajili yetu.

fr.L: {{christos:Christ|Le Messie}} [est] celui qui est mort, bien plus, qui a été ressuscité, qui aussi est à [la] droite de Dieu, qui aussi intercède pour nous.
fr.B: {{christos:Christ|Le Messie}} est celui qui est mort ; bien plus, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été ressuscité, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est à la droite de Dieu, où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} plaide en notre faveur.
fr.R: {{christos:Christ|Le Messie}} est mort, et plus encore, Dieu {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ramené à la vie. Maintenant, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a la place d’honneur à la droite de Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} parle à Dieu en notre faveur.

ko.L: 죽으신 분, 아니 오히려 살아나신 분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이십니다. 그분은 하나님의 오른편에 계시고, 우리를 위하여 간구하십니다.
ko.B: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 죽으셨을 뿐 아니라, 더 나아가 살아나셨고, 하나님의 오른편에 계셔서 우리를 위해 간구하십니다.
ko.R: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 죽으셨습니다. 그뿐 아니라 하나님께서 그분을 다시 살리셨습니다. 이제 그분은 하나님의 오른편 영광스러운 자리에 계시고, 우리를 위해 하나님께 말씀드리십니다.

vi.L: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} [là] Đấng đã chết, hơn thế nữa, đã được sống lại, là Đấng cũng đang ở bên phải Đức Chúa Trời, là Đấng cũng cầu thay cho chúng ta.
vi.B: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} là Đấng đã chết; hơn thế nữa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã được sống lại, và đang ở bên phải Đức Chúa Trời, nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cầu thay cho chúng ta.
vi.R: {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã chết, và hơn thế nữa, Đức Chúa Trời đã khiến {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sống lại. Bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở chỗ danh dự bên phải Đức Chúa Trời, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời cho chúng ta.

pt.L: {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} [é] o que morreu, e mais ainda, foi ressuscitado, o qual também está à direita de Deus, o qual também intercede por nós.
pt.B: {{christos:Cristo|O Messias}} é aquele que morreu; mais do que isso, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} foi ressuscitado e está à direita de Deus, onde suplica por nós.
pt.R: {{christos:Cristo|O Messias}} morreu e, mais do que isso, Deus {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} ressuscitou. Agora {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ocupa o lugar de honra ao lado direito de Deus, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fala a Deus em nosso favor.

am.L: የሞተው {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} [ነው]፤ ይልቁንም የተነሣው፣ ደግሞ በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ያለው፣ ደግሞ ስለ እኛ የሚማልደው [እርሱ ነው]።
am.B: የሞተው {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ነው፤ ከዚህም በላይ ተነሥቷል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ሆኖም ስለ እኛ ይማልዳል።
am.R: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ሞተ፤ ከዚህም በላይ እግዚአብሔር ከሞት አስነሣው። አሁን በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ የክብር ስፍራ አለው፤ ስለ እኛም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይናገራል።

ru.L: {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} — умерший, более того, воскрешённый, который и находится по правую руку Бога, который и ходатайствует за нас.
ru.B: {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} — тот, кто умер; более того, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} был воскрешён и находится по правую руку Бога, где {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} просит за нас.
ru.R: {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} умер, и более того, Бог воскресил {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} к жизни. Теперь {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} на почётном месте, по правую руку от Бога, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорит Богу за нас.

hi.L: मसीह ही हैं जो मरे, वरन् जिलाए भी गए, जो परमेश्वर की दाहिनी ओर हैं, और हमारे लिए विनती भी करते हैं।
hi.B: मसीह वे हैं जो मरे; इससे भी बढ़कर, वे जिलाए गए, और वे परमेश्वर की दाहिनी ओर हैं, जहाँ वे हमारे लिए विनती करते हैं।
hi.R: मसीह मरे, और इससे भी बढ़कर, परमेश्वर ने उन्हें फिर से जीवित किया। अब वे परमेश्वर की दाहिनी ओर आदर के स्थान पर हैं, और वे हमारे लिए परमेश्वर से बात करते हैं।

uk.L: {{christos:Христос|Месія}} — той, хто помер, а ще більше — воскрес, хто також є по правиці Бога, хто й заступається за нас.
uk.B: {{christos:Христос|Месія}} — той, хто помер; ба більше, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} був воскрешений і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} перебуває по правиці Бога, де {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} клопочеться за нас.
uk.R: {{christos:Христос|Месія}} помер, і більше того, Бог воскресив {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} до життя. Тепер {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} має почесне місце праворуч від Бога, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} заступається перед Богом за нас.

ja.L: {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}[こそ]、死なれた方、いや、むしろ起こされた方であり、神の右におられ、わたしたちのためにとりなしてもくださる方[です]。
ja.B: {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は、死んでくださった方です。それどころか、死者の中から起こされ、神の右におられて、わたしたちのためにとりなしてくださっています。
ja.R: {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は死なれました。それだけではなく、神は{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}を死からよみがえらせてくださいました。今、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}は神の右にある、最も尊い場所におられ、わたしたちのために神に願ってくださっています。

decisions.choice: an answer: Christ, who died and pleads for us, is the one who could condemn and does not
alternatives: a further question: "Is it Christ who died ... who will condemn us?"
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT punctuates the words as a statement. Read either way, the point is the same: the one who might judge is the one who died for us and speaks for us.

decisions.choice: "Christ"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts have "Christ Jesus"; others have "Christ" alone, which the SBLGNT follows. Some also add "from the dead" after "raised". (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

decisions.choice: at the right hand of God: the place of honor and power
decisions.reason: The words echo Psalm 110:1, "Sit at my right hand". To sit at a king's right hand was to share his rule.

decisions.choice: intercedes: pleads on someone's behalf
decisions.reason: entugchanō is to approach someone for another, the verb used of the Spirit in verse 27. The Spirit pleads within believers, and Christ pleads for them before God (Hebrews 7:25).

decisions.choice: God raised him to life; the place of honor at God's right side
alternatives: was raised; at the right hand of God
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who raised him and explains "right hand" (m3).

decisions.choice: naye, no span
decisions.reason: Where the English Balanced and Readable say "he" for Christ, Swahili uses the verb prefix or "naye" (and he), in which the pronoun is joined to the conjunction and cannot take a capital, so there is no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}} as the answer: "... 분은 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}이십니다" (L); "{{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서는 ..." (B, R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads this as the answer: Christ, who died and pleads for us, is the one who could condemn and does not. Literal ends on Christ's name to keep that shape; Balanced and Readable state it.

decisions.choice: "神の右にある、最も尊い場所" (R); "神の右" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The right hand of God is the place of honor and shared rule (m3). Readable says so; Literal and Balanced keep the biblical phrase. Christ's pleading uses the same verb as the Spirit's in verse 27, "とりなす" (L, B); Readable says "神に願って" for Christ, who speaks for us before God (m4).

source.text: τίς ἡμᾶς χωρίσει ἀπὸ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ Χριστοῦ;

records.literal_gloss: Who us will separate from the love of the Christ?

en.L: Who will separate us from the love of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}?
en.B: Who can tear us away from the love of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}?
en.R: Can anything take us away from the love {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} has for us?

es.L: ¿Quién nos separará del amor {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}?
es.B: ¿Quién podrá arrancarnos del amor {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}?
es.R: ¿Puede algo apartarnos del amor que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} nos tiene?

sw.L: Nani atatutenganisha na upendo wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}?
sw.B: Ni nani anayeweza kutung'oa kutoka katika upendo wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}?
sw.R: Je, kuna kitu chochote kinachoweza kututenganisha na upendo ambao {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} anao kwetu?

fr.L: Qui nous séparera de l’amour du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ?
fr.B: Qui pourra nous arracher à l’amour du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ?
fr.R: Est-ce que quelque chose peut nous enlever l’amour que le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} a pour nous ?

ko.L: 누가 우리를 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 사랑에서 끊겠습니까?
ko.B: 누가 우리를 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 사랑에서 떼어 놓을 수 있겠습니까?
ko.R: {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 우리를 사랑하시는데, 그 사랑에서 무엇이 우리를 떼어 놓을 수 있겠습니까?

vi.L: Ai sẽ phân cách chúng ta khỏi tình yêu thương của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}?
vi.B: Ai có thể tách chúng ta khỏi tình yêu thương của {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}?
vi.R: Có điều gì có thể tách chúng ta khỏi tình yêu thương mà {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} dành cho chúng ta không?

pt.L: Quem nos separará do amor do {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}?
pt.B: Quem poderá nos arrancar do amor {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}?
pt.R: Será que alguma coisa pode nos afastar do amor que {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} tem por nós?

am.L: {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሕ}} ፍቅር ማን ይለየናል?
am.B: {{christos:ከክርስቶስ|ከመሲሕ}} ፍቅር ማን ሊነጥለን ይችላል?
am.R: {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ለእኛ ካለው ፍቅር ምንም ነገር ሊለየን ይችላልን?

ru.L: Кто отлучит нас от любви {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}?
ru.B: Кто может оторвать нас от любви {{christos:Христа|Мессии}}?
ru.R: Может ли что-нибудь отнять у нас любовь, которую {{christos:Христос|Мессия}} имеет к нам?

hi.L: कौन हमें मसीह के प्रेम से अलग करेगा?
hi.B: कौन हमें मसीह के प्रेम से दूर कर सकता है?
hi.R: क्या कोई भी चीज़ हमें उस प्रेम से दूर कर सकती है जो मसीह हमसे करते हैं?

uk.L: Хто нас відлучить від любові {{christos:Христової|Месії}}?
uk.B: Хто може відірвати нас від любові {{christos:Христової|Месії}}?
uk.R: Чи може щось відірвати нас від любові, яку {{christos:Христос|Месія}} має до нас?

ja.L: だれが、わたしたちを{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の愛から引き離すでしょうか？
ja.B: だれが、{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の愛からわたしたちを引き裂くことができるでしょうか？
ja.R: {{christos:キリスト|メシア}}はわたしたちを愛してくださっています。その愛から、わたしたちを引き離せるものが何かあるでしょうか？

decisions.choice: the love of Christ: Christ's love for us
decisions.reason: The question is whether anything can cut believers off from the love Christ has for them, as verse 37 ("the one who loved us") and verse 39 ("the love of God") show.

decisions.choice: "of Christ"
decisions.reason: A few manuscripts have "the love of God", as in verse 39. Most have "of Christ", and the SBLGNT follows them. (From general knowledge of the manuscripts; to be checked against the apparatus.)

decisions.choice: who: any person or thing
decisions.reason: The question begins with "who", but the list that follows names things, not people. Paul means anything at all.

decisions.choice: Can anything
decisions.reason: Readable says "anything", since the list that follows names things (m3).

source.text: θλῖψις ἢ στενοχωρία ἢ διωγμὸς ἢ λιμὸς ἢ γυμνότης ἢ κίνδυνος ἢ μάχαιρα;

records.literal_gloss: Trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?

en.L: Trouble or distress or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
en.B: Trouble, or anguish, or persecution? Hunger, or lack of clothing, or danger, or the sword?
en.R: Can troubles or hard times? Can people who attack us because we belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}? Can hunger, or having nothing to wear, or danger, or a violent death?

es.L: ¿[Será] la aflicción, o la angustia, o la persecución, o el hambre, o la desnudez, o el peligro, o la espada?
es.B: ¿La aflicción, o la angustia, o la persecución? ¿El hambre, o la falta de ropa, o el peligro, o la espada?
es.R: ¿Pueden hacerlo los problemas o los tiempos difíciles? ¿Pueden hacerlo las personas que nos atacan porque pertenecemos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}? ¿Puede hacerlo el hambre, o no tener qué ponernos, o el peligro, o una muerte violenta?

sw.L: [Je, ni] taabu, au dhiki, au kuteswa, au njaa, au kukosa nguo, au hatari, au upanga?
sw.B: Je, ni taabu, au dhiki, au kuteswa? Je, ni njaa, au kukosa mavazi, au hatari, au upanga?
sw.R: Je, matatizo au nyakati ngumu zinaweza? Je, watu wanaotushambulia kwa sababu sisi ni wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wanaweza? Je, njaa, au kukosa nguo za kuvaa, au hatari, au kifo cha kikatili vinaweza?

fr.L: Détresse, ou angoisse, ou persécution, ou famine, ou nudité, ou danger, ou épée ?
fr.B: La détresse, ou l’angoisse, ou la persécution ? La faim, ou le manque de vêtements, ou le danger, ou l’épée ?
fr.R: Est-ce que les difficultés ou les moments durs le peuvent ? Est-ce que les gens qui nous attaquent parce que nous appartenons au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} le peuvent ? Est-ce que la faim, le manque de vêtements, le danger ou une mort violente le peuvent ?

ko.L: 환난입니까, 곤고입니까, 박해입니까, 굶주림입니까, 헐벗음입니까, 위험입니까, 칼입니까?
ko.B: 환난입니까, 괴로움입니까, 박해입니까? 굶주림입니까, 헐벗음입니까, 위험입니까, 칼입니까?
ko.R: 어려움이나 고통이 그렇게 할 수 있습니까? 우리가 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 속했다고 우리를 공격하는 사람들이 그렇게 할 수 있습니까? 굶주림이나, 입을 옷이 없는 것이나, 위험이나, 칼에 맞아 죽는 것이 그렇게 할 수 있습니까?

vi.L: Hoạn nạn, hay khốn khó, hay bắt bớ, hay đói kém, hay trần truồng, hay nguy hiểm, hay gươm giáo?
vi.B: Hoạn nạn, khốn khổ hay bắt bớ? Đói khát, thiếu áo mặc, hiểm nguy hay gươm giáo?
vi.R: Khó khăn hay đau khổ có thể không? Những người bắt bớ chúng ta vì chúng ta thuộc về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} có thể không? Đói khát, không có áo mặc, hiểm nguy, hay bị giết cách tàn bạo có thể không?

pt.L: Tribulação, ou angústia, ou perseguição, ou fome, ou nudez, ou perigo, ou espada?
pt.B: A aflição, a angústia ou a perseguição? A fome, a falta de roupa, o perigo ou a espada?
pt.R: Será que as dificuldades ou os tempos difíceis podem? Será que as pessoas que nos atacam porque pertencemos {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}} podem? Será que a fome, a falta de roupa, o perigo ou uma morte violenta podem?

am.L: መከራ ወይስ ጭንቀት ወይስ ስደት ወይስ ራብ ወይስ ራቁትነት ወይስ አደጋ ወይስ ሰይፍ?
am.B: መከራ ወይስ ጭንቀት ወይስ ስደት? ራብ ወይስ የልብስ እጦት ወይስ አደጋ ወይስ ሰይፍ?
am.R: ችግር ወይም አስቸጋሪ ጊዜ ሊለየን ይችላልን? {{christos:የክርስቶስ|የመሲሑ}} ስለ ሆንን የሚያጠቁን ሰዎች ሊለዩን ይችላሉን? ራብ ወይም የሚለበስ ማጣት ወይም አደጋ ወይም የግፍ ሞት ሊለየን ይችላልን?

ru.L: Скорбь, или теснота, или гонение, или голод, или нагота, или опасность, или меч?
ru.B: Скорбь, или страдание, или гонение? Голод, или нехватка одежды, или опасность, или меч?
ru.R: Могут ли трудности или тяжёлые времена? Могут ли люди, которые нападают на нас за то, что мы принадлежим {{christos:Христу|Мессии}}? Могут ли голод, или то, что нам нечего надеть, или опасность, или насильственная смерть?

hi.L: क्या क्लेश, या संकट, या सताव, या अकाल, या नंगाई, या जोखिम, या तलवार?
hi.B: क्लेश, या पीड़ा, या सताव? भूख, या वस्त्रों की कमी, या ख़तरा, या तलवार?
hi.R: क्या मुसीबतें या कठिन समय? क्या वे लोग जो हम पर इसलिए हमला करते हैं कि हम मसीह के हैं? क्या भूख, या पहनने को कुछ न होना, या ख़तरा, या हिंसक मृत्यु?

uk.L: Скорбота, чи утиск, чи переслідування, чи голод, чи нагота, чи небезпека, чи меч?
uk.B: Біда, чи туга, чи переслідування? Голод, чи брак одягу, чи небезпека, чи меч?
uk.R: Чи можуть біди або важкі часи? Чи можуть люди, які нападають на нас, бо ми належимо {{christos:Христові|Месії}}? Чи можуть голод, чи брак одягу, чи небезпека, чи насильницька смерть?

ja.L: 苦難か、行き詰まりか、迫害か、飢えか、裸か、危険か、剣か？
ja.B: 苦難や、行き詰まりや、迫害でしょうか？飢えや、着る物のないことや、危険や、剣でしょうか？
ja.R: 困難やつらいことでしょうか？{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}に属しているために、わたしたちを攻撃する人たちでしょうか？飢えや、着る物がないことや、危険や、むごい殺され方でしょうか？

decisions.choice: trouble and distress: outward pressure and inner anguish
decisions.reason: thlipsis is pressure and hardship; stenochōria is being hemmed in, with nowhere to turn. Paul pairs them in 2:9.

decisions.choice: sword: violent death, as by execution
decisions.reason: The sword stands for being killed by force, the fate of martyrs, as verse 36 goes on to say.

decisions.choice: persecution, famine, nakedness: what Paul himself had suffered
decisions.reason: Paul lists such hardships from his own life in 2 Corinthians 11:23-27. These are things that might seem to show that God had abandoned his people.

decisions.choice: people who attack us because we belong to Christ; a violent death
decisions.reason: Readable explains "persecution" and "sword" (m2) in plain words.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Readable names Christ, whose love verse 35 speaks of, and the title takes the usual setting.

decisions.choice: "détresse"
decisions.reason: The same word as "détresse" in 5:3, so the reader can see that the troubles in which believers boast are the troubles that cannot separate them from Christ's love.

decisions.choice: "환난" (L, B) / "어려움" (R), as at 5:3; "곤고" (L); "괴로움" (B); "고통" (R)
decisions.reason: Trouble and distress are outward pressure and inner anguish (meaning decision). "환난" keeps the word of 2:9 and 5:3; "곤고" is the exact but old word, so Balanced and Readable use current words.

decisions.choice: "hoạn nạn" and "khốn khó" (L), "khốn khổ" (B); "khó khăn" and "đau khổ" (R)
decisions.reason: Outward pressure and inner anguish (m1). "Hoạn nạn" is the word for this pressure in 5:3, and Readable says "khó khăn" there too.

decisions.choice: tribulação (L); aflição (B)
decisions.reason: As in 5:3: thlipsis is "tribulação" at Literal and "aflição" at Balanced; Readable "dificuldades".

decisions.choice: "行き詰まり"
decisions.reason: The word is being hemmed in with nowhere to turn (m1), set beside outward pressure. "行き詰まり" keeps that picture of a narrow place.

source.text: καθὼς γέγραπται ὅτι Ἕνεκεν σοῦ θανατούμεθα ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν, ἐλογίσθημεν ὡς πρόβατα σφαγῆς.

records.literal_gloss: As it has been written that: For the sake of you we are being put to death whole the day, we were counted as sheep of slaughter.

en.L: Just as it is written, "For {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sake we are being put to death all the day; we were counted as sheep of slaughter."
en.B: As it is written, "On {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} account we are being killed the whole day through; we are looked on as sheep for the butcher."
en.R: This is what the Scriptures say: "Because we belong to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, people try to kill us all the time. They think of us as sheep to be killed."

es.L: Así como está escrito: «A causa de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} se nos da muerte todo el día; fuimos tenidos por ovejas de matadero».
es.B: Como está escrito: «Por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} nos están matando el día entero; nos miran como a ovejas para el carnicero».
es.R: Esto es lo que dicen las Escrituras: «Porque {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pertenecemos, la gente trata de matarnos todo el tiempo. Nos ven como ovejas que van a ser sacrificadas».

sw.L: Kama ilivyoandikwa, "Kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} tunakabiliwa na kifo siku nzima; tulihesabiwa kama kondoo wa machinjoni."
sw.B: Kama ilivyoandikwa, "Kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} tunauawa siku nzima; tunatazamwa kama kondoo wa kupelekwa kwa mchinjaji."
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo Maandiko yanavyosema: "Kwa sababu sisi ni {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, watu wanajaribu kutuua wakati wote. Wanatuona kama kondoo wanaopelekwa kuchinjwa."

fr.L: Selon qu’il est écrit : « À cause de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, nous sommes mis à mort tout le jour ; nous avons été considérés comme des brebis d’abattoir. »
fr.B: Comme il est écrit : « À cause de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, on nous met à mort tout au long du jour ; on nous regarde comme des moutons destinés à l’abattoir. »
fr.R: Voici ce que disent les Écritures : « Parce que nous {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartenons, on cherche sans cesse à nous tuer. On nous traite comme des moutons qu’on va égorger. »

ko.L: 기록된 대로입니다. "우리가 종일 주님을 위하여 죽임을 당하며, 도살당할 양처럼 여겨졌다."
ko.B: 기록된 대로입니다. "우리는 주님 때문에 온종일 죽임을 당하고, 도살장으로 끌려갈 양처럼 여겨진다."
ko.R: 성경에 이렇게 기록되어 있습니다. "우리가 주님께 속했기 때문에, 사람들은 언제나 우리를 죽이려고 한다. 그들은 우리를 잡혀 죽을 양처럼 여긴다."

vi.L: Như có chép: "Vì cớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà chúng tôi bị giết suốt ngày; chúng tôi bị kể như chiên để làm thịt."
vi.B: Như có lời chép: "Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà chúng tôi bị giết suốt ngày; chúng tôi bị xem như chiên đem đến lò sát sinh."
vi.R: Như Kinh Thánh chép: "Vì chúng tôi thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, người ta lúc nào cũng tìm cách giết chúng tôi. Họ xem chúng tôi như chiên đem đi giết."

pt.L: Assim como está escrito: "Por {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} causa somos mortos o dia inteiro; fomos contados como ovelhas de matança."
pt.B: Como está escrito: "Por {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} causa estamos sendo mortos o dia todo; somos vistos como ovelhas para o abate."
pt.R: É isto que as Escrituras dizem: "Porque pertencemos a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, as pessoas tentam nos matar o tempo todo. Elas nos veem como ovelhas que vão ser mortas."

am.L: እንዲህ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ፦ «ስለ አንተ ቀኑን ሙሉ እንገደላለን፤ እንደሚታረዱ በጎች ተቆጠርን።»
am.B: እንዲህ ተብሎ ተጽፏል፦ «ስለ አንተ ቀኑን ሙሉ እንገደላለን፤ ለዕርድ እንደ ተዘጋጁ በጎች ተቆጠርን።»
am.R: ቅዱሳት መጻሕፍት እንዲህ ይላሉ፦ «የአንተ ስለ ሆንን ሰዎች ሁልጊዜ ሊገድሉን ይሞክራሉ። እንደሚታረዱ በጎች ይቆጥሩናል።»

ru.L: Как написано: «Ради {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} нас умерщвляют весь день; мы сочтены как овцы на заклание.»
ru.B: Как написано: «Из-за {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} нас убивают каждый день; на нас смотрят как на овец для бойни.»
ru.R: Как говорит Писание: «Потому что мы принадлежим {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, люди всё время пытаются убить нас. Они думают о нас как об овцах, которых ведут на убой.»

hi.L: जैसा लिखा है, "तेरे लिए हम दिन भर मार डाले जाते हैं; हम वध होनेवाली भेड़ों के समान गिने गए।"
hi.B: जैसा लिखा है, "तेरे कारण हम सारे दिन घात किए जाते हैं; हमें क़साई के लिए भेड़ों के समान समझा जाता है।"
hi.R: पवित्रशास्त्र यह कहता है: "क्योंकि हम तेरे हैं, लोग हर समय हमें मार डालने की कोशिश करते हैं। वे हमें काटी जानेवाली भेड़ें समझते हैं।"

uk.L: Як написано: «Заради {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} нас убивають увесь день; нас зарахували, як овець для забою.»
uk.B: Як написано: «Через {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} нас убивають день у день; на нас дивляться, як на овець для різника.»
uk.R: Ось що каже Писання: «Через те, що ми належимо {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}, люди весь час намагаються нас убити. Вони вважають нас вівцями, яких треба зарізати.»

ja.L: 「あなたのゆえに、わたしたちは一日中殺されている。わたしたちは、殺されるための羊と数えられた」と書かれているとおりです。
ja.B: こう書かれているとおりです。「あなたのために、わたしたちは一日じゅう命を奪われ、殺されるために引かれていく羊のように見られている。」
ja.R: 聖書にはこう書いてあります。「あなたのものであるために、わたしたちはいつも殺されそうになっている。人々はわたしたちを、殺されるための羊のように思っている。」

decisions.choice: a quotation of Psalm 44:23 (Hebrew numbering)
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the psalm in the words of the Greek Old Testament. There God's people, faithful to him, cry out that they suffer for his sake. Paul applies their words to believers who suffer for Christ.

decisions.choice: "you" is God, to whom the psalm is spoken
decisions.reason: The psalm addresses God. Paul keeps its words; in his use, suffering "for your sake" is suffering for belonging to God and to Christ.

decisions.choice: all the day: all the time, continually
decisions.reason: A Hebrew way of saying "without stopping".

decisions.choice: sheep of slaughter: sheep meant to be killed
decisions.reason: The Hebrew phrase means sheep set aside for slaughter, with no defense.

decisions.choice: Because we belong to you, people try to kill us
alternatives: for your sake we are put to death
decisions.reason: Readable says why they suffer and who causes it.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}
decisions.reason: The "you" of the psalm is God (m2), addressed in the singular, so the pronoun takes the deity_pronoun span, as in the English.

decisions.choice: siku nzima (L, B); wakati wote (R)
decisions.reason: "All the day" means all the time, continually (m3). "Siku nzima" (the whole day) keeps the picture in plain words; Readable says "wakati wote" as the English Readable says "all the time". The pronoun for God is the free possessive ("yako", "wako"), which takes the span.

decisions.choice: the psalm in 해라체, as settled at 2:24; God addressed as "주님"
decisions.reason: Scripture quotations are in 해라체 through the letter; the psalm speaks to God (meaning decision), and Korean addresses God as "주님", as in the psalm at 3:4, rather than with a pronoun.

decisions.choice: "잡혀 죽을 양" (R)
decisions.reason: Sheep of slaughter are sheep meant to be killed (meaning decision); Readable says it in plain words instead of "도살".

decisions.choice: "chúng tôi" for the psalm's speakers and "Ngài" for God addressed
decisions.reason: In the psalm the people speak to God (m2). The style guide has the psalmist say "tôi" and speak to God as "Ngài"; the people together say "chúng tôi". "Bị kể" (L) keeps the reckoning verb of chapter 4.

decisions.choice: tu ("tua", "ti")
decisions.reason: The psalm speaks to God, so it uses "tu" (docs/portuguese-style.md section 4), with the deity_pronoun span where the English has one on "your".

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}; {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}
decisions.reason: The psalm is spoken to God (m2), so the pronoun takes the setting, as the English one does.

decisions.choice: "तेरे" where the psalm speaks to God
decisions.reason: The psalm is spoken to God (meaning decision m2), and the style guide has people speaking to God say "तू", the intimate address of Hindi prayer.

decisions.choice: plain style (だ・である) inside the quotation; "あなた" for God
alternatives: です・ます inside the quotation
decisions.reason: Quoted Scripture inside a letter keeps the plain style, as the style guide says. The psalm speaks to God (m2), and people speaking to God say "あなた".

source.text: ἀλλ’ ἐν τούτοις πᾶσιν ὑπερνικῶμεν διὰ τοῦ ἀγαπήσαντος ἡμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: But in these [things] all we more than conquer through the [one] having loved us.

en.L: But in all these things we are winning overwhelmingly through the one who loved us.
en.B: But in all of this we are winning, and winning by far, through the one who loved us.
en.R: But even in all these troubles, we win a complete victory with the help of the one who loved us.

es.L: Pero en todas estas cosas vencemos ampliamente a través de aquel que nos amó.
es.B: Pero en medio de todo esto estamos venciendo, y venciendo con mucho, a través de aquel que nos amó.
es.R: Pero aun en medio de todos estos problemas, obtenemos una victoria completa con la ayuda de aquel que nos amó.

sw.L: Lakini katikati ya mambo haya yote tunashinda kwa ushindi mkubwa kupitia yule aliyetupenda.
sw.B: Lakini katikati ya haya yote tunashinda, tena tunashinda kwa mbali, kupitia yule aliyetupenda.
sw.R: Lakini hata katikati ya taabu hizi zote, tunapata ushindi kamili kwa msaada wa yule aliyetupenda.

fr.L: Mais dans toutes ces choses, nous remportons une victoire écrasante par celui qui nous a aimés.
fr.B: Mais dans tout cela, nous sommes vainqueurs, et de loin, grâce à celui qui nous a aimés.
fr.R: Mais même au milieu de toutes ces difficultés, nous remportons une victoire complète avec l’aide de celui qui nous a aimés.

ko.L: 그러나 이 모든 일에서 우리는 우리를 사랑하신 분을 통하여 넉넉히 이기고 있습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 이 모든 일 가운데서도 우리는 우리를 사랑하신 분을 통해 이기고도 남습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 이 모든 어려움 가운데서도, 우리는 우리를 사랑하신 분의 도움으로 완전한 승리를 거둡니다.

vi.L: Nhưng trong tất cả những điều này, chúng ta chiến thắng vượt bậc nhờ Đấng đã yêu thương chúng ta.
vi.B: Nhưng trong mọi điều ấy, chúng ta đang chiến thắng, và chiến thắng vẻ vang, nhờ Đấng đã yêu thương chúng ta.
vi.R: Nhưng ngay giữa tất cả những khó khăn ấy, chúng ta giành được chiến thắng trọn vẹn nhờ sự giúp đỡ của Đấng đã yêu thương chúng ta.

pt.L: Mas em todas essas coisas vencemos amplamente por meio daquele que nos amou.
pt.B: Mas em tudo isso estamos vencendo, e vencendo com muita vantagem, por meio daquele que nos amou.
pt.R: Mas, mesmo no meio de todas essas dificuldades, temos uma vitória completa com a ajuda daquele que nos amou.

am.L: ነገር ግን በእነዚህ ሁሉ በወደደን በእርሱ በኩል እጅግ አብልጠን እያሸነፍን ነው።
am.B: ነገር ግን በዚህ ሁሉ በወደደን በእርሱ በኩል እናሸንፋለን፤ ደግሞም በብዙ እጥፍ እናሸንፋለን።
am.R: ነገር ግን በእነዚህ ሁሉ ችግሮች ውስጥ እንኳ በወደደን በእርሱ እርዳታ ፍጹም ድል እናገኛለን።

ru.L: Но во всём этом мы более чем побеждаем через Возлюбившего нас.
ru.B: Но во всём этом мы побеждаем, и побеждаем с избытком, через того, кто нас возлюбил.
ru.R: Но даже во всех этих трудностях мы одерживаем полную победу с помощью того, кто нас любит.

hi.L: परंतु इन सब बातों में हम उनके द्वारा, जिन्होंने हमसे प्रेम किया, जयवंत से भी बढ़कर हैं।
hi.B: पर इन सब बातों में हम उनके द्वारा, जिन्होंने हमसे प्रेम किया, जीत रहे हैं, और भारी जीत पा रहे हैं।
hi.R: पर इन सब मुसीबतों में भी हम उनकी सहायता से पूरी जीत पाते हैं, जिन्होंने हमसे प्रेम किया।

uk.L: Але в усьому цьому ми більш ніж перемагаємо через того, хто полюбив нас.
uk.B: Але в усьому цьому ми перемагаємо, і перемагаємо з великою перевагою, через того, хто полюбив нас.
uk.R: Але навіть у всіх цих бідах ми здобуваємо повну перемогу з допомогою того, хто полюбив нас.

ja.L: しかし、これらすべてのことにおいて、わたしたちは、わたしたちを愛してくださった方によって、勝利以上の勝利を収めています。
ja.B: しかし、これらすべての中にあっても、わたしたちを愛してくださった方によって、わたしたちは勝っています。それも、はるかに勝っているのです。
ja.R: でも、こうしたすべての苦しみの中でも、わたしたちを愛してくださった方の助けによって、わたしたちは完全に勝つのです。

decisions.choice: win overwhelmingly: win and more than win
decisions.reason: hupernikaō adds "beyond" to the verb "conquer". Believers do not only survive these things; through Christ's love they win a victory greater than the enemy's attack.

decisions.choice: the one who loved us: Christ, whose love is named in verse 35
alternatives: God, whose love is named in verse 39
decisions.reason: The past tense points to a single act of love, Christ's death (Galatians 2:20). Paul speaks of the same love as Christ's and God's (verses 35, 39), so the levels keep "the one who loved us".

decisions.choice: in all these things: in the middle of them, not by escaping them
decisions.reason: The victory is won while the troubles of verse 35 go on.

decisions.choice: winning overwhelmingly (L); winning, and winning by far (B); a complete victory (R)
decisions.reason: The familiar wording "more than conquerors" goes back to older English Bibles. The levels say in current words what the verb means (m1).

decisions.choice: vencemos ampliamente (L); estamos venciendo, y venciendo con mucho (B); obtenemos una victoria completa (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is "win" with a prefix meaning "beyond": to win and more than win (m1). Spanish keeps it a verb, as the Greek is, and says how great the victory is, rather than use the noun phrase long familiar from older Bibles.

decisions.choice: tunashinda kwa ushindi mkubwa (L); tunashinda, tena tunashinda kwa mbali (B); tunapata ushindi kamili (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is "win" with a prefix meaning "beyond" (m1). Swahili keeps it a verb and says how great the victory is, avoiding the familiar wording of older versions. "Katikati ya" (in the middle of) gives the sense of "in all these things": victory in the troubles, not by escaping them (m3).

decisions.choice: "une victoire écrasante" (L); "vainqueurs, et de loin" (B); "une victoire complète" (R)
decisions.reason: "Plus que vainqueurs" is the wording of familiar French Bibles; as in English, the levels say in their own words what the verb means: winning, and winning far beyond the enemy's attack.

decisions.choice: "chiến thắng vượt bậc" (L); "chiến thắng, và chiến thắng vẻ vang" (B); "giành được chiến thắng trọn vẹn" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to win and more than win (m1). "Thắng hơn bội phần" is the 1926 wording; the levels say the same sense in their own words, as the English levels do.

decisions.choice: vencemos amplamente (L); vencendo com muita vantagem (B); uma vitória completa (R)
decisions.reason: As the English avoids the familiar "more than conquerors", Portuguese avoids the familiar "mais que vencedores" and says in current words what the verb means (m1).

decisions.choice: "እጅግ አብልጠን እያሸነፍን ነው" (L); "እናሸንፋለን፤ ደግሞም በብዙ እጥፍ እናሸንፋለን" (B)
alternatives: "ከአሸናፊዎች እንበልጣለን" (we are more than conquerors), the familiar wording
decisions.reason: The Greek is one verb, "win overwhelmingly". The familiar phrase is avoided as the wording of an existing version, and the Amharic keeps a verb of winning as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: более чем побеждаем (L); побеждаем с избытком (B); полная победа (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is "win and more than win" (m1); each level says it in current words, and the Synodal "преодолеваем" is not used.

decisions.choice: Возлюбившего
decisions.reason: The one who loved us is Christ (m2); Literal's participle stands as a title and is capitalised, as in 5:14 and 7:4. Balanced and Readable say "того, кто", lowercase like the English.

decisions.choice: "勝利以上の勝利を収めています" (L); "勝っています。それも、はるかに勝っている" (B); "完全に勝つ" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to win and more than win (m1). The levels say that in current words rather than in a familiar older wording, as the English does.

source.text: πέπεισμαι γὰρ ὅτι οὔτε θάνατος οὔτε ζωὴ οὔτε ἄγγελοι οὔτε ἀρχαὶ οὔτε ἐνεστῶτα οὔτε μέλλοντα οὔτε δυνάμεις οὔτε ὕψωμα οὔτε βάθος οὔτε τις κτίσις ἑτέρα δυνήσεται ἡμᾶς χωρίσαι ἀπὸ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ θεοῦ τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: I am persuaded for that neither death nor life nor angels nor rulers nor things present nor things coming nor powers \v 39 nor height nor depth nor any creation other will be able us to separate from the love of the God the [one] in Christ Jesus the Lord of us.
